# Databricks Briefing: Meeting of 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Coverage window: 16 October to 15 November 2026. Items dated outside this window are labelled as background.*

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing summarises Databricks' public announcements, product changes, investments, and deadlines from the last 30 days. It is based only on the sources listed in the references. Several sources are secondary aggregators, so exact dates are noted where the sources differ. Where the provided material contains no relevant information, this is stated.

## Executive Summary

- **Genie One is the centre of Databricks' November activity.** Databricks extended Genie One to a desktop app, a Chrome new-tab extension, mobile deep links, scheduled email, a Slack and Teams approval flow, and third-party assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)).
- **Several items carry hard deadlines for customers.** The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint reaches end of life on 30 November 2026, and AI Functions on older runtimes stop working on 1 February 2027 ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming); [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Capital and expansion signals are strong.** Databricks announced roughly $3 billion of investment across Europe and the Middle East and more than $500 million in the Netherlands, both in November ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
- **No acquisitions or senior hires were announced within the window** in the sources reviewed. The most recent acquisition, Row Zero, was announced on 24 September 2026 ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-acquires-row-zero-bringing-live-governed-spreadsheets)).

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Genie One and Agent Experiences

Databricks has moved Genie One beyond the browser during the period. The macOS desktop app reached general availability, with a Windows app in Beta ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks); [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)). The Chrome extension, which replaces the new-tab page with Genie One while enabled, is in Beta and uses existing Databricks sign-in and permissions ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks); [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

Other changes to Genie One include the following:

| Date (2026) | Change | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 Nov | Approve Genie tool actions directly in Slack and Microsoft Teams | Public Preview | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 5 Nov | External knowledge sources, pulling Power BI semantic model metadata | Beta | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 10 Nov | Genie One Chrome extension | Beta | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 11 Nov | Claude connector and ChatGPT plugin for Genie One MCP | Available | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 11 Nov | Genie One desktop app for Windows | Beta | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 12 Nov | Scheduled tasks can email other users in the organisation | Released | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks) |
| 12 Nov | Artifacts and slides (decks and visual pages with data snapshots) | Beta | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks) |
| 12 Nov | Genie ZeroOps, which monitors jobs and pipelines and proposes fixes | Beta | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 14 Nov | Genie One links open directly in the iOS and Android Genie apps | Released | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks) |

Genie One is also being positioned as a governed agent layer. Databricks states that Genie One prioritises Pages (governed business definitions) over automatically inferred context and cites them in answers ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)).

### Platform, Data Engineering, and AI Infrastructure

Several platform updates were released in the period:

- **Genie Code and Lakeflow:** Trigger Lakeflow Jobs when upstream jobs complete (Beta, 3 November) and AI Function tasks for jobs (Beta, 4 November) ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Zerobus Ingest:** Ingestion into default-storage tables became generally available on 2 November ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Lakebase:** Merge strategies for Structured Streaming upserts (3 November) and Postgres 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16 minor-version updates with upstream bug and security fixes ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)). Lakebase also added native Postgres logical replication on 15 October, just before the window ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/lakebase)).
- **Model access:** Moonshot AI Kimi K3.1 Pro became available on Unity Gateway on 4 November ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Smart Routing:** Now routes only subagents, not the first prompt. Databricks states it costs up to 70% less in internal benchmarks and cuts p90 routing latency from 9 seconds to 2 seconds ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Marketplace:** Metric view listings became generally available on 5 November ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

### Governance, Security, and Compliance

Governance is a notable theme. Context-based ingress policies can now allow traffic from ChatGPT, Claude, Power BI, Tableau Cloud, dbt Cloud, and the Genie apps for Slack and Microsoft Teams, with Databricks maintaining the partner IP details ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Feature Views became available by default for compliance-profile workspaces ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

Two governance-relevant design points stand out. First, Artifacts store a snapshot of their data, so anyone who can view an artifact sees that data even without access to the source tables ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)). Second, scheduled Genie One tasks can now email other users in the organisation ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)). Both features expand the reach of governed data beyond its original permission boundary.

### Deprecations and Deadlines

| Deadline | Change | Action Required | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 Nov 2026 | Genie One MCP Beta endpoint reaches end of life (previously 31 Oct) | Move to `system.ai.genie_one_mcp` in Unity Gateway | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming) |
| Dec 2026 | Pages available by default for compliance-profile workspaces | Review Page definitions and access | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming) |
| 1 Feb 2027 | AI Functions requiring Runtime 15.4 LTS or above stop working below Runtime 17.3 LTS | Upgrade affected compute to 17.3 LTS or above | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 4 Feb 2027 | Zhipu AI GLM 5.2 retired; GLM 5.3 recommended | Migrate model references | [Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |

DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) was retired on 5 November, with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017) recommended as the replacement ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

## Deals, Investments, and Corporate Activity

- **Infrastructure investment:** Databricks announced plans to invest approximately $3 billion across Europe and the Middle East to accelerate enterprise AI adoption, dated 11 November ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
- **Netherlands investment:** More than $500 million in the Netherlands, dated 10 November ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
- **Customer win (adjacent):** Fox Corporation selected Databricks as a strategic partner for its next-generation data and AI platform on 13 October, just before the window ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
- **Acquisition (background):** Row Zero, a live, governed spreadsheet product, was acquired on 24 September. Databricks says it will add a spreadsheet interface to Genie, built on Genie Ontology, Unity Catalog, and Unity Gateway ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-acquires-row-zero-bringing-live-governed-spreadsheets)).
- **Partner recognition:** Entrada was named Genie Partner of the Year, and Lovelytics was named Brickbuilder Partner of the Year in Databricks' 2026 partner awards. The publication date in the source is not stated ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/blog/databricks-announces-2026-global-partner-awards)).

Product positioning from the Data + AI Summit (June 2026) provides context. Genie Ontology is described as a live context layer that extracts and updates business knowledge from Databricks and connected apps such as Google Drive, Jira, Slack, Confluence, and SharePoint ([Winks, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements)). Ali Ghodsi reportedly said agentic consumption "is going to get extremely expensive," and cost control was a recurring theme ([Winks, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements)). Databricks also described OpenSharing, which extends data sharing to structured data, models, skills, semantics, and Genie Agents ([Databricks Community, 2026](https://community.databricks.com/t5/community-articles/dais-2026-the-databricks-announcements-i-think-clients-should/td-p/159914)).

## Hiring

**No hiring announcements or executive appointments within the 30-day window were found in the provided sources.** A LinkedIn analysis referencing job-opening growth in regional sales and security engineering is available ([Saltzman, 2025](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/jason-salt_how-databricks-will-deploy-48b-in-2026-activity-7406815692102021120-ikZi)). That post is roughly eleven months old, is an author's speculation rather than a company disclosure, and is therefore given low weight. Hiring should be confirmed directly with the account team before the meeting.

## Analyst Assessment

**Opinion 1: The Genie One expansion is a deliberate push to make Databricks the agent layer above the user's existing tools, not just a BI product.** The window includes a desktop app, a browser extension, mobile links, Slack and Teams approvals, and connectors into ChatGPT and Claude ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)). This strategy broadens reach but also expands the number of surfaces that must be governed.

**Opinion 2: The most urgent items for customers are the 30 November MCP endpoint cutoff and the 1 February 2027 runtime requirement.** Both are hard failures rather than optional upgrades. Teams that have not migrated will see errors, not warnings ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)).

**Opinion 3: The governance model for Artifacts and scheduled email is the item most in need of clarification.** A data snapshot that is visible to anyone with view access, combined with emails sent to other users, could widen data exposure in ways that differ from the source tables' permissions ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)). Databricks has framed governance as table stakes for agents ([Winks, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements)), so the company should be able to explain these controls.

**Opinion 4: Cost and capital signals suggest Databricks is investing ahead of demand, but the cost of agentic consumption remains a customer concern.** The regional investment announcements are significant ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). Meanwhile, the company itself acknowledged that agentic usage is expensive ([Winks, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements)). Smart Routing's cost reduction is a concrete response, though it is reported from internal benchmarks ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Governance of Artifacts and scheduled email:** How do Artifact data snapshots and scheduled emails to other users respect row-level and column-level permissions in Unity Catalog, and what audit trail is available when a snapshot is shared beyond its original audience? ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks))
2. **Migration support and cost:** What support will Databricks provide for customers still on the Genie One MCP Beta endpoint before 30 November, and how will token and consumption costs for agentic workloads be forecast and capped in Unity Gateway, given the stated cost concerns? ([Databricks, 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming); [Winks, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements))
3. **Roadmap timing and GA criteria:** Which Beta features (Windows desktop, Chrome extension, Artifacts, Genie ZeroOps, External knowledge sources) are expected to reach general availability, on what timeline, and will the regional investments in Europe, the Middle East, and the Netherlands ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)) include local support, hiring, or data residency commitments relevant to our organisation?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 October to 17 November 2026 (30 days before the meeting). Based only on the search results provided.

## What changed

**Scale and growth (claimed, unaudited)**
- Ben Horowitz's 27 October essay says Databricks has passed a $7B revenue run rate, growing 80% year over year. Its Lakehouse is above $1.5B (growing over 100%) and Lakebase is above $100M. Databricks is private, so these figures are not audited. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- The same essay says agents now send Databricks more queries than people do. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- Databricks was most recently valued at $190B. As of October 2026 it has no announced IPO date and no public S-1. (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options)

**Launches**
- On 11 November, Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can still connect through the Genie One MCP server. (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents)
- Databricks launched a set of agentic AI tools on 11 November. These include an updated Genie assistant that runs in the background and makes proactive suggestions, and a separate "Ontology" feature that scans organisational data. (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html)
- Commvault announced Data Activate for Databricks, which is planned for early access in December 2026 in select Azure regions. It is not yet generally available. (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai)

**Deals and investment**
- HP is moving its customer data platform into Databricks, with a stated aim of 40% lower costs. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- Databricks plans a $3B investment in Europe and the Middle East. The source shows only the headline. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- Databricks will invest more than $500M in the Netherlands. The source shows only the headline. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)

**Hires and M&A**
- No hires were found in the results.
- The company profile lists acquisitions of Panther Labs (June 2026) and Electric DB (August 2026). Both fall before the 30-day window, so they are background only. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/7LlnrDq1nEGX)

## Gaps
- The results contain no hiring or executive-change news for the window.
- The $3B and Netherlands investment items are headline-only. Amounts, timing and scope need confirming.
- The Solutions Review newsletter (7 November) names Databricks in its headline but gives no detail in the results. (https://solutionsreview.com/business-intelligence/analytics-and-data-science-news-for-the-week-of-november-6-updates-from-databricks-ocient-smartsheet-more)

## Open questions
1. How will the new Genie agents and Ontology feature be priced and governed for our deployment, and what access controls apply to agent-generated queries?
2. What is the scope, timing and regional allocation of the $3B Europe and Middle East investment, and does it affect capacity or data residency for us?
3. Given that agents now make more queries than people, how is agent usage measured and billed, and what does the HP customer-data consolidation mean for our own migration plans?

# Databricks Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing supports a meeting with Databricks on 17 November 2026. It covers changes from roughly 16 October to 15 November 2026 in product releases, deals, investments, and leadership. It also notes earlier context where that helps interpret recent moves. Every factual statement carries a source link. Where the sources are vague, dated inconsistently, or come from low-reliability vendors, the briefing says so.

## Executive Summary

- **Product:** Databricks launched a second-generation, always-on Genie on 11 November 2026, alongside Genie Ontology and Genie Search ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). Its Genie One assistant expanded to Chrome, desktop, mobile, and email workflows in the same window ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)).
- **Deadline:** The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint reaches end of life on 30 November 2026, two weeks after the meeting ([Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)).
- **Investment:** Databricks announced a headline investment of approximately $3 billion across Europe and the Middle East on 11 November 2026. The provided material contains no details beyond the headline ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
- **Hiring:** No dated executive hire within the 30-day window could be confirmed from the provided sources.
- **Assessment:** The strongest pattern is Databricks turning Genie into a single agentic layer that spans every surface a user touches, with governance and business context as the main differentiators. Governance questions, especially around data snapshots in shared artifacts, deserve direct attention in the meeting.

## Product and Platform Changes (Last 30 Days)

The most recent release notes, dated 12 November 2026 and first seen by Releasebot on 14 November 2026, list the following changes ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)).

| Date (2026) | Change | Status | Relevance for the Meeting |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 Nov | Second-generation always-on Genie, Genie Ontology, Genie Search | Launched; Genie and Genie Ontology GA; Genie Search, Ontology Manager, and always-on Genie in preview/beta programs "coming soon" ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)) | Core strategic launch |
| 12 Nov | Genie One Chrome new-tab extension | Beta ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)) | Adoption and identity model |
| 12 Nov | Scheduled tasks can email other users | Released ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)) | Expands internal distribution of AI outputs |
| 12 Nov | Artifacts and slides in Genie One | Beta; admin must enable Artifacts preview ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)) | Raises data governance questions (see below) |
| 12 Nov | Lakebase updated to Postgres 18.7, 17.12, 16.16 | Released ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)) | Security and bug-fix patching |
| 14 Nov | Genie One desktop app GA on macOS; Windows in beta | macOS GA; Windows beta ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)) | Desktop parity |
| 12 Nov | Links to Genie chats and dashboards open in mobile apps | Released for iOS and Android ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)) | Mobile access |

The new-generation Genie is described as an agent that "works autonomously, manages long-running work, and proactively brings decisions to people through a new priority inbox and email" ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). Its Genie Search feature is said to expand to more than 100 enterprise data sources, including the lakehouse and business applications such as Google Drive, Jira, and Confluence ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).

Pricing is consumption-based rather than per seat. Admins can set spending limits by team or user through Unity Gateway ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).

### Upcoming Changes and Deadlines

The "What's coming?" page lists several dated items relevant to customers ([Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)); the Azure edition is last updated 13 November 2026 and lists the same MCP deadline ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)).

| Item | Date | Action Required |
|---|---|---|
| Genie One MCP Beta endpoint end of life (previously 31 Oct 2026) | 30 Nov 2026 | Move workloads to `system.ai.genie_one_mcp` in Unity Gateway ([Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)) |
| Pages available by default for compliance security profile workspaces | Dec 2026 | Review governed business definitions; Genie One will prioritize Pages over inferred context ([Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)) |
| AI Functions require Databricks Runtime 17.3 LTS or above | 1 Feb 2027 | Upgrade compute; calls on earlier runtimes return errors ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)) |
| Unpaginated requests to some Unity Catalog REST operations rejected | "Soon" (no date given) | Audit API integrations ([Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)) |
| Databricks-provided MCP connectors enabled by default for compliance-profile workspaces | "Soon" (no date given) | Confirm connector policies ([Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)) |

Note that the MCP endpoint deadline was moved once already, from 31 October to 30 November 2026 ([Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)). Customers should confirm the date is final.

## Deals, Investments, and Corporate Activity

### Last 30 Days

- **Investment announcement:** On 11 November 2026, Databricks announced it would invest approximately $3 billion across Europe and the Middle East to accelerate enterprise AI adoption. The press release title is the only detail available in the provided material ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
- **Analyst commentary:** A Fundz product-launch page describes the second-generation Genie as an "always-on autonomous AI assistant for enterprise work" ([Fundz, 2026](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)). Fundz is a sales-intelligence vendor, so this is a secondary and promotional description.

No new acquisition or partnership dated within the 30-day window was confirmed in the provided sources.

### Earlier Context (Outside 30 Days)

| Date | Event | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Dec 2025 | Series L round of more than $4 billion at a $134 billion valuation | [Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks) |
| Jun 2026 | Agreement to acquire Panther Labs for AI-driven threat detection | [Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks) |
| Jul 2026 | Expanded Microsoft partnership extending into the 2030s | [Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks) |
| Aug 2026 | Acquisition of Electric to give AI agents their own Postgres database | [Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks) |
| Sep 2026 | Acquisition of Row Zero, a cloud-based spreadsheet provider | [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-databricks/__h71WlGEvmuefCzSdZogxaGihmuCYu0rBKj3hkmJQF7M) |

Tracxn reports 23 acquisitions in total, with an average deal value of $700 million, though this average appears to be an estimate from aggregated data ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-databricks/__h71WlGEvmuefCzSdZogxaGihmuCYu0rBKj3hkmJQF7M)). Wikipedia also records earlier partnerships with OpenAI (September 2025) and Anthropic (March 2025) ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)).

A commentary article on the 2026 Data + AI Summit notes that Databricks is exploring "OpenSharing," which would allow organizations to share Genie Agents, a model in which providers could sell governed natural-language access to proprietary data ([Databricks Community, n.d.](https://community.databricks.com/t5/community-articles/dais-2026-the-databricks-announcements-i-think-clients-should/td-p/159914)). This is an interpretive piece rather than an official announcement.

## Leadership and Hiring

### Last 30 Days

- **General counsel:** Databricks appointed Trâm Phi as senior vice president and general counsel. She joins from DocuSign, where she was SVP and general counsel ([iteuropa, n.d.](https://iteuropa.com/news/databricks-hires-former-docusign-exec-svp-and-general-counsel)). The article does not state a date, so it cannot be confirmed as falling within the 30-day window. The article also alternates between "Trâm" and "Phil," so the spelling should be verified before the meeting.
- **Org chart:** A Workzil page updated on 4 November 2026 lists Ali Ghodsi as CEO and Co-Founder and Dave Conte as CFO ([Workzil, 2026](https://www.workzil.com/companies/databricks/team)). Derrick's data is more detailed but dated August 2026 ([Derrick, 2026](https://derrick-app.com/company/databricks/executives)).

### Current Leadership Roster (Per Derrick, Aug 2026)

| Name | Role |
|---|---|
| Ali Ghodsi | Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer |
| David Conte | Chief Financial Officer |
| Matei Zaharia | Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer |
| Rick Schultz | Chief Marketing Officer |
| Hatim Shafique | Chief Operating Officer |
| Ion Stoica | Co-founder and Executive Chair |

Source: [Derrick, 2026](https://derrick-app.com/company/databricks/executives). Derrick tracks 19 leaders in total. The CFO's first name appears as "Dave" in one source and "David" in another, so it should be confirmed.

Derrick also reports 17,306 tracked employee profiles and lists the United States as the largest location ([Derrick, 2026](https://derrick-app.com/company/databricks/executives)). These figures are estimates.

## Analysis and Assessment

**1. Genie is becoming the single agentic surface.** The November releases place Genie One in Chrome's new-tab page, desktop apps, mobile apps, scheduled emails, and shareable artifacts ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)). In my assessment, the strategic aim is to make Genie the default entry point to enterprise data rather than a feature inside the lakehouse. This raises the stakes for identity, permissions, and cost controls, and it means Databricks will compete more directly with productivity and search platforms.

**2. Context and governance are the stated differentiators.** Databricks presents Genie Ontology and Pages as ways to ground agents in governed business definitions ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex); [Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming)). The approach is credible, but it depends on customers curating definitions. The Ontology Manager is designed to flag concepts that need definitions, which suggests that much of the work will fall to customer teams.

**3. The artifact data-snapshot design needs scrutiny.** Artifacts store a snapshot of their data, and anyone who can view an artifact sees that data, even without access to the source tables ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks)). This is a deliberate trade-off for sharing, but in regulated environments it could expose data beyond existing access controls. I consider this the most important governance question for the meeting.

**4. Consumption pricing with spending limits is a deliberate choice.** Databricks states that customers pay for usage rather than seats ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). Always-on agents can generate unpredictable spend, and the industry is watching cost closely. The emphasis on spending caps suggests Databricks recognizes this risk.

**5. Near-term customer friction is concentrated in deadlines.** The MCP endpoint retirement on 30 November, the Pages default change in December, and the AI Functions runtime requirement in February 2027 will require action from many customers ([Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming); [Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)). Account teams can add value by helping customers plan these migrations.

**6. Several claims remain unverified.** Vendor and commentary sources describe Databricks' capital position and hiring in more bullish terms than the official sources do. One LinkedIn post cites a $4.8 billion raise, while Wikipedia reports a Series L of more than $4 billion at a $134 billion valuation ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)). The LinkedIn post shows an age of "11mo" and no clear date, so I have not relied on it ([Saltzman, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/jason-salt_how-databricks-will-deploy-48b-in-2026-activity-7406815692102021120-ikZi)).

## Source Reliability Notes

- **Highest reliability:** Official Databricks press releases, Databricks documentation, and Microsoft Learn pages, which reflect Databricks' own product statements.
- **Moderate reliability:** Wikipedia (citations vary in quality), Reuters-type reporting cited in Wikipedia, and Tracxn aggregated data.
- **Low reliability for this briefing:** Fundz, Derrick, and Workzil are commercial data vendors whose figures are estimated or dated. The LinkedIn post and the DAIS community article are commentary.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Artifact governance:** How do admins restrict, expire, or audit the data snapshots stored in Genie One artifacts, and do snapshots respect compliance-profile controls before the Artifacts preview is enabled more broadly? ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/databricks))
2. **MCP migration and timing:** Will Databricks extend the 30 November 2026 end-of-life date for the Genie One MCP Beta endpoint again, and what support is available to move existing workloads to `system.ai.genie_one_mcp` in Unity Gateway? ([Databricks, n.d.](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/whats-coming))
3. **Investment and preview roadmap:** How will the approximately $3 billion Europe and Middle East investment be allocated across product, data residency, and go-to-market, and when will Genie Search, Ontology Manager, and the always-on Genie move from preview into general availability? ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex))

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window covered:** c. 18 October to 17 November 2026
**Basis:** Search results only. Figures are as reported by the cited sources and have not been independently verified.

## What changed in the last 30 days

**Traction and financials**
- Ben Horowitz's essay (27 Oct) puts Databricks at a revenue run rate of more than $7B, growing 80% year over year. Its Lakehouse is above $1.5B (growing over 100%) and Lakebase above $100M. The essay gives no further breakdown, and Databricks is private, so these figures are unaudited (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people). Horowitz also wrote that agents now send Databricks more queries than people do (same source).
- Databricks remains private, with no announced IPO date or public S-1 as of October 2026. It was most recently valued at $190B (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options).

**Launches**
- On 11 Nov, Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can still connect through the Genie One MCP server (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents).
- On 11 Nov (Wednesday), Databricks also launched agentic AI tools. An updated Genie assistant runs in the background and makes proactive suggestions. A separate "Ontology" feature scans organisational data (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html).
- Commvault announced "Data Activate for Databricks," with early access planned for December 2026 in select Azure regions. This is a third-party plan, not a Databricks launch (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai).

**Deals and investment**
- HP is moving its customer data platform into Databricks, with a stated aim of 40% lower costs (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs).
- Headlines on the same wire page reference "Databricks Plans $3B Investment in Europe and the Middle East" and "Databricks to Invest More Than $500M in the Netherlands." I did not see the full articles, so treat these as headline-level only (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs).

**Hires and leadership**
- No hires or leadership changes were found in the search results.

## Caveats
- Revenue and growth figures come from a single essay and are unaudited.
- The Solutions Review weekly roundup mentions Databricks, but the excerpt contains no details (https://solutionsreview.com/business-intelligence/analytics-and-data-science-news-for-the-week-of-november-6-updates-from-databricks-ocient-smartsheet-more).
- The company profile lists acquisitions (Electric DB, Aug 2026; Panther Labs, Jun 2026; Quotient AI, Mar 2026), but all fall before the 30-day window (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/7LlnrDq1nEGX).

## Open questions
1. Can Databricks share metrics that verify the Lakehouse and Lakebase growth figures, and the share of queries now coming from agents?
2. How will the native Genie plugins and Genie One MCP server affect governed data access for our organisation, and what is the roadmap for agent integrations?
3. What is the timing and scope of the $3B Europe and Middle East investment, and does it bring changes to regional pricing, support or data residency?

## Summary

Canva announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 roles, about 22% of staff, on 3 November (US time) and 4 November (Sydney time) 2026 ([Varley, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life)). The figure covers redundancies, changed roles and relocation requests, not confirmed exits ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). Product, Growth and Platform are merging into one product organisation ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

| From Jan 2027 | Most hybrid staff expected in office two to three days a week | [employerbranding.news (n.d.)](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle) |

### Severance and Terms (Verified Against Reporting)

- Departing staff receive at least six months' base pay, regardless of location ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)).
- Benefits include 12 months of healthcare where Canva already provides it, career coaching, a year of LinkedIn Premium, retained MacBooks, removal of the one-year vesting cliff, and optional US$10,000 grants ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).
- Quartz treats the six-month floor, MacBook retention and grants as outliers against a 16-week sector baseline ([Quartz, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages)).

### Launches, Hires and Deals

- **Launches:** Canva released Craft, its in-house image model, in October 2026 ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). The exact date is unverified and should be confirmed.
- **Hiring:** No dated hiring data falls in the window. Reporting says Canva is concentrating product teams in Sydney, which suggests fewer remote openings outside Australia ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). This is an inference, not a confirmed policy.
- **Deals:** No acquisition in the window appears in the sources. Tracxn lists seven 2026 acquisitions, the latest being Ortto in April, which is outside the window ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY)).

### Items Outside the 30-Day Window (Context Only)

| Item | Date | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Growth forecast cut from 30% to 20%, citing AI feature costs | August 2026 | [employerbranding.news (n.d.)](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle) |
| Ortto acquisition | April 2026 | [Canva Newsroom (2026)](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/simtheory-ortto-join-canva) |
| Ten of 12 technical writers cut | 2025 | [employerbranding.news (n.d.)](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle) |

## Assessment

**Verified:** The restructure is confirmed, the 1,271 figure is confirmed as "affected roles," and the severance floor is reported consistently across sources.

**Inference:** The cuts appear driven by coordination costs and AI compute costs rather than automation replacing workers. The August forecast cut was linked to AI feature costs ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)). Canva's memo blames structure, not automation ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). CTO Magazine cautions against equating the layoffs with AI substitution ([Gomes, 2026](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand)). I judge the structural explanation credible, but it cannot be fully verified until the split between redundancies, role changes and relocations is disclosed.

## Data Gaps and Discrepancies

- **Headcount:** Canva has not said how many will leave ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). No country split has been published ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).
- **Valuation:** Reporting cites US$34.9 billion after a 17% cut ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)), while Forbes Australia implies about US$30.4 billion ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)). The dates and methods differ.
- **Revenue:** A US$4 billion ARR figure (February) and an annualised ~US$3.69 billion figure (October) use different measures ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)).
- **"First mass layoff":** One HR source calls this Canva's first mass layoff ([amazingworkplaces, 2026](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)), which conflicts with earlier cuts reported elsewhere ([employerbranding.news, n.d.](https://employerbranding.news/canva-layoffs-employer-brand-meta-oracle)).
- **Post-10 November outcomes:** No reporting on the company-wide meeting is available.

**Macro context:** US employers announced 43,994 job cuts in October 2026, down 71% year on year ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). Canva's cuts are therefore unusually large relative to the broader market.

## Three Open Questions

1. **Workforce split:** How do the 1,271 affected roles break down into redundancies, role changes and relocations, and by country?
2. **Operating model:** After the 10 November meeting, what are the scope and reporting lines of the merged product organisation, and will remaining roles outside Sydney remain remote-eligible?
3. **Financial outlook:** Is the 20% growth forecast still current, and what progress has been made on cutting AI cost per task?

# Canva Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Scope:** Developments from roughly 16 October to 15 November 2026, with earlier context where needed
**Reliability note:** Most coverage of the restructure comes from secondary sources. Canva's own memo is quoted second-hand, and Canva has not published headcount exits or a country split. Figures below are reported, not independently verified.

## Executive Summary

Canva announced a restructure on 3 to 4 November 2026 that affects 1,271 roles, about 22% of its workforce. The company describes the change as a response to slowing growth. The package includes a minimum of six months' base pay, extended healthcare, and other support. Sources indicate that the 1,271 figure is not a count of exits, since it includes redundancies, changed roles, and relocation requests ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

In my assessment, the memo's stated rationale is structural (overlapping handovers, management layers, and dispersed teams) and growth-driven. However, the company's August forecast cut and its AI cost problems suggest that AI economics are a material part of the slowdown, even if the memo does not frame it that way. The 30-day window contains no reported hires or acquisitions, so the main subject of this meeting is the restructure and its execution.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### The Restructure Announcement

On 3 November 2026 (US time), CEO and co-founder Melanie Perkins sent staff a memo. It said: "After months of thinking through how to set Canva up for the next chapter, we have made the incredibly hard decision to make significant changes to how we're organised, where some of our teams are based and the roles and skills we need for the future" ([Varley, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life)). The announcement was reported in Sydney time on 4 November ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

Per the memo, three units (Product, Growth, and Platform) will merge into one product organisation. Management layers will be simplified, and more teams will be concentrated in Sydney ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Perkins wrote that "small changes won't be enough" and said Canva needs to "refound Canva" around small teams that own their work end to end ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

### Scale and Terminology

Canva operates in 37 countries and has not published a country split for the cuts ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). Coverage uses several terms for the same figure. Some describes "1,271 employees affected" ([CTO Magazine, 2026](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand)), while others specify roles. Only the "roles" framing is consistent with the memo as quoted. Canva has not said how many people will leave.

### Office Policy

The memo says most hybrid staff will be expected in the office "around two to three days" a week from January, depending on location. Forbes notes Canva previously required hub visits only twice a quarter before dropping even that requirement ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

### Process and Timeline

Affected employees receive an invitation to an optional one-to-one with a senior leader. They keep Slack and Gmail access until the end of that week. A company-wide meeting took place on 10 November, followed by reorganised team meetings from 11 November ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). The sources do not report what was said at those meetings, so this is an open gap for the briefing.

### Severance and Benefits

| Element | Canva (November 2026) | Reference point |
|---|---|---|
| Base pay | At least six months' base pay for all affected staff worldwide ([Quartz/HR Brew, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages)) | 16-week benchmark for major tech firms ([Quartz/HR Brew, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages)) |
| Healthcare | Up to 12 months where Canva already provides coverage ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)) | Block's February round named six months ([Quartz/HR Brew, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages)) |
| Equipment | Staff may keep company MacBooks ([Quartz/HR Brew, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages)) | Not reported for other firms |
| Other support | Career coaching, a year of LinkedIn Premium, a year of Canva Care for families, and optional US$10,000 grants ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)) | Not reported for other firms |
| Vesting | One-year vesting cliff removed ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs); [Amazing Workplaces, n.d.](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)) | Quartz/HR Brew notes that unvested equity treatment is often unreported ([Quartz/HR Brew, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages)) |

Quartz/HR Brew treats the six-month floor, the MacBook decision, and the $10,000 grants as outliers against the 16-week benchmark ([Quartz/HR Brew, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages)). Niehues calculates that the six-month minimum exceeds the technology-sector average, though this is a consultant's estimate ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

### Market Context (October 2026)

Challenger, Gray and Christmas reported that US employers announced 43,994 job cuts in October 2026. That is 71% lower than October 2025 and the lowest October since 2023 ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). Canva's cuts therefore stand out against a low-layoff backdrop.

### Product Launches

Canva released Craft in October 2026, described as its first in-house image generation model, designed to lower the cost of serving AI features ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). A discrepancy needs checking: Wikipedia cites a TechCrunch article dated 30 October 2025 on Canva launching its own design model ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva)). The Craft release date should be confirmed before it is used in the meeting.

### Hires and Deals

The supplied material reports **no new hires or executive appointments** and **no acquisitions or deals** within the last 30 days. The most recent acquisitions cited are startups working on animation and marketing, reported on 24 February 2026 ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva)). Any claims about hiring should be checked against Canva's careers page, which Final Round AI advises checking before applying ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

## Background: Earlier 2026 Developments

| Date | Event | Source |
|---|---|---|
| March 2025 | Canva made 10 of 12 technical writers redundant | [Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| April 2026 | Canva AI 2.0 launched, described as the most significant product change since 2013 | [Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| May 2026 | Reported $800,000 fine for late lodgement of financial reports | [Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva) |
| August 2026 | 2026 revenue growth forecast cut from 30% to 20%, linked to slowed AI rollouts and computing costs | [Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva); [Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| Undated | Shareholders Blackbird and Airtree reportedly cut Canva's valuation 17% to US$34.9 billion from a US$42 billion peak | [Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |

Wikipedia reports that the cost per AI task fell by nearly 90% after Canva AI 2.0 was introduced, and that Canva slowed AI rollouts while rebuilding its underlying architecture ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva)). The company reported US$3.5 billion in revenue for the previous year and says it is profitable on a free cash flow basis, according to The Register as cited by Niehues ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

## Analysis

### Why the Restructure Happened

Three explanations appear in the coverage:

1. **Growth deceleration.** Perkins says growth slowed for the first time in a decade ([Silicon Republic, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life)).
2. **Organisational friction.** Niehues argues the target is handovers between Product, Growth, and Platform, which required agreement at every step ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).
3. **AI cost pressure.** CTO Magazine lists rising costs of building an AI platform among three pressures ([CTO Magazine, 2026](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand)).

My view is that the first two explanations are best supported by primary-sourced quotes. The third is plausible given the August forecast cut and the AI cost reporting, but the memo itself does not make that link. I would not present the restructure as primarily AI-driven, and I would not present it as unrelated to AI economics.

### Reliability of Sources

Final Round AI is a career-coaching vendor that sells an interview tool, and its articles carry promotional content. I have used its factual reporting but not its advice. Amazing Workplaces and Final Round AI are both secondary. The strongest sources in this briefing are Silicon Republic (a news outlet), Quartz/HR Brew (benchmark data), and Niehues (a consultant with a detailed reading of the memo). The Wikipedia entry is useful for chronology but should be cross-checked against original reporting.

### Risks and Opportunities for the Relationship

- **Risk:** Recruiting and employer brand. Affected staff will talk publicly, and Amazing Workplaces notes that the package was widely covered within a day ([Amazing Workplaces, n.d.](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)).
- **Risk:** Remote and international roles. With product teams concentrating in Sydney, fewer remote openings outside Australia may follow ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). This is an inference from a vendor source, not a company statement.
- **Opportunity:** The severance package is generous by benchmark standards, which may limit legal and reputational friction ([Quartz/HR Brew, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages)).

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Of the 1,271 roles, how many will be redundancies, changed roles, or relocations, and how many fall outside Australia?** Canva has not published a country split or an exit count ([Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).
2. **What targets will the merged product organisation be measured against, given the cut to 20% growth and the AI cost reductions reported so far?** The memo ties the restructure to growth, but the forecast and AI cost data suggest the targets are not yet public ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva)).
3. **How will the equity treatment of affected staff be handled, and what is the hiring plan for Sydney and other hubs in 2027?** Reporting on unvested equity is inconsistent across sources, and the hiring plan has not been disclosed ([Quartz/HR Brew, n.d.](https://qz.com/tech-layoff-severance-packages); [Final Round AI, n.d.](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

Chris G | VC + Startups on Instagram: "Canva’s 2026 layoffs have a plot twist: the company is helping its former employees become entrepreneurs.

Imagine getting laid off and your employer offers to help fund your next startup. That’s essentially what Canva is doing.

CEO Melanie Perkins announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, or 22% of the workforce. Not all are being laid off; some face role changes or relocation.

But look at the exit package:

→ At least 6 months of salary
→ 12 months of healthcare where available
→ Employees keep their MacBooks
→ $10,000 startup grants through the Canva Collective Fund, with no equity taken
→ Career coaching and LinkedIn Premium

Now here’s what investors should actually pay attention to.

Canva lowered its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% as AI costs put pressure on its business model.

Meanwhile, Product, Growth, and Platform are being consolidated into one organization.

Translation: AI isn’t just changing what software companies sell. It’s changing the cost of delivering their products and how teams need to operate.

And here’s the overlooked opportunity: Canva’s departing talent could become the next generation of startup founders.

Losing your job is never easy. But giving employees financial runway, healthcare, and a chance to build something new is a much better exit than simply handing them a severance check.

The lesson for founders? How you treat employees on the way out says a lot about how you build a company.

Would you rather have six months of severance or a shot at funding your own startup?

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Window:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources below are dated 2–10 November 2026 unless noted.

**Summary:** Canva has cut about 22% of its workforce (1,271 people) in a restructure it describes as a "re-founding." It is also expanding its OpenAI partnership. Reports disagree on whether further cuts or a hiring freeze are coming.

## What changed

**Restructuring and job cuts**
- Canva announced a restructure affecting 22% of its global workforce. The CEO said "small changes won't be enough" and that the company needs to "re-found Canva" around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- 1,271 employees, over one-fifth of staff, are losing their jobs. The company is flattening its org chart and consolidating teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html).
- Product, growth and platform teams are being merged. Canva also aims to reduce "subspecialisation," so remaining staff may take on broader roles (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- Capital Brief reported previously unreported finance-division cuts of 32 roles in January (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

**Severance**
- Departing staff receive at least six months' salary plus other support (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- The package includes keeping company MacBooks, a free year of LinkedIn Premium and career coaching (https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- A new fund offers US$10,000 grants to departing staff who want to start a business or community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).

**Hiring outlook (conflicting reports)**
- Canva reportedly weighs further redundancies or a hiring freeze in November, tied to a revised revenue growth outlook. Canva has not confirmed either (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).

**AI and deals**
- Canva expanded its OpenAI partnership, gaining broader access to GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6. The companies will work on making these models cheaper to run, though no savings or costs were disclosed. The deal came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- OpenAI already powers Canva Code, which builds interactive designs, websites and apps from text descriptions (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

**Marketing**
- Canva unveiled a North America brand campaign, "What Will You Canva Today?", from new agency GS&P (Goodby's first work for the account). The first TV spot aired during NBC Sunday Night Football on 1 November (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

**Hires**
- No hiring announcements were found in the sources.

**Background (outside window)**
- Canva's acquisitions listed in a company profile (Ortto, SimTheory, Doohly at US$30M, Scene Group, MangoAI) are dated February to April 2026 (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp). The profile is undated, so treat it as background only.

## Open questions

1. Will the November redundancies or hiring freeze reported by Capital Brief go ahead, and which teams are affected? (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)
2. What savings or cost targets sit behind the expanded OpenAI deal, and how will they affect pricing or the roadmap for Canva Code? (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model)
3. With product, growth and platform teams merging, who now owns decisions and partnerships on our side, and what is the revised revenue growth outlook behind the restructure? (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html)

# Razorpay Pre-Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Executive Summary

This briefing covers the 30-day window from 16 October to 15 November 2026, ahead of the 17 November 2026 meeting. The evidence for that window is thin. The only company-issued announcement I could verify as dated inside it is the **final IFSCA licence for GIFT City**, announced on 3 November 2026 ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). I found no verified hires, acquisitions, or new funding rounds inside the window.

The more substantial news is older. The AI-first push, including the **Vulcan** payments model, **Agent Studio**, and conversational banking products, was launched between May and September 2026 ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). Four senior engineering hires were announced on 4 August 2026 ([Abrar, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)). Both fall outside the requested window and are presented here as context.

**Assessment:** Razorpay's AI strategy is consistent and sustained across at least six months of launches. The 30-day signal is weaker than the launch cadence suggests, and the key unknown is commercial traction, which the public sources do not quantify.

## Scope, Method, and Source Reliability

Sources were ranked by reliability. Company newsroom and event pages were used for product and licence claims. Business Standard and The Paypers were used for hires and IPO reporting. Aggregators (Inc42, Tracxn) were used for deal and funding data, with discrepancies flagged. YouTube titles and undated pages were treated as unverified unless corroborated.

### Evidence Status Table

| Item | Date Stated | Source Type | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Final IFSCA licence for GIFT City | 3 Nov 2026 | Company newsroom | Verified (summary truncated) |
| Razorpay–OpenAI ChatGPT Ads partnership | 5 Oct 2026 | Company newsroom / Tracxn | Verified, but outside window |
| Four senior engineering hires | 4 Aug 2026 | Business Standard | Verified, outside window |
| Vulcan AI payments model | 18 Aug 2026 | Company newsroom | Verified; internal data figures conflict |
| IPO preparation (USD 500m) | 12 Jan 2026 | The Paypers | Reported, preliminary |
| "Razorpay IPO" stock-market video | 5 Nov 2026 (title only) | YouTube | Unverified; content not accessible |
| COO briefing on "Netbanking 2.0" and "Agentic Commerce" | Undated | YouTube | Unverified; date and content not accessible |
| Inc42 employee count and web traffic | Undated snapshot | Inc42 | Unverified timing |

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days (16 October – 15 November 2026)

### Verified Developments

**1. Final IFSCA licence for GIFT City (3 November 2026).** Razorpay's newsroom lists a release dated 3 November 2026 announcing that it has received its final IFSCA licence for GIFT City. The stated purpose is to power cross-border money movement. The listing says the capability brings "global investing, international collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities under a single" offering, but the summary is truncated, so the full scope, effective date, and permitted activities cannot be confirmed ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).

**2. No verified hires, acquisitions, or funding in the window.** Tracxn's acquisitions page, last updated 1 November 2026, reports zero acquisitions in the current calendar year. Its most recent acquisition is PoshVine, in September 2022 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)). Inc42 records the last funding round as a secondary transaction on 9 May 2022 ([Inc42, n.d.-b](https://inc42.com/company/razorpay/funding)).

**3. Unverified IPO-related content (5 November 2026).** A YouTube market-news video dated 5 November 2026 carries "Razorpay IPO" in its title. I could not access its content, so it cannot be used as evidence of an IPO filing, timeline, or bank mandate ([YouTube, 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ciyZPf6NbMI)).

### Items Adjacent to the Window

The **Razorpay–OpenAI partnership to expand ChatGPT Ads in India** was announced on 5 October 2026, 11 days before the window opens. Razorpay Engage is intended to let local brands run and track campaigns ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom); [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)). Tracxn also lists an Entrackr report dated 5 October 2026 that names Razorpay, OpenAI, and Grab ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)).

## Context: Developments Before the Window

### AI Product Push (May–September 2026)

| Date | Launch | Key Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 May 2026 | Apuarv Sethi elevated to CMO | Brand and business momentum across India and SEA | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom) |
| 27 May 2026 | Payment Command Line Interface | Built for developers and AI agents | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom) |
| June 2026 (last updated 15 Jun) | Agent Studio at FTX'26 | Built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK; B2B agent marketplace | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-launches-the-worlds-first-ai-native-agent-studio-for-payments-at-ftx26-powered-by-anthropics-claude) |
| 18 Aug 2026 | Vulcan AI payments foundation model | Built with NVIDIA and AWS | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom) |
| 2 Sep 2026 | RAY conversational AI account manager on WhatsApp | Developed with IndusInd Bank; Bajaj Finance among first live users | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom) |
| 7 Sep 2026 | Banking Connect and multi-currency account | Live with SBI and HDFC; for exporters | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom) |
| 30 Sep 2026 | Apple Pay online and in-store | Live with thousands of businesses, including Zepto | [Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom) |

At FTX 2026, the company described four launches: an Agentic Platform, Agentic Payments, Agent Studio, and Agentic Business Banking ([Razorpay, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/razorpay_keynote-reimagining-money-movement-activity-7437771494610411520-QuVn)). Agent Studio's initial agents include an Abandoned Cart Conversion Agent, with Nugget by Zomato and SuperU as named partners, and a Dispute Responder Agent ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-launches-the-worlds-first-ai-native-agent-studio-for-payments-at-ftx26-powered-by-anthropics-claude)).

### Leadership and Hiring

On 4 August 2026, Razorpay announced it was hiring four senior engineering executives from Microsoft, Salesforce, Cred, and Divyam.ai to help deploy AI at scale. The company framed the hires as part of a strategy to become an "AI-first platform" ([Abrar, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)). CTO and co-founder Shashank Kumar said the company requires "a fundamentally different engineering organisation" combining AI expertise, large-scale engineering experience, and product thinking ([Abrar, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)). The individual executives' names and roles were not included in the sources provided, so they are not stated here.

Razorpay's GFF 2026 materials list Rahul Kothari (COO), Khilan Haria (Chief Product Officer), and Kevin Lee (CEO and Country Head, Razorpay Curlec) as speakers ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/m/gff2026)). Prabu Ram is listed as SVP, Engineering ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)).

### Partnerships

Tracxn lists a series of 2026 partnerships: NPCI and Razorpay bringing agentic payments to Claude (February), an AI Agent Studio launch (March), a Sarvam partnership for voice-first commerce (March), a DPIIT startup-ecosystem partnership (March), a RateGain partnership for RG Pay (April), a Fynd partnership for omnichannel commerce (June), and a BiteSpeed partnership for D2C conversion (June) ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)). These items come from an aggregator and were not checked against primary releases.

### Capital Markets and IPO Preparation

The Paypers reported in January 2026 that Razorpay had begun preliminary IPO preparations, possibly raising USD 500 million in fresh capital, with Kotak Mahindra Capital and Axis Capital as leading contenders for underwriting. It also said a listing could come toward the end of 2026, subject to market conditions and regulatory approvals ([Pincovski, 2026](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge)). The same report says Razorpay completed its reverse flip to India in May 2025 and incurred a tax outgo of roughly USD 150 million ([Pincovski, 2026](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge)).

An undated Economic Times item reports bank appointments for an IPO and gives a valuation of USD 7.5 billion ([Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). Its timing is inconsistent with the other reports, so it is treated as older reporting.

## Company Snapshot

| Metric | Reported Figure | Source | Caveat |
|---|---|---|---|
| Total funding | USD 816.62m+ | [Inc42, n.d.-b](https://inc42.com/company/razorpay/funding) | Aggregator |
| Last funding event | Secondary, 9 May 2022, USD 75m | [Inc42, n.d.-b](https://inc42.com/company/razorpay/funding) | Older |
| Acquisitions | 7 (Tracxn) vs. 8 (Inc42) | [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI); [Inc42, n.d.-a](https://inc42.com/company/razorpay/acquisitions) | Counts conflict |
| Employees | 4,038 | [Inc42, n.d.-a](https://inc42.com/company/razorpay/acquisitions) | Undated |
| FY25 revenue | ₹187.3 Cr+ (Inc42) vs. "USD 419.577" (The Paypers) | [Inc42, n.d.-a](https://inc42.com/company/razorpay/acquisitions); [Pincovski, 2026](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge) | Units and figures conflict |
| FY25 growth | 65% YoY, with net loss | [Pincovski, 2026](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge) | Net loss attributed to ESOP expenses and restructuring |
| Glassdoor rating | 3.30 (1,342 reviews) | [Inc42, n.d.-a](https://inc42.com/company/razorpay/acquisitions) | Undated |
| Web traffic (30-day change) | 37.23m; −8.74% | [Inc42, n.d.-a](https://inc42.com/company/razorpay/acquisitions) | Undated |

Two data points need reconciliation before the meeting. The Vulcan launch headline cites training on "4Bn transactions," while the body describes "nearly 3 trillion data points" ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). The FY25 revenue figures from Inc42 and The Paypers differ by an order of magnitude or more, and The Paypers does not state a currency unit.

## Analysis and Assessment

**The AI strategy is a sustained operating commitment, not a single announcement.** Between May and September 2026, Razorpay issued product launches across agentic onboarding, payments, banking, and developer tooling. The August engineering hires add organisational weight to that direction. I view the strategy as credible in its breadth, but the public record contains almost no adoption metrics. Named partners such as Zomato, Swiggy, Bajaj Finance, and SBI are mentioned, but the sources do not quantify transaction volumes, revenue from agentic products, or merchant uptake.

**The 30-day signal is weak, and that matters for the meeting.** The GIFT City licence is the only verified company announcement in the window. This suggests the company's near-term focus may be regulatory and international infrastructure rather than new consumer-facing launches. It also means the meeting should not assume a steady stream of recent news to discuss.

**Capital markets activity is the largest open variable.** The IPO reports from January and the undated item that cites bank mandates are consistent with a listing being prepared, but the November video title is the only item dated in the window, and its content cannot be verified. The stated plan for a listing around the end of 2026 has not been confirmed by any verified filing in the sources provided.

**Financial disclosure is inconsistent across sources.** Razorpay's public FY25 revenue figures differ between aggregators. This is not unusual for a company in IPO preparation, but it limits how confidently the company's scale and growth can be described.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **What is the current IPO timeline and status?** Have any draft offer documents been filed, and do the company's FY25 revenue and FY26 year-to-date figures reconcile with the USD 419.577 and ₹187.3 Cr+ figures currently in circulation?

2. **What is the scope and rollout plan for the GIFT City IFSCA licence?** Which cross-border products will launch first, which markets are in scope, and what is the expected revenue or volume contribution in the next 12 months?

3. **How is AI product traction being measured?** What adoption, transaction, or revenue metrics are tracked for Agent Studio, Vulcan, and RAY, and what data underpins Vulcan's training claims (4 billion transactions versus nearly 3 trillion data points)?

runs.briefing:
# Pre-meeting briefing: Razorpay, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Sources dated roughly 17 October to 17 November 2026, plus one undated company profile. Every fact is cited to the URL it came from.

## What changed in the last 30 days

**IPO approval (main development)**
- Razorpay received market regulator approval for its IPO, according to a SEBI document shown on Friday, 13 November 2026 (https://www.thehindu.com/business/indian-fintech-firm-razorpay-gets-regulatory-nod-for-ipo/article71698143.ece).
- SEBI issued its final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November, which clears the company to proceed to the next listing stages (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms). Inc42 reported the SEBI nod on 4 November (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo). Note that the sources differ on the date: The Hindu and ET's second report tie the approval to 13 November (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/razorpay-sembcorp-green-infra-get-sebi-nod-to-float-ipos/articleshow/135803228.cms). Confirm the date before quoting it.
- Shareholders approved a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 2,700 crore, plus an offer for sale (OFS) that lets existing investors partly sell their holdings (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).
- Axis Capital, JPMorgan, Citi and Kotak Mahindra Capital are advising on the offering (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).
- The draft papers were filed confidentially in June, for an IPO reportedly sized at around $600 million (https://www.thehindu.com/business/indian-fintech-firm-razorpay-gets-regulatory-nod-for-ipo/article71698143.ece).
- Earlier estimates put the raise at ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 crore, with final price band and structure pending the RHP filing (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ip-os-mahanadi-coalfields-oyo-cult-fit-carlsberg-india-are-among-big-ticket-ip-os-expected-after-jio-platforms-listing/article-202719, 30 October 2026).

**Regulatory licence (deal/expansion)**
- Razorpay received a final licence to expand cross-border payments from GIFT City (headline only, in a Business Standard page dated 9 November 2026) (https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/ifsca-proposes-model-portfolios-in-gift-city-by-research-entities-126110900766_1.html). I could not find the article body, so details are unverified.

**Hires and launches:** No hires or product launches were found in the sources provided.

## Company baseline (undated)
- Headquarters: Bangalore; B2B SaaS; privately held as of the profile (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7).
- Headcount listed at 4,033, down 23 over the quarter and down 16 over the year (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7). This profile is undated, so treat the trend as indicative.

## Open questions
1. With the approval in hand, what are the final issue size, the split between the fresh issue (Rs 2,700 crore) and the OFS, and the expected price band, given earlier estimates of ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 crore?
2. What is the timeline from here to the RHP filing and listing, and are there any remaining SEBI conditions we should track?
3. Which cross-border corridors does the GIFT City licence cover, and when do you expect to launch them?
