# Razorpay: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Look-back window: 16 October to 15 November 2026. Items outside the window are labelled as prior context.*

## Executive Summary

- **Most material change:** Razorpay received a final IFSCA licence for GIFT City on 2 to 3 November 2026 ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)), and reportedly received SEBI approval for a ₹6,000 crore IPO on 4 November ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)).
- **Capital markets:** IPO coverage is moving from rumour to regulatory progress, but offer-size figures differ across sources and have not been reconciled ([The Paypers, n.d.](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge)).
- **AI strategy:** The company continues to position itself as an "AI-native" platform. The most recent verified senior hires, four engineering executives, were announced on 4 August 2026, outside the window ([Abrar, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)).
- **Verification gap:** No executive hires or new partnerships dated within the 30-day window could be verified from the materials provided.

## Changes in the Last 30 Days

### Regulatory and Corporate Finance

Razorpay announced that it had received its final IFSCA licence to operate from GIFT City, which is intended to support cross-border money movement ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). A third-party LinkedIn commentary states the licence enables investment platforms to fund non-resident overseas investments, and that Razorpay already held an RBI licence from December 2025 for trade payments ([Aggarwal, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/pranay-aggarwal-_razorpay-already-moved-money-across-borders-activity-7525780603510738944-HLBe)). The same post cites RBI data that remittances for overseas shares and bonds rose 56% to $2.65 billion in FY26, from about $1.70 billion in FY25 ([Aggarwal, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/pranay-aggarwal-_razorpay-already-moved-money-across-borders-activity-7525780603510738944-HLBe)). **These figures are unverified against primary RBI sources and should be treated as indicative only.**

The Razorpay newsroom also listed a 3 November 2026 release describing a platform bringing "global investing, international collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities under a single" offering. The headline is truncated in the source, so the full details could not be verified ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).

### IPO Progress

Tracxn lists a 4 November 2026 headline, "Razorpay Gets SEBI Nod For ₹6,000 Cr IPO," sourced to Inc42. The full article was not accessible, so this is recorded as a headline-level report ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)). A separate report describes a rumoured USD 500 million IPO, placing Razorpay among new-age Indian firms, including PhonePe, Zepto, Oyo and Infra.Market, preparing to list over the next 12 to 18 months ([The Paypers, n.d.](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge)). A YouTube market update dated 5 November 2026 also references a "Razorpay IPO," but its content could not be reviewed ([YouTube, 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ciyZPf6NbMI)).

### Product and AI Launches

| Item | Date | Status in Window | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Razorpay Sprint 2026 (100+ updates across six verticals, including Agentic Stack, Payments on LLMs, Voice Payments, Ray Customer Support, and Razorpay Dashboard on Claude) | Event date not stated; design write-up published 12 Nov 2026 | Likely in window, date unverified | [Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26); [Awwwards, 2026](https://www.awwwards.com/razorpay-sprint26-the-future-of-payments.html) |
| Razorpay at GFF 2026, "next generation of AI-powered banking" | Undated | Unverified | [Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/m/gff2026) |
| COO commentary on "Netbanking 2.0" and "Agentic Commerce" | Undated | Unverified | [YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ia5i2GZHlFc) |

Sprint is described as an annual product launch event ([Awwwards, 2026](https://www.awwwards.com/razorpay-sprint26-the-future-of-payments.html)). The Sprint page's product list is broad, but commercial adoption metrics for individual products were not provided ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)).

### Executive and Key Hires

No executive hire dated 16 October to 15 November 2026 could be verified. The most recent verified engineering hiring round was announced on 4 August 2026. Razorpay said the four hires from Microsoft, Salesforce, Cred and Divyam.ai would help deploy AI across products and operations in India ([Abrar, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)). CTO and co-founder Shashank Kumar said the company needs "a fundamentally different engineering organisation" to build AI-native financial infrastructure ([Abrar, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)).

### Deals and Partnerships

No new partnership was verified within the window. The GIFT City licence is regulatory rather than commercial. The partnerships below are outside the window and are included for context.

The SEBI item is headline-only. | [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI); [The Paypers, n.d.](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge) |
| Valuation ($7.5 billion) and IPO timing | Economic Times coverage is undated. It refers to an IPO "towards the middle of this year," which may be stale. | [Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr) |
| IFSCA licence date | Newsroom gives 3 Nov; Tracxn gives 2 Nov; third-party commentary gives 2 Nov. | [Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/newsroom); [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI) |
| $375 million raise and international expansion | Article appears to be from around 2021 (references turning seven "in mid-December"). Excluded from analysis as stale. | [FinTech Futures, n.d.](https://www.fintechfutures.com/cross-border-payments/indian-paytech-razorpay-raises-375m-plans-international-expansion) |
| Remittance statistics (56% growth to $2.65 billion) | Sourced from a third-party LinkedIn post; not verified against RBI data. | [Aggarwal, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/pranay-aggarwal-_razorpay-already-moved-money-across-borders-activity-7525780603510738944-HLBe) |
| Sprint 2026 event date | Not stated in the materials. | [Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26) |
| Truncated 3 November global-investing release | Headline incomplete. | [Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/newsroom) |

## Analyst View

### Assessment

In my view, the most consequential development is Razorpay's move toward regulated cross-border and investment-funding infrastructure, combined with IPO progress. The GIFT City licence extends Razorpay beyond merchant payments into a category that previously required separate licensing ([Aggarwal, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/pranay-aggarwal-_razorpay-already-moved-money-across-borders-activity-7525780603510738944-HLBe)). This is a more defensible growth path than purely competing on transaction pricing, and it fits the company's stated aim of building "AI-native financial infrastructure" ([Abrar, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)).

The AI narrative is strategically coherent. The August engineering hires, the Vulcan model, and the Sprint 2026 agentic products form a consistent story ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/newsroom); [Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)). However, the sources provided show product breadth without commercial evidence. I found no adoption figures, revenue attribution, or pricing for the agentic products. Until those are disclosed, I would treat the AI push as credible strategy but unproven as a revenue driver.

### Key Risks

- **Execution risk:** More than 100 launches in one event may dilute focus. No adoption metrics were published.
- **IPO risk:** Conflicting size and timing reports suggest the listing plan is still evolving.
- **Regulatory dependency:** Cross-border growth depends on RBI and IFSCA frameworks that could shift.
- **Information risk:** Several key claims rest on headlines, undated pages, or third-party commentary.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **IPO:** What is the target offer size, timing, and valuation range following SEBI's reported approval, and how do you reconcile the ₹6,000 crore figure with the reported USD 500 million?
2. **GIFT City and cross-border:** Which investment platforms or partners are live or in onboarding under the new licence, and what share of revenue do you expect from cross-border investing and international collections within the next 12 months?
3. **Agentic products:** What adoption, transaction volume, or merchant uptake metrics can you share for Vulcan, the agentic stack, and Ray, and how are these products priced and monetised?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Razorpay
**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Scope:** Last 30 days, based only on the search results provided

## Snapshot
Razorpay, a Bengaluru-based (Bangalore HQ per one profile) B2B SaaS company, is moving toward a public listing. Its IPO has regulatory clearance, and it has a new cross-border licence from GIFT City.

## What changed

**IPO and regulatory approval**
- Razorpay received the market regulator's approval for its IPO, according to an SEBI document shown on Friday, 13 November 2026. The company had confidentially filed draft papers in June for an IPO of about $600 million. (https://www.thehindu.com/business/indian-fintech-firm-razorpay-gets-regulatory-nod-for-ipo/article71698143.ece)
- SEBI issued its final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November. This clears the way for the next stages of the listing. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Razorpay's shareholders approved a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 2,700 crore, plus an offer for sale (OFS) that lets existing investors partly sell their holdings. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Axis Capital, JPMorgan, Citi and Kotak Mahindra Capital are advising on the offering. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Inc42 reported the SEBI nod for an IPO of ₹6,000 crore. (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo)
- Earlier coverage expected the company to raise ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 crore through a fresh issue plus OFS. This coverage predates the approval and says the price band was still to come. (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ip-os-mahanadi-coalfields-oyo-cult-fit-carlsberg-india-are-among-big-ticket-ip-os-expected-after-jio-platforms-listing/article-202719)

**Licensing and deals**
- Razorpay received a final licence to expand cross-border payments from GIFT City. The source is a Business Standard headline index; the full article was not in the results. (https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/ifsca-proposes-model-portfolios-in-gift-city-by-research-entities-126110900766_1.html)

**Headcount (undated source)**
- Headcount is listed at 4,033, down 16 (-0.4%) over the year and down 23 over the quarter. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7)

**Hires and product launches:** No results found in the last 30 days. I could not find sources for these.

## Source gaps and conflicts
- **Approval date:** The Hindu reports the approval as shown on 13 November. ET reports SEBI's final observations as issued on 3 November. Confirm which date is correct before citing it externally.
- **IPO size:** Estimates range from ₹5,000–6,000 crore (Upstox) to ₹6,000 crore (Inc42). The ET excerpt cuts off before the target figure.
- **Headcount:** The profile page is undated, so it may not reflect the last 30 days.

## Open questions
1. Following SEBI's observations, what is the expected timeline for the red herring prospectus, price band and listing date, and how much of the issue will be fresh capital versus OFS?
2. How will the GIFT City cross-border licence change the international payments business, and what will it need in terms of hiring or infrastructure?
3. Headcount has declined slightly over the past year. What is the current hiring plan, and does it change in the lead-up to listing?

runs.briefing:
# Infosys Pre-Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Executive Summary

Infosys enters the 17 November 2026 meeting after a 30-day window (16 October to 15 November 2026) dominated by its Q2 FY27 results and a narrowed full-year revenue guidance. Revenue growth guidance was cut to 1% to 2% constant currency from 1.5% to 3% ([Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)). Underlying operating indicators were mixed: AI revenue accelerated, large-deal bookings were strong, but volume and pricing remained under pressure ([Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756); [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)). Shareholder-related events, including an interim dividend and a record date, were routine.

**My assessment:** The guidance cut should be read less as a demand collapse and more as a deliberate trade-off. Management is prioritising contract economics over volume, and it is explicitly absorbing AI-driven productivity deflation. The central question for the meeting is whether AI is becoming additive to revenue growth or mainly a source of price compression. The evidence so far supports both interpretations, and the company's own commentary does not resolve the question.

## Scope, Sources, and Verification Approach

The briefing covers the window of 16 October to 15 November 2026. Sources were ranked by reliability. Company-issued materials (the PR Newswire release and the earnings-call transcript) and established financial media (Investing.com, Briefs, and Livemint) were weighted above secondary commentary (LinkedIn posts, aggregators, and video titles). Where secondary sources conflict, this is flagged. Items outside the window or without a verifiable date are listed separately in the final section.

## Key Changes in the Last 30 Days

### Financial Performance and Guidance

The headline change was the revised FY2027 guidance. For the year ending March 2027, Infosys now guides to 1% to 2% constant-currency growth, down from 1.5% to 3% in July. The new range lags the 2.03% analyst consensus and pushed Infosys ADRs down as much as 7.6% in early New York trading on 23 October ([Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)).

The Q2 FY27 headline metrics are summarised below.

| Metric | Reported Figure | Source | Reliability Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q2 constant-currency revenue growth | 1.5% YoY; 1.2% QoQ | [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23) | Aggregator; consistent with analyst commentary |
| Operating margin | 21% | [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23); [InsiderFinance, 2026](https://www.insiderfinance.io/news/infosys-q2-results-ai-up-guidance-cut) | Two sources agree |
| Operating margin guidance | 20% to 22% (unchanged) | [Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl) | Individual commentary |
| Free cash flow | $922M (BigGo) or $928M (LinkedIn), down 15.7% YoY | [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23); [Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl) | Sources conflict; verify against the filing |
| Net profit | ₹7,823 crore, up about 6% YoY | [Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl) | Individual commentary |
| Revenue | ₹49,244 crore, up about 11% YoY (rupee terms); $5.145B | [Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl) | Rupee growth is not comparable to constant-currency growth |
| Cash yield | Approximately 6.9% | [Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756) | Company call |
| DSO | 64 days, down 7 days YoY | [Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756) | Company call |
| Effective tax rate (FY) | 29% to 30% | [Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756) | Company call |

Management attributed the guidance reduction to several factors. The CFO stated that "our Q2 has been softer, and our volume continues to remain softer," and cited pricing pressure from competitive intensity and higher client demands for productivity ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)). The CFO also said that offshoring changes and a decision not to pursue a large European manufacturing deal that did not meet return expectations together reduced growth guidance by about 2% ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)). The company also flagged lower working days in H2 as an impact ([Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756)).

Analysts pressed on the guidance, with one noting that the full-year outlook was the weakest in seven years and the slowest growth pace in at least three years ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)).

### Deals and AI Monetisation

Large-deal bookings in Q2 totalled $5.2 billion, including a net-new mega deal worth more than $2.0 billion over seven years and a $1 billion renewal ([InsiderFinance, 2026](https://www.insiderfinance.io/news/infosys-q2-results-ai-up-guidance-cut); [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)). One secondary source reports that 62% of the pipeline was net-new business ([Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl)). Analysts noted that the mega-deal ramp-up will not begin until the latter part of the fiscal year ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)).

AI revenue rose 29% sequentially and represented 10.5% of total revenue, up from 8.2% in the prior quarter ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23); [InsiderFinance, 2026](https://www.insiderfinance.io/news/infosys-q2-results-ai-up-guidance-cut)). CEO Salil Parekh stated that AI is "giving us the growth" while also "seeing the compression" from competitive intensity, and that almost all deals of $50 million or more now include AI ([Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)). On the call, he described AI-related services as a secular opportunity, in contrast to the finite nature of a particular large deal ([Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756)). He cited a $300 billion addressable market for AI services ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)).

### Shareholder Returns and Workforce

Infosys declared an interim dividend of ₹26 per share for FY27, up from ₹23 in the prior year. The record date was 3 November 2026, and payment was scheduled for 11 November 2026 ([Sethi, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/infosys-dividend-2026-record-date-tomorrow-know-dividend-payout-yield-history-returns-11793585489373.html)). Payment status on 11 November is not confirmed in the materials reviewed.

Shares had declined 27.29% year-to-date and 20.06% over the past year as of early November ([Sethi, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/infosys-dividend-2026-record-date-tomorrow-know-dividend-payout-yield-history-returns-11793585489373.html)).

On headcount, net headcount rose by about 4,400 in H1. The company hired about 13,000 freshers in H1 against an FY2027 target of about 20,000. Attrition fell to 12.7% from 13.0% sequentially. Utilisation was 85.4% including trainees, but 81.9% excluding trainees, reflecting fresher intake ([Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756)). Compensation increases took effect 26 October, with a second phase scheduled for 27 January 2027 ([Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756)).

### Partnerships and Launches

Infosys announced a strategic collaboration with Columbia University focused on deep research and business value. The release itself was retrieved without a verifiable publication date, so its timing relative to the window cannot be confirmed ([Infosys, n.d.](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/infosys-and-columbia-university-launch-strategic-collaboration-across-deep-research-to-drive-innovation-and-unlock-business-value-302895969.html)).

### Market and Macro Context

Several market headlines in the same period bear on Infosys's outlook, though they are not company-specific:

- **Demand sentiment in India:** A 14 November headline reported that India's market was recovering as AI enthusiasm cooled and foreign capital returned ([Briefs, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)).
- **AI infrastructure in India:** AirTrunk filed plans for two large data campus projects in Andhra Pradesh, which may support demand for data-centre-related services ([Briefs, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)).
- **Currency and rates:** The dollar rallied to a one-month high as traders increased Fed hike wagers ([Briefs, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)). For an exporter that reports in rupees and dollars, this matters for reported versus constant-currency growth.
- **AI as a systemic risk:** A Fed survey placed AI at the top of financial-system risks ([Briefs, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)).

## Analyst Assessment

Based on the evidence above, my view is as follows.

**1. The guidance cut reflects deliberate selectivity, but it is also a volume problem.** Management's explanation combines discipline (declining a large European manufacturing deal) with structural factors (offshoring and softer volume). The 2% impact attributed to the offshoring change and the European deal is material relative to a 1% to 2% range. Without the deal decision, the revised range would be considerably less conservative. The company has not provided a breakdown of how much of the 2% is recoverable.

**2. AI is currently growing revenue, but its deflationary effect is not yet netted out.** The 29% sequential rise in AI revenue is significant. However, management cited AI-driven productivity deflation as a reason for lower guidance. The company's own language, "giving us the growth" alongside "seeing the compression," indicates that the net effect is still being measured. Until pricing data is disclosed, I would treat AI as a gross growth driver with an uncertain net contribution.

**3. Bookings are strong, but conversion timing is the binding constraint.** The $5.2 billion in large deals is a positive signal of client willingness to commit. However, the mega-deal ramp is not expected to contribute meaningfully until the later part of the year. Revenue growth in H2 will depend on execution and on whether the company can offset weak volume.

**4. The margin and cash profile is a relative strength.** A stable 21% operating margin and a 6.9% cash yield suggest financial flexibility. The decline in free cash flow (reported at 15.7% YoY by one source) should be verified, since the reported figures differ between sources.

**5. Investor sentiment is pricing in a structural concern.** A 27% year-to-date decline in the share price is consistent with a market that views the growth gap as persistent rather than cyclical. Management needs to demonstrate that AI-led revenue can compound faster than pricing pressure.

## Risks and Watch Items

| Risk | Indicator to Monitor | Source Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Continued volume softness | Constant-currency growth in Q3 FY27 relative to the 1% to 2% range | [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23) |
| AI-driven pricing deflation | Revenue per employee and pricing commentary on AI deals | [Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu) |
| Mega-deal ramp delay | Timing of revenue recognition from the $2B+ contract | [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23) |
| Currency volatility | Gap between reported and constant-currency growth | [Briefs, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu) |
| Fresher hiring shortfall | Progress against the 20,000-fresher FY27 target (13,000 hired in H1) | [Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756) |
| Wage cost pressure | Effect of the January 2027 compensation phase on margins | [Investing.com, n.d.](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756) |

## Items Outside the Window or Unverified

The following items were reviewed but cannot be placed inside the 30-day window or could not be verified:

| Item | Issue | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Prior guidance of 1.5% to 3% | Issued in July 2026, before the window; used only as a baseline | [Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu) |
| Acquisitions of Optimum Healthcare ($465M) and Stratus Global ($95M); five acquisitions totalling $800M+ | No publication date in the source; likely outside the window | [CNBC-TV18, n.d.](https://www.facebook.com/cnbctv18india/videos/infosys-announced-2-strategic-acquisitions-optimum-healthcare-for-465m-and-strat/1492229445811071) |

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Summary:** Infosys's second quarter (ended 30 September) showed slower growth, a lower revenue outlook, and weakness in North America, though AI revenue and large deal wins grew. Investor-relations activity and campus expansion continued in late October and early November.

**Financial results and outlook**
- Q2 revenue was $5,145 million, with AI revenue up 29% sequentially to 10.5% of revenue. Reported revenue rose 1.3% year over year, and operating margin was 21.0% (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- Infosys cut its annual revenue growth guidance, and its ADR fell over 7% on 23 October (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/infosys-adr-falls-over-7-as-it-major-lowers-annual-revenue-growth-guidance-everything-investors-need-to-know/article-202325).
- Net profit rose 6.2% to 78.23 billion rupees but missed the 79.29 billion rupee analyst expectation. Deal wins rose to $5.2 billion from $3.1 a year earlier. Weakness among North American hi-tech and retail clients was cited (https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/23/india039s-infosys-beats-second-quarter-revenue-view).
- Shares fell 6.5% on 27 October after Q2 EPS missed estimates by $0.01 (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- BMO Capital raised its price target to $13 and kept a Market Perform rating on 26 October (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- Infosys reported North America revenue decline amid sector slowdowns on 23 October (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).

**Deals and large contracts**
- Large-deal total contract value reached $5.2 billion, 62% of it net new, including one deal above $2 billion (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).

**Hiring and capacity**
- Infosys expanded its Truist GCC in India and onboarded 1,000 colleagues on 19 October (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- A new 1.1 million sq ft block opened at the Pocharam campus in Hyderabad to serve emerging technologies (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/infosys-sets-up-new-1-1m-sq-ft-block-at-pocharam-campus-in-hyderabad-to-cater-to-emerging-technologies/articleshow/135366954.cms).
- A Hyderabad campus expansion was inaugurated on 2 November, attended by Telangana Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka, IT Minister Duddilla Sridhar Babu, and CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka. The facility targets banking, retail, life sciences, and manufacturing clients and includes radiant cooling and rainwater harvesting (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece). Shares slid over 2% that day (same source).
- Infosys employs over 325,000 people across 59 countries (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece).

**Investor relations and other events**
- Management will attend non-deal investor roadshows in London and Edinburgh in November (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- A block trade worth ₹69.49 crore was executed on the NSE on 23 October (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- The Infosys Prize 2026 was announced on 12 November in Bengaluru, with six researchers each receiving $100,000. This is a foundation award, not a company business event (https://news.careers360.com/infosys-prize-2026-scholars-from-tifr-princeton-carnegie-mellon-uc-san-ranscisco-new-south-wales-singapore-universities-winners).

**Background (undated source)**
- Headquarters in Bangalore; founded 1981; IT services and consulting; B2B model (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/Gbd7vUUlzCYP).

**Gaps:** I found no news dated 13–17 November and no product launch announcements. Several items are headlines only, without full text.

**Open questions**
1. What is the outlook for North American demand, and how much of the guidance cut reflects client project scaling-down versus AI-related spending shifts (https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/23/india039s-infosys-beats-second-quarter-revenue-view)?
2. Can AI revenue (10.5% of Q2 revenue) keep growing at the recent pace, and how much of the $5.2 billion deal pipeline is expected to convert to revenue in the next two quarters (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html)?
3. Now that the Hyderabad and Pocharam capacity is in place, what hiring and utilization plans follow, and how will the GCC model (such as the Truist expansion) be scaled (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)?

# Infosys: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Review window: 16 October to 15 November 2026.*

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing covers material developments in the 30 days before the 17 November 2026 meeting, organized under news, product launches, leadership and hiring, and deals and partnerships. Each factual claim is cited. Items that could not be verified, or whose sources conflict, are flagged in the Verification Flags section. Figures from the Q2 FY2027 results (quarter ended September 2026) are the most material items in the window.

## Summary Assessment

The dominant development is Infosys's Q2 FY2027 results on 23 October 2026. The quarter showed strong demand signals alongside a weaker full-year outlook. Large-deal bookings reached $5.2 billion and AI revenue reached 10.5% of total revenue ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23); [InsiderFinance, 2026](https://www.insiderfinance.io/news/infosys-q2-results-ai-up-guidance-cut)). Yet management narrowed FY2027 constant-currency revenue growth guidance to 1% to 2%, from 1.5% to 3% ([Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)).

My view is that the guidance cut reflects structural pricing pressure as well as cyclical softness. The CFO cited softer volume, pricing pressure from competitive intensity, and a higher client demand for productivity ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)). The CEO described AI as both "giving us the growth" and "seeing the compression" ([Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)). AI therefore appears to be simultaneously adding to Infosys's revenue mix and reducing the price of the services it sells. The key swing factor for the next two quarters is whether the record bookings convert into revenue. The mega-deal ramp is reported to begin later in the period, so H2 execution carries most of the risk.

Profitability has held up. Operating margin stayed at 21% against guidance of 20% to 22% ([Devam Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl)). The market has been less convinced: the stock is down 27.29% year-to-date and 20.06% over one year as of early November ([Sethi, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/infosys-dividend-2026-record-date-tomorrow-know-dividend-payout-yield-history-returns-11793585489373.html)).

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### News and Results

On 23 October 2026, Infosys reported Q2 FY2027 results and revised guidance. The FY2027 revenue outlook was cut to 1% to 2% constant currency, below the 2.03% analyst view. ADRs fell as much as 7.6% in early New York trading on Friday, 23 October ([Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)). Analysts described the full-year outlook as the weakest in seven years and noted the slowest growth pace in at least three years ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)).

On the call, the CFO attributed about 2 percentage points of the growth impact to offshoring changes and a deliberate decision not to pursue a large European manufacturing deal that did not meet return expectations ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)). The CFO also said that at the lower end of guidance management had built in higher uncertainty, and at the upper end an improvement in the environment ([Investing.com, 2026](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756)).

The CEO said almost all deals above $50 million now include AI ([Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)).

Management also noted that the Q2 volume was softer and that the company is cautious about discretionary technology spending ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23); [Devam Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl)).

### Dividend and Shareholder Actions

Infosys declared an interim dividend of ₹26 per share for FY2027, up from ₹23 a year earlier. The record date was 3 November 2026, and payment was scheduled for 11 November 2026 under the exchange filing dated 23 October ([Sethi, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/infosys-dividend-2026-record-date-tomorrow-know-dividend-payout-yield-history-returns-11793585489373.html)). Payment confirmation was not found in the reviewed sources.

### Product Launches

No new product launch by Infosys was verified within the window. Two Finacle-related items appeared in the Infosys press release feed, but their dates are not shown in the available text and they are treated as unverified for timing:

- A Finacle universal-banker branch modernization deployment with UNI Financial Cooperation in Canada ([PR Newswire, n.d.](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/infosys-and-columbia-university-launch-strategic-collaboration-across-deep-research-to-drive-innovation-and-unlock-business-value-302895969.html)).
- Winners of the Qorus-Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards 2026 ([PR Newswire, n.d.](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/infosys-and-columbia-university-launch-strategic-collaboration-across-deep-research-to-drive-innovation-and-unlock-business-value-302895969.html)).

### Leadership and Key Hires

No change in senior leadership was verified in the window. CEO Salil Parekh and CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka led the 23 October results call ([Investing.com, 2026](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756); [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)).

Workforce data from the call:

- About 13,000 freshers hired in H1, against a target of approximately 20,000 for FY2027 ([Investing.com, 2026](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756)).
- Net headcount increased by about 4,400 ([Investing.com, 2026](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756)).
- Compensation increases began on 26 October, with a second phase effective 27 January 2027 ([Investing.com, 2026](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756)).

Taken together, these figures suggest Infosys is still investing in its pipeline while absorbing wage costs. That combination makes the pricing pressure described on the call more consequential for margins.

### Deals and Partnerships

- **Large-deal bookings:** $5.2 billion in Q2, with 62% of the pipeline described as net-new business ([Devam Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl); [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)).
- **Strategic collaboration:** Infosys and Columbia University announced a collaboration on deep research to drive innovation and business value ([PR Newswire, n.d.](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/infosys-and-columbia-university-launch-strategic-collaboration-across-deep-research-to-drive-innovation-and-unlock-business-value-302895969.html)). The announcement date is not visible in the available text.

## Market Context

Broader sentiment toward AI-linked equities softened in mid-November. Briefs headlines from 13 November reported that U.S. stocks slipped as the AI trade wobbled, and that the Fed survey ranked AI as the top financial-system risk ([Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)). A 14 November headline reported that India's market was recovering as the AI frenzy cooled and foreign cash returned ([Thomas, 2026](https://www.briefs.co/news/infosys-cuts-2027-revenue-outlook-as-clients-tighten-tech-bu)). These are headline-level observations, and the article bodies were not reviewed. They are relevant mainly as context for how investors may read Infosys's AI narrative.

## Verification Flags

1. **Source conflict on free cash flow.** BigGo reports $922 million, while a LinkedIn post reports approximately $928 million and describes FCF as down 15.7% YoY ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23); [Devam Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl)). Confirm against the company filing before citing.
2. **Rupee-denominated results are unverified.** Net profit of ₹7,823 crore (about 6% YoY) and revenue of ₹49,244 crore (about 11% YoY) come only from a personal LinkedIn post ([Devam Bose, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/devam-bose-193235163_for-infosys-q2fy27-activity-7520050126766157824-Pbfl)). Reconcile with the official results release.
3. **Conflicting characterization of margins.** A YouTube video title describes Q2 margins as having missed, while other sources describe the 21% operating margin as steady and within guidance ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f4vgConNx8k); [BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)). The video content was not available, so this is unverified.
4. **Transcript labeling.** The Investing.com transcript is titled "Q2 2026," while the content refers to FY2027 Q2 ([Investing.com, 2026](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-infosys-q2-2026-beats-revenue-cuts-outlook-93CH-4969756)). The content is treated as the Q2 FY2027 call.
5. **Truncated mega-deal timing.** A BigGo summary says the mega-deal ramp "will only begin in the latter" part of a period, but the sentence is cut off ([BigGo Finance, 2026](https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_INFY_2026-10-23)). The exact timing is unverified.
6. **Undated press releases.** The Columbia University collaboration and Finacle items have no visible dates ([PR Newswire, n.d.](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/infosys-and-columbia-university-launch-strategic-collaboration-across-deep-research-to-drive-innovation-and-unlock-business-value-302895969.html)). Their presence in the 30-day window is unverified.
7. **Dividend payment.** The 11 November payment date comes from a scheduled filing ([Sethi, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/infosys-dividend-2026-record-date-tomorrow-know-dividend-payout-yield-history-returns-11793585489373.html)). Actual payment was not confirmed.
8. **Briefs source URL.** The primary Briefs page appears to be a scraped listing containing many unrelated headlines. Its Infosys content is the October 23 article. Items attributed to it should be confirmed against the original article.
9. **No verified news on the following:** product launches by Infosys, senior leadership changes, and new contract announcements beyond the Q2 bookings disclosure. Absence in these sources does not confirm absence in reality.

## Open Questions for Infosys

1. **Pricing versus volume:** How much of the FY2027 guidance cut is attributable to AI-driven productivity deflation in existing contracts, and how much to volume softness? What pricing assumptions are built into the 1% to 2% range for H2?
2. **Mega-deal conversion:** When will the net-new deal above $2 billion begin contributing revenue, what is the expected ramp profile, and what share of the $5.2 billion bookings is expected to convert within FY2027?
3. **AI monetization:** With AI at 10.5% of revenue and nearly all $50 million-plus deals including AI, how is Infosys pricing AI-enabled work, and what evidence can it provide that AI revenue is growing faster than the compression it creates in legacy services?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Public items from the search results dated 19 October to 12 November 2026 (about the last 30 days before the meeting). All facts below come from these results. I did not find a source for the meeting's purpose, attendees, or Infosys contacts.

## Financial results and guidance
- Q2 (quarter ended 30 Sep 2026) revenue was $5,145M, with AI revenue up 29% sequentially to 10.5% of revenue. Reported revenue rose 1.3% year over year, and operating margin was 21.0% (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- Net profit rose 6.2% to 78.23 billion rupees but missed the analyst estimate of 79.29 billion. Infosys cut its forecast, citing a North America slowdown as AI spending shifts (https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/23/india039s-infosys-beats-second-quarter-revenue-view).
- The ADR fell over 7% after Infosys lowered its annual revenue growth guidance (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/infosys-adr-falls-over-7-as-it-major-lowers-annual-revenue-growth-guidance-everything-investors-need-to-know/article-202325).
- Shares fell 6.5% as Q2 EPS missed estimates by $0.01 (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108). Infosys also reported a North America revenue decline amid sector slowdowns (same source).
- BMO Capital raised its price target to $13 and maintained Market Perform (same source).
- A block trade of ₹69.49 crore was executed on the NSE (same source).

## Deals
- Large-deal total contract value reached $5.2B, 62% of it net new, including one deal above $2B (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- Deal wins rose from $3.1B a year earlier to $5.2B (https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/10/23/india039s-infosys-beats-second-quarter-revenue-view).

## Hires and capacity
- Infosys expanded its Truist GCC in India and onboarded 1,000 colleagues (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- Infosys employs over 325,000 people across 59 countries (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece).
- A new 1.1M sq ft block at the Pocharam campus in Hyderabad targets emerging technologies (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/infosys-sets-up-new-1-1m-sq-ft-block-at-pocharam-campus-in-hyderabad-to-cater-to-emerging-technologies/articleshow/135366954.cms). I could only verify the headline, not the full article.

## Launches and events
- The Hyderabad campus was inaugurated on 2 November. It serves banking, retail, life sciences and manufacturing clients and includes energy-efficient systems. The CFO, Jayesh Sanghrajka, and state officials attended. Shares slid over 2% that day (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece).
- Management will attend non-deal investor roadshows in London and Edinburgh in November (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- The Infosys Prize 2026 winners were announced on 12 November in Bengaluru. Each of the six winners receives USD 100,000. This is a foundation award, not a company product launch (https://news.careers360.com/infosys-prize-2026-scholars-from-tifr-princeton-carnegie-mellon-uc-san-ranscisco-new-south-wales-singapore-universities-winners).

## Caveats
- The Star's headline says Infosys "beats" revenue expectations, but its body reports a forecast cut. Verify the revenue comparison before quoting it.
- Several items are headline-only from aggregator pages, so I have not verified their details.

## Open questions
1. After the guidance cut, what revenue growth assumptions sit behind the revised outlook for North America, and when do you expect that region to recover?
2. Of the $5.2B in large-deal TCV (62% net new), how much is tied to AI work, and what is the expected revenue timing?
3. With the Truist GCC hiring and the Pocharam expansion, how are headcount and capacity plans being matched to slowing demand in North America?

# Zepto Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Bottom Line

This briefing supports a meeting with Zepto on 17 November 2026. It covers changes over the 30 days before the current date (16 October to 15 November 2026), as requested.

**Bottom line:** The provided sources contain no Zepto news, launches, hires, or deals dated within that 30-day window. The most recent Zepto-specific item is dated 1 August 2026, when the company reportedly postponed its IPO by two to three quarters ([Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo)). The record therefore shows a gap of roughly three and a half months. Before the meeting, the team should check Zepto's newsroom, SEBI filings, and recent press directly, because any developments from August to November are not captured here. The most material context for the conversation is the shift from an IPO planned for 2026 to a deferred listing, alongside a lower private valuation.

## Evidence Limitation: The 30-Day Window

The source set does not support a "what changed in the last 30 days" account. The Kotak Neo timeline, which is the most complete running log, ends with entries from late July and early August 2026 ([Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo)). The YourStory report on the pre-IPO round is also from July 2026 ([YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed)). Other pages in the set carry recent site-wide sidebar headlines, but those concern other companies, such as Anthropic and Veritas Finance, and do not describe Zepto ([Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo)).

Because the pre-IPO round is described as "set to raise" and the source reports that a mail to Zepto drew no response, several items below should be treated as reported rather than confirmed ([YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed)).

## What Changed: Most Recent Developments on Record

The table below lists the latest dated items in the source set, in reverse chronological order. None falls within the 30-day window.

| Date | Development | Category | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Aug 2026 | CEO Aadit Palicha told staff at a town hall that the IPO would be postponed by about two to three quarters, per news reports | IPO timeline | [Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo) |
| 1 Aug 2026 | Company may explore other funding options after the postponement | Capital | [Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo) |
| 30 Jul 2026 | Plans to raise about ₹1,000 crore in a pre-IPO round at about $4.5 billion, mainly from domestic investors | Deal (reported) | [YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed) |
| 17 Jul 2026 | IPO could be trimmed by nearly 20%, from $850 million to $650–700 million | IPO structure | [Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo) |
| 9 Jun 2026 | Updated DRHP filed with SEBI, disclosing a FEMA-related compliance matter involving founders | Regulatory | [Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo) |
| 8 Jun 2026 | Filing reveals fast revenue growth and larger losses; some shareholders will not sell in the offer-for-sale | Financials / IPO | [Singh, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/zeptos-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-growth-bigger-losses-and-a-valuation-question-nobodys-answered-yet) |

### Capital and Valuation

Zepto's valuation has moved down since its last closed private round. The company closed a $450 million Series H round led by CalPERS at a $7 billion valuation in October 2025 ([Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo); [TechCrunch via Yahoo Finance, 2025](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/zepto-raises-450-million-7-101211041.html)). The reported pre-IPO round values the company at about $4.5 billion, roughly 36% below the 2025 mark ([YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed)). Some mutual funds and family offices that reviewed the company have indicated valuations well below the last private round ([Singh, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/zeptos-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-growth-bigger-losses-and-a-valuation-question-nobodys-answered-yet)).

The reported pre-IPO round is intended to raise Indian shareholding, which stands at about 40% ([YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed)).

### IPO Timeline and Structure

The IPO has been repeatedly reshaped:

| Stage | Reported terms | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Early 2026 outlook | ₹11,000 crore issue at a $7–8 billion valuation | [Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026) |
| Updated DRHP (June 2026) | Fresh issue of ₹8,010 crore; total size about ₹10,000 crore | [Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/ipo/zepto-funding-history-and-valuation-journey) |
| July 2026 | Offering reportedly reduced to $650–700 million | [Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo) |
| Current expectation | Listing expected between February and May 2027 | [Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo) |

SEBI approved the IPO in May 2026 ([Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/ipo/zepto-funding-history-and-valuation-journey)). Several large backers, including Y Combinator-affiliated funds, Lightspeed, and StepStone, are not selling in the offer-for-sale ([Singh, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/zeptos-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-growth-bigger-losses-and-a-valuation-question-nobodys-answered-yet)). That signals a lack of short-term exit pressure from those investors, though the source does not say why.

### Regulatory Matters

Zepto's founders received summonses from the Enforcement Directorate in April 2026. The inquiry concerns foreign investments, shareholding structure, and other matters under foreign-exchange law ([Singh, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/zeptos-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-growth-bigger-losses-and-a-valuation-question-nobodys-answered-yet)). The updated DRHP states that all requested documents have been submitted to the ED ([Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo)). The source set does not show whether the matter has been resolved.

### Launches, Hires, and Deals

- **Launches:** No new product or market launches appear in the sources for the 30-day window. The most recent dated product-related item is a 2025 advertising partnership with Criteo for retail media ([Criteo, 2025](https://www.criteo.com/news/press-releases/2025/08/criteo-and-zepto-partner-to-drive-the-next-wave-of-quick-commerce-in-india)).
- **Hires:** No senior hiring announcements appear for the window. Earlier reporting describes executives from Flipkart, Amazon, Uber, Dream11, and PharmEasy joining in 2021 ([TechCrunch, 2021](https://techcrunch.com/2021/12/20/zepto-a-10-minute-grocery-delivery-app-in-india-raises-100-million)).
- **Deals:** Zepto reportedly appointed Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and JM Financial as IPO bankers in May 2026 ([Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo)). The pre-IPO round is the only deal in the 2026 record after that, and it is reported rather than confirmed.

## Operating Performance

The operating data is the strongest part of the record. In fiscal 2026, operating revenue rose 104% year on year to ₹115.5 billion, about $2.4 billion. Advertising revenue rose more than 151% to ₹16.4 billion, about $171 million ([Singh, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/zeptos-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-growth-bigger-losses-and-a-valuation-question-nobodys-answered-yet)). Advertising therefore accounted for roughly 14% of operating revenue in fiscal 2026 (calculated from the reported figures).

| Metric | Value | Period | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Average orders per day | 1.75 million | Fiscal 2026 | [YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed) |
| Orders per day | 2.33 million | Quarter ended March 2026 | [YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed) |
| Stores | 1,139 | 31 March 2026 | [YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed) |
| Annual transacting users | About 48 million | Fiscal 2026 | [YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed) |

The sources do not provide Zepto's net loss figures, so the reported "bigger losses" cannot be quantified from this record ([Singh, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/zeptos-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-growth-bigger-losses-and-a-valuation-question-nobodys-answered-yet)).

## Inconsistencies in Reporting

Several figures conflict across sources and should be confirmed before the meeting:

| Item | Reported figure A | Reported figure B | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| IPO size | About ₹10,000 crore total ([Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/ipo/zepto-funding-history-and-valuation-journey)) | ₹11,000–12,000 crore ([Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo)) | Likely reflects different dates and drafts |
| IPO valuation | $7–8 billion target ([Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026)) | About $1 billion ([Singh, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/zeptos-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-growth-bigger-losses-and-a-valuation-question-nobodys-answered-yet)) | The $1 billion figure appears to refer to the offering size, not valuation |
| Current private valuation | $7 billion (October 2025) ([Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo)) | About $4.5 billion (July 2026) ([YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed)) | Reported as a pre-IPO round, not confirmed as closed |

## Analytical View

Based on this record, my assessment is that the central issue for the meeting is capital structure and listing credibility, not growth. Revenue growth above 100% and rising store and order volumes are real, but they have not been enough to hold the 2025 valuation in the market. The gap between the $7 billion private mark and the $4.5 billion pre-IPO figure suggests that investors are discounting either profitability or governance risk, and the record does not show which.

The shift to domestic capital, paired with the ED matter and the reduced offering, points to a company managing a more constrained path to listing. I would not treat the 2027 window as settled. A listing in February to May 2027 depends on resolving the foreign-exchange inquiry and on public-market appetite that the sources describe as uncertain. The fact that major existing investors are holding rather than selling is a mildly positive signal about their confidence, but it does not offset the valuation discount.

For the meeting, the priority should be to understand what Zepto is doing to close the profitability and governance gaps, rather than to discuss the growth numbers, which are already public.

## Three Open Questions to Ask

1. **What is the status of the pre-IPO round and of the ED inquiry?** The reported ₹1,000 crore round has not been confirmed as closed, and the FEMA matter remains open in the sources ([YourStory, 2026](https://yourstory.com/2026/07/zepto-rs-1000-cr-pre-ipo-round-prepublic-listing-delayed); [Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo)). Both bear directly on the listing timeline.

2. **What is the path to profitability, and how does it relate to the valuation gap?** The record shows strong revenue growth and an increase in losses but no net loss figures ([Singh, 2026](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/08/zeptos-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-growth-bigger-losses-and-a-valuation-question-nobodys-answered-yet)). Asking for the current unit economics and the timeline for store-level and company-level profitability would clarify what investors are pricing.

3. **Given the postponement, what changed in the IPO structure and what is the revised timetable?** The offering has moved from ₹11,000 crore to a reduced size, and the listing has moved to February–May 2027 ([Kotak Neo, n.d.](https://www.kotakneo.com/ipo/zepto-ipo)). Asking which milestones would trigger a launch, and whether the reduced offering is still the plan, would test whether the timetable is firm.

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026. Sources are from the search results only.

## What changed in the last 30 days

**Launches and marketing**
- Zepto landed a brand activation in Seoul Street, and AnimationXpress reports that Anime India is next. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta is quoted, and Zepto has not said which fandom comes next. Fans are queuing in Hyderabad on 14 November. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago)

**Festive demand**
- Zepto delivered over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour during Dhanteras. Platforms including Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and Flipkart Minutes reported strong festive order growth. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm)

**People and workplace**
- Zepto moved its post-Diwali scheduled holiday from Tuesday to Monday, giving employees an extra day off. Chief HR officer Sneha Arora said the aim was a longer weekend for families. (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms)
- Reputational risk: a viral video led to coverage that a delivery partner received "cash-like coupons" instead of money as a Diwali bonus, which one commenter called "peanuts in the name of a bonus." A user also criticised startups in the gig economy for weak worker benefits. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)
- The same article quotes a social media post claiming a "Zepto valuation 7 billion." This is an unverified claim. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)

**Hires and deals**
- No hires or deals within the window were found in the results.

**Background (outside the window)**
- A company profile lists Zepto as a privately held Indian company founded in 2021, with a venture round dated 1 July 2026 for USD 100M and a Series H dated 16 November 2025 for USD 450M. The profile is undated and its data is partly garbled, so verify before citing. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)

**Excluded:** The "zeptoverse" results (Moneycontrol, Nacionale) concern a particle-physics term and are unrelated to Zepto the company. The Inc42 IPO tracker result shows no Zepto-specific content.

## Open questions

1. How was the Diwali bonus structured for delivery partners, and why were some payouts made as coupons rather than cash?
2. Which fandom or brand is next after Anime India, and what is the planned timing for the Seoul Street and Hyderabad activations?
3. Can you confirm the 2026 funding round and any valuation figures, given that the only valuation reference we found is an unverified social media post?

# Zepto: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing supports a meeting with Zepto on 17 November 2026. It covers developments in the 30 days before the report date of 15 November 2026 (16 October to 15 November 2026), as the request specified. It also provides three open questions for the meeting.

**Key finding:** The provided sources contain no Zepto news, launch, hire, or deal dated within this 30-day window. The most recent dated Zepto-specific item is a 30 April 2026 hiring partnership ([GetPersonalisedCV, 2026](https://getpersonalisedcv.in/blog/zepto-ncs-partnership-quick-commerce-hiring-guide)). Every other item is either older or undated. The sections below therefore separate verified recent items from older context and from unverified claims.

## Bottom Line

Zepto's dominant strategic event is its planned IPO, which is still pre-pricing. The public record is thin and internally inconsistent on the filing route, issue size, and valuation. Before the meeting, the team should confirm the current status of the filing and the figures it will use. Reliance on the press figures alone carries material risk.

## Company Snapshot

Zepto launched in 2021 with a ten-minute grocery delivery model. Its founders, Aadit Palicha and Kaivalya Vohra, were two Stanford dropouts ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)). The company operates dark stores, which are small fulfilment centres typically occupying 1,500 to 3,000 square feet ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)). It has also expanded beyond groceries into electronics, pharmacy, and fashion ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)). Its investors include Y Combinator, Lachy Groom, Nexus Venture Partners, StepStone, Glade Brook, and Lightspeed ([Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html)).

## What Changed: Last 30 Days (16 October to 15 November 2026)

### News, Launches, and Deals

No dated news item in the provided sources falls within the 30-day window. The IPO-related items that could be relevant are either undated or predate the window:

| Item | Date in source | Within 30 days? | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Confidential DRHP filing reported as imminent | 25 Dec 2025 ([PTI, 2025](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/zepto-to-file-confidential-drhp-on-friday-targets-2026-listing/articleshow/126175717.cms)) | No | Reported, not verified |
| Confidential DRHP filing reported as completed | 29 Dec (year not shown) ([PL Capital, n.d.](https://www.plindia.com/news/zepto-takes-the-confidential-ipo-route-key-things-to-know)) | No | Reported, year unconfirmed |
| Public filing with offer-for-sale and pre-IPO placement | Undated ([Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html)) | Unknown | Unverified |
| Latest IPO status update (no confirmed date) | Last updated 31 Jul 2026 ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)) | No | Most recent IPO status found |

### Hiring

On 30 April 2026, Zepto signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the National Career Service to integrate its vacancies into the government job portal. The partnership is aimed at hiring more than 1 lakh workers, from delivery partners to dark store managers and supply chain leads ([GetPersonalisedCV, 2026](https://getpersonalisedcv.in/blog/zepto-ncs-partnership-quick-commerce-hiring-guide)). A significant share of the hiring targets youth in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities ([GetPersonalisedCV, 2026](https://getpersonalisedcv.in/blog/zepto-ncs-partnership-quick-commerce-hiring-guide)). This item is about six and a half months old, so it is context rather than a recent change.

### Deals and Financing

The most material financing item is the planned pre-IPO placement of up to ₹16.02 billion (about $167 million) ([Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html)). The article is undated, so its timing is unverified. The same report says the company was valued at $7 billion in its last funding round in October ([Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html)). The year of that round is not stated.

## IPO Position

### Planned Offering

Zepto is reported to be aiming to raise ₹11,000 crore (about $1.2 billion) at a valuation of $7 to $8 billion ([Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026)). The offering is expected to be largely a fresh issue, with proceeds directed toward funding expansion rather than early-investor exits ([PL Capital, n.d.](https://www.plindia.com/news/zepto-takes-the-confidential-ipo-route-key-things-to-know)). Use of proceeds is expected to fund dark store expansion, technology investment, and working capital ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)).

### Conflicting Figures

The sources do not agree on several core figures:

| Metric | Figure reported | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Fresh issue size | ₹11,000 crore (about $1.2 billion) | [Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026) |
| Fresh issue size | Up to ₹80.1 billion (about $837 million) | [Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html) |
| Valuation at IPO | $7 to $8 billion | [Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026) |
| Valuation at IPO | $6 to $8 billion (analyst estimate, pre-DRHP) | [Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details) |
| Prior private round | $5 billion (mid-2024) | [Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details) |
| Prior private round | $7 billion (October, year unstated) | [Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html) |
| Filing timing | Completed in 2024–25 | [Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details) |
| Filing timing | Reported around late December 2025 | [PTI, 2025](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/zepto-to-file-confidential-drhp-on-friday-targets-2026-listing/articleshow/126175717.cms); [PL Capital, n.d.](https://www.plindia.com/news/zepto-takes-the-confidential-ipo-route-key-things-to-know) |

The filing-route discrepancy matters most. A confidential DRHP keeps the document out of the public domain until SEBI observations are resolved ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)). The Yahoo Finance article describes a filing with specific issue sizes and an offer-for-sale by named investors, which suggests disclosure has occurred ([Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html)). The sources do not resolve whether a public DRHP has been filed.

### Timeline

No confirmed IPO date has been announced. The company has indicated 2026 as its target listing window ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)). A price band has not been announced ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)). The Jainam guide, last updated 31 July 2026, is the most recent status source found, so it may not reflect developments after that date.

### Financial Performance

The Yahoo Finance headline describes the filing as showing fast growth and bigger losses, with an open valuation question ([Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html)). The provided excerpt does not include the underlying revenue, loss, or gross order value figures, so no numbers can be reported here. Jainam identifies gross order value, revenue, and the path to contribution margin breakeven as the three primary valuation inputs ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)).

## Analyst Assessment

**1. The IPO is the central topic, but the information base is not reliable enough for firm conclusions.** The figures for issue size, valuation, and filing route differ across sources of similar standing. Until the company's own filing or an authoritative regulatory record is checked, the team should treat ₹11,000 crore and $7 to $8 billion as working assumptions, not facts.

**2. A 2026 listing looks less likely than the official target implies.** The most recent status source, from 31 July 2026, reports no price band and no confirmed date ([Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)). The provided sources contain no evidence of a public DRHP or price band as of 15 November 2026. With about six weeks left in the calendar year, my judgment is that a 2026 listing is possible but not the base case. This is an inference from the absence of evidence, not a confirmed fact.

**3. The hiring partnership is the most verifiable operational signal.** It is documented as an MoU with a government platform and has a specific target of more than 1 lakh hires ([GetPersonalisedCV, 2026](https://getpersonalisedcv.in/blog/zepto-ncs-partnership-quick-commerce-hiring-guide)). It supports the expansion narrative that the IPO proceeds are meant to fund. Its timing, however, is outside the requested 30-day window.

**4. Meeting recommendation.** Use the meeting to confirm facts rather than to present the press narrative. The team should avoid quoting the valuation or issue size as settled, and should ask Zepto to clarify the filing status directly.

## Source Quality and Verification Flags

- **Verified recent (within 30 days):** None found in the provided sources.
- **Recent but unverified:** The Yahoo Finance article is undated and conflicts with other figures ([Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html)).
- **Older context:** The STAT Times article on a $200 million raise at a $900 million valuation is historical and undated in the excerpt. It is not used for current figures ([STAT Times, n.d.](https://www.stattimes.com/logistics/zepto-raises-200-million-at-900-million-valuation-1345306)).
- **Secondary blogs:** The Jainam and Team Dhan pages are investor-education content, not primary filings. They are used for context and flagged where they conflict with other sources.
- **Excluded:** A software vendor's business-model page was excluded because it is promotional and contains no verifiable Zepto data.
- **Not available in the sources:** Revenue, losses, gross order value, user numbers, city count, and any post-July 2026 IPO update.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Filing status and figures:** Has the DRHP been made public, and which fresh issue size and valuation range does Zepto consider current? The press reports cite ₹11,000 crore and up to ₹80.1 billion, and the valuation ranges differ ([Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026); [Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html)).
2. **Path to profitability:** What are the latest gross order value, revenue, and contribution margin figures, and what is the timeline to contribution margin breakeven? The Yahoo Finance report points to bigger losses, and Jainam names this metric as the key valuation test ([Yahoo Finance, n.d.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/zepto-ipo-filing-reveals-fast-050717430.html); [Jainam Resources, 2026](https://www.jainam.in/blog/zepto-ipo-details)).
3. **Hiring delivery:** How much of the 1 lakh-plus hiring target under the National Career Service MoU has been filled, and what share is in dark store operations versus corporate roles? ([GetPersonalisedCV, 2026](https://getpersonalisedcv.in/blog/zepto-ncs-partnership-quick-commerce-hiring-guide))
