runs.briefing:
# Shopify Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing prepares for a meeting with Shopify on 17 November 2026. It covers the 30 days from 16 October to 15 November 2026 and includes news, product launches, developer and security changes, leadership and hiring signals, deals, and market data. Items from just outside the window are labelled as context. Every factual claim is linked to a source in the reference list. Where the provided material contains no relevant item for a category, the briefing says so rather than filling the gap.

## Executive Summary

- **Product direction is centred on agentic commerce.** The Fall '26 Edition, released 28 October 2026, makes Shopify's catalog, cart, and checkout available to AI agents and apps ([Shopify, 2026b](https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-developer)).
- **Merchant tooling is shifting toward AI-driven store management.** Canvas and a rebuilt Sidekick are the main examples, though Canvas is still in early access ([Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall)).
- **Platform security and deprecation deadlines are tightening.** Several changes fall between now and early 2027, which creates operational load for merchants and app developers.
- **No Shopify executive appointments or acquisitions were found in the 30-day window.** The provided sources do not report any.
- **Market signals are mixed but stable.** Shopify's share price closed at $147.09 on 13 November 2026 ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/SHOP/press-releases)).

## Key Changes in the Last 30 Days

### Product and Platform Launches

The most significant event in the window was the Fall '26 Edition, codenamed "Exponential," which Shopify published on 28 October 2026. Sources disagree on the scale: the Editions page lists 222 updates across 11 categories ([Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall)), while the launch email described "150+ updates" ([Witscode, 2026](https://witscode.com/blogs/shopify-editions-fall-2026)). The discrepancy is likely a counting difference, but it is worth clarifying in the meeting.

The release is organised around several themes:

| Area | Change | Status (per sources) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Agentic checkout | Shop Pay checkout inside AI agents, including Muse from Meta, Claude Duet, Grok Bot, and Instinct | Live | [Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall) |
| Agent discovery | shop.md lets ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents shop Shopify stores | Live | [Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall) |
| Storefront tooling | WebMCP tools run by default on every Liquid and Hydrogen storefront and checkout | Default-on | [Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall) |
| Store design | Canvas, a whole-store design surface edited through Sidekick | Early access; desktop-only at launch | [Witscode, 2026](https://witscode.com/blogs/shopify-editions-fall-2026) |
| Theme architecture | New theme architecture for agencies and developers | Developer preview | [Witscode, 2026](https://witscode.com/blogs/shopify-editions-fall-2026) |
| Fraud prevention | Shopify Protect updates, including new fraud and chargeback tools | Mixed availability | [Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall) |

Shopify reports that daily Sidekick sessions grew 4.2x year over year, and that Sidekick made more than 25 million theme edits in the first half of 2026 ([Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall)). Shopify also states that stores can go from no theme to launch 20% faster with Canvas, though this is a company claim rather than an independently verified result ([Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall)).

Shopify's own framing identifies agentic commerce as central to the release ([Coalition Technologies, 2026](https://coalitiontechnologies.com/blog/shopify-editions-fall-26)). Identixweb cites Adobe's expectation of US online holiday spending reaching $275.1 billion this season, with traffic from AI tools up 130% year over year ([Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall)).

Rollouts also gained a key feature. On 23 October 2026, Shopify expanded Rollouts to full catalog scheduling, allowing brands to set when catalogs go live, switch between them at set times, and bundle pricing changes with theme and checkout updates ([Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)). This directly targets Black Friday and Cyber Monday (BFCM) planning.

### Merchant Features

On 11 November 2026, Shopify began showing store credit balances in the customer account header. Signed-in customers who have not yet ordered also receive personalised product recommendations from the catalog ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify)).

### Developer and Security Changes

| Date | Change | Relevance | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 27 Oct 2026 | App security updates, October 2026 (developer changelog) | Apps and partners | [Witscode, 2026](https://witscode.com/blogs/shopify-editions-fall-2026) |
| 2 Nov 2026 | Global Catalog REST API stops serving traffic | Integrations relying on the legacy API | [Witscode, 2026](https://witscode.com/blogs/shopify-editions-fall-2026) |
| Nov 2026 to Jan 2027 | IP allowlists phased in for custom apps installed outside their owning organisation | Custom apps and partner accounts | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify) |
| 14 Nov 2026 | Allowlists may combine IP addresses, CIDR ranges, and hosting provider ASNs; tighter requirements for public and partner-created apps | Public and partner apps | [Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify) |

The 14 November update is labelled "App security updates: Thank you, plus what's required next," which suggests Shopify is responding to feedback from bulk-operation allowlisting while tightening requirements further ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify)).

### Deadlines Approaching

Several deadlines follow the window and should be on the agenda:

- **Script tag deprecation:** Applies on 1 October 2026 and 1 March 2027. It affects all Shopify plans, including Plus ([Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)).
- **Global Catalog REST API cutoff:** 2 November 2026, which has now passed as of the briefing date ([Witscode, 2026](https://witscode.com/blogs/shopify-editions-fall-2026)).
- **IP allowlist enforcement:** Phased from November 2026 through January 2027 ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify)).
- **BFCM activation:** Common Thread Co. advised scheduling the 27 November activation in advance ([Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)).

## Hires and Leadership

The provided sources contain **no Shopify executive appointments or senior hires within the 30-day window.** The most recent board change in the material is Jeanne DeWitt Grosser joining the board on 16 June 2026, which falls outside the window ([Shopify, 2026a](https://www.shopify.com/news/search)).

The Rocket Talent articles dated October and November 2026 concern recruitment services for Shopify brands and are not Shopify hiring announcements ([Rocket Talent, 2026](https://rockettalent.co/blog/growth-recruiters-for-shopify-brands-complete-guide)). They should not be treated as evidence of Shopify leadership changes.

## Deals, Financials, and Market Signals

**Deals:** No acquisitions or partnerships announced within the window appear in the sources. For historical context, Shopify agreed to acquire fulfilment provider Deliverr for $2.1 billion in May 2022 ([Paul, Weiss, 2022](https://www.paulweiss.com/insights/client-news/shopify-to-acquire-deliverr-for-21-billion)). In March 2025, it agreed to acquire AI search startup Vantage Discovery, which it planned to integrate into its platform ([LinkedIn, 2025](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/shopify-acquires-ai-search-startup-march-21st-2025-5ccpe)).

**Financials:** Shopify announced 30%+ growth across GMV, revenue, gross profit, and free cash flow on 5 August 2026 ([Shopify, 2026a](https://www.shopify.com/news/search)). This is outside the window but is the most recent reported performance. On 2 June 2026, Shopify also increased its share repurchase programme by $3 billion ([Shopify, 2026a](https://www.shopify.com/news/search)).

**Market data:** Shopify closed at $147.09 on 13 November 2026, up 0.21%. After hours, the share price was $145.62, down 1.00% ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/SHOP/press-releases)). A single-day movement is not a meaningful trend, and the sources do not include longer-term price data.

**Ecosystem:** Shopify describes an app ecosystem worth $1.3 billion and reports that its partner network is growing ([Shopify, 2026c](https://www.shopify.com/news/a-world-with-more-builders)). The Partner Survey figures cited there were fielded in mid-2026 and fall outside the window.

## Source Reliability and Data Gaps

- **Primary sources:** Shopify's developer news and the Shopify news pages are the most reliable for product and platform facts ([Shopify, 2026b](https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-developer)).
- **Secondary sources:** Several third-party blogs, including Identixweb, Witscode, Meetanshi, and Coalition Technologies, summarise the Fall '26 Edition. They are useful but differ on the update count, so the 222 and 150+ figures should be verified against Shopify's Editions page.
- **Release trackers:** Releasebot and Common Thread Co. provide dated entries but are aggregators. Specific dates and deadlines should be confirmed in Shopify's own changelog before the meeting.
- **Gaps:** No Shopify executive changes, acquisitions, or new financial guidance were found within the window. The sources also lack independent adoption data for Canvas, shop.md, and the agentic checkout features.

## Analyst Assessment

In my view, the most material development is not any single feature. It is the combined direction: Shopify is moving the storefront, checkout, and merchant operations toward AI agents while tightening the rules for apps and integrations. This creates opportunity for merchants who adopt early, but it also raises the cost of staying current. Between the script tag deprecation, the Global Catalog API cutoff, and the IP allowlist phase-in, a merchant or partner that misses a date could see tracking, integrations, or checkout break during peak trading.

Canvas is the feature with the most execution risk. It is in early access, desktop-only at launch, and did not support third-party themes, app blocks, markets, translations, or rollouts at launch ([Witscode, 2026](https://witscode.com/blogs/shopify-editions-fall-2026)). Shopify's 20% speed claim is promising, but the gaps matter for merchants with complex stores. The 2 October Rollouts discount feature, which was published just before the window, also benefits merchants who test offers before BFCM, but the sources note that 7 to 14 days of experiment time is needed for significance ([Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)). That makes timing critical for brands starting late.

The September 1 change to on-hand inventory reporting also deserves attention. Sell-through, days-remaining, and ABC analysis reports now measure all physical stock rather than sellable stock, so trend lines have a step change that could be misread as performance ([Huptech Web, 2026](https://www.huptechweb.com/blogs/shopify-changelog-guide)).

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Canvas roadmap:** What is the timeline for moving Canvas out of early access, and when will it support third-party themes, app blocks, markets, and rollouts, given these were absent at launch ([Witscode, 2026](https://witscode.com/blogs/shopify-editions-fall-2026))?
2. **Agentic commerce measurement:** How does Shopify plan to report sales and attribution from AI agent channels, including Shop Pay checkout inside agents and shop.md, so that merchants can judge return on investment ([Identixweb, 2026](https://www.identixweb.com/shopify-editions-fall))?
3. **Security enforcement for partners:** How will the IP allowlist and app security requirements phased in through January 2027 be supported for partners and custom apps installed outside their owning organisation, and what support is available for apps that cannot meet the requirements in time ([Releasebot, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify))?

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Shopify (Meeting 17 November 2026)

**Scope:** Sources dated roughly 21 October to 8 November 2026. Only the search results provided were used.

## Financial performance
- Shopify reported 32% revenue growth (32% in constant currency) and a 22% free cash flow margin for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, announced 3 November 2026 (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow). A Simply Wall St summary carried on Yahoo Finance repeats these figures (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/latest-news-e-commerce-shopifys-123733064.html).
- Management held a Q3 results call on 3 November 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET, with a webcast replay available (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow).

## Product launches
- Shopify's Fall '26 Edition was published on 1 November 2026 (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-merchant). Highlights include a new Shop home on the web, with shoppable posts, editorial curations, and sections personalised to each shopper (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-merchant).
- VP of Product Vanessa Lee frames the release around network effects across merchants (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-merchant).

## Promotions
- A third-party DemandSage page advertises three months of Shopify for $1/month, valid until 30 November 2026 (https://www.demandsage.com/shopify-free-trial). This is not an official Shopify source, and the terms are unverified.

## Headcount (timing unclear)
- An undated Tavily company profile lists headcount at 30,025, up 5,330 (21.6%) year on year, up 1,499 in the latest quarter, and up 170 in the latest month (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/yIg9BumgrtmF). Because the page is undated, these figures may fall outside the 30-day window.

## Hires and deals
- No hires, acquisitions, or partnership deals appear in the results. I could not find sources for these categories in the last 30 days.

## Open questions
1. What is the rollout timeline and merchant impact of the new Shop home and personalised sections announced in the Fall '26 Edition?
2. With revenue up 32% and headcount reportedly up 21.6% year on year, which areas are receiving the most investment in the next 12 months?
3. Are the $1/month, three-month trial terms available through official Shopify channels, and do they apply to the accounts we would bring to Shopify?

# Databricks: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Review window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026 (30 days)
**Purpose:** Background for a 17 November 2026 meeting with Databricks

---

## Executive Summary

Databricks' most material change in the review window is the November 2026 launch of a second-generation Genie, an always-on autonomous agent, together with its distribution into third-party assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cursor ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex); [Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Cost governance also moved forward, with AI Function spend folded into Unity Gateway budgets from 1 November 2026 ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). I could not verify any executive hire, acquisition or new strategic partnership announced inside the review window. Several widely circulated items in the sources are either older than 30 days or conflict with each other, and they are flagged below.

---

## Context: Background Outside the Review Window

The Data + AI Summit took place from 15 to 18 June 2026 at Moscone Center, San Francisco. It is outside the 30-day window but sets the strategic frame. CEO Ali Ghodsi argued that "AI doesn't struggle with intelligence; it struggles with context" ([Marattha, 2026](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026)). The summit was attended by more than 30,000 professionals in person ([Marattha, 2026](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026)). Omnigent, an open-source multi-framework agent harness, was introduced as part of the Agent Bricks announcements ([Marattha, 2026](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026)).

Earlier partnership activity also sits outside the window. In July 2026, Databricks and Microsoft announced an expanded integration extending into the 2030s ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)). Databricks also signed a multi-year Anthropic partnership in March 2025 and an OpenAI partnership in September 2025, both valued at $100 million ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)).

---

## Material Changes in the Last 30 Days

### Product Launches and Releases

### Funding and Valuation

Wikipedia reports a December 2025 Series L round of more than $4 billion at a $134 billion valuation ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)). A LinkedIn post cites a $4.8 billion raise and describes planned capital deployment ([Saltzman, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/jason-salt_how-databricks-will-deploy-48b-in-2026-activity-7406815692102021120-ikZi)). That post is an opinion piece from an individual analyst, is roughly eleven months old, and its figures do not match the Wikipedia account. I have therefore not relied on it.

---

## Analysis

### Strategic Read

My view is that the most significant change is Databricks' decision to make Genie available inside competitors' assistants, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor. Databricks is betting that its value lies in governed context and data access rather than in owning the end-user interface. The supporting evidence is the breadth of the connector list and the 100-plus source expansion of Genie Search ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). This is consistent with the June "context problem" framing ([Marattha, 2026](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026)).

The second signal is that cost control is becoming a product feature. Unity Gateway budgets now cover AI Functions from 1 November, and budget events can now trigger webhooks into incident or ticketing tools ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Together these suggest Databricks has heard buyer concern about unpredictable AI spend, and it is moving to address it in the platform rather than in pricing alone.

The third signal is that governance is advancing in parallel with agent capability. Feature Views are now default for compliance-profile workspaces, and cross-platform connectors arrive with admin-managed setup ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). The risk is that data leaving the workspace through third-party assistants creates a governance boundary that buyers will need to audit.

### Risks and Gaps

- **Preview maturity:** Most of the new connectors and the Windows desktop app are in preview or beta, so production commitments should be cautious ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Rollout lag:** Staged releases mean some customers will not see features for a week or more ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Vendor-reported metrics:** The 33% accuracy improvement for `ai_decide` is self-reported and has no published benchmark in the sources ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Source quality:** Several sources are aggregators, and some carry inconsistent details. These include Fundz, which describes the launch in marketing terms ([Fundz, 2026](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)), and Wikipedia, which is a tertiary source.

---

| Summit length | Described as four days (Marattha, 2026; Atlan, n.d.) and as a "two-day keynote program" (Marattha, 2026) | **Internal inconsistency; not material** |
| Row Zero acquisition | Date given as September 2026 with no deal terms | **Outside window; terms unverified** |
| Acquisition count | 23 per Tracxn | **Third-party aggregator; not verified against filings** |

---

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Cost predictability:** Now that AI Function usage counts against Unity Gateway budgets from 1 November, how does Databricks expect customers to model agent-driven spend, particularly for the always-on Genie, and what controls are available before a budget is exhausted? ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex))

2. **Governance across surfaces:** When Genie answers are delivered through ChatGPT, Claude or Microsoft 365 Copilot, which controls apply to data residency, row- and column-level permissions and audit logging, and when will the preview connectors reach general availability? ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november))

3. **Context beyond the lakehouse:** Genie Ontology is positioned as maintaining understanding across an enterprise's data and processes. How far does it extend to non-Databricks systems, and what is the roadmap for the next two quarters in light of the recent Electric and Panther acquisitions? ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex); [Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks))

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window covered:** 18 October to 17 November 2026
**Basis:** Search results only. Items without a source are not included.

## Financials and Valuation

- Ben Horowitz's essay of 27 October 2026 puts Databricks at a revenue run rate above $7B, growing 80% year over year. Its Lakehouse is above $1.5B (growing over 100%) and Lakebase is above $100M. The essay gives no further breakdown, and the figures are unaudited because Databricks is private. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- The same essay says agents now send Databricks more queries than people do. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- Databricks was most recently valued at $190B. As of October 2026 it has no announced IPO date and no public S-1. (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options)

## Product Launches

- On 11 November 2026, Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server. (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents)
- Databricks launched a set of agentic AI tools on 11 November. They include an updated Genie assistant that works in the background and an "Ontology" feature that scans organizational data. (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html)

## Deals, Partnerships and Investment

- HP is moving its customer data platform into Databricks and expects costs to fall by 40%. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- Commvault announced Data Activate for Databricks, which makes governed enterprise data available for analytics and AI. Early access is planned for December 2026 in select Azure regions, so it is not yet generally available. (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai)
- A BigDATAwire press list dated 12 November shows the headline "Databricks Plans $3B Investment in Europe and the Middle East." The results contain only the headline, so the scope and timing are unconfirmed. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- A BigDATAwire list also shows the headline "Databricks to Invest More Than $500M in the Netherlands," without detail. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)

## Hires and Leadership

- No hires or leadership changes were found in the results for this window.

## Open Questions

1. The Horowitz figures are unaudited and the agent-query claim is unquantified. How does Databricks measure agent versus human query volume, and what share of the 80% growth comes from agents?
2. Databricks has announced a $3B investment in Europe and the Middle East and a $500M+ investment in the Netherlands. What are the timelines, and how will the HP migration's projected 40% cost reduction be verified?
3. With Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot, and Commvault's partner product in early access, how is pricing structured for third-party agent queries, and how does Databricks plan to keep governance consistent across them?

runs.briefing:
# Databricks Pre-Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026 | **Look-back window:** approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026

## Executive Summary

Databricks's most material activity in the past 30 days was product distribution rather than corporate transactions. On 11 November 2026 the company launched a second-generation, always-on Genie, a Genie Ontology layer, and expanded Genie Search to more than 100 enterprise data sources ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). In the same week, Genie connectors and plugins were rolled out for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Bot/Cursor ([Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Hiring activity also rose sharply. Third-party trackers report 896 open roles, including nine in leadership, as of mid-November ([Lakewave, 2026](https://lakewave.ai/company/databricks)). No verified executive appointment or acquisition within the window was found in the provided materials.

## Background Context (Outside the 30-Day Window)

The Data + AI Summit took place from 15 to 18 June 2026 at Moscone Center in San Francisco, with more than 30,000 in-person attendees ([Atlan, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements); [Flexera, 2026](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026)). CEO Ali Ghodsi framed the keynote around the idea that AI's core problem is context rather than intelligence ([Flexera, 2026](https://www.flexera.com/blog/perspectives/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026)). Headline launches included Genie One, Genie Ontology, Agent Bricks, Unity Catalog Metrics, and Unity AI Gateway ([Atlan, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements)). Because these predate the window, they are included only as context for the November releases.

Two earlier items also frame the commercial relationship. In July 2026, Databricks and Microsoft announced an expanded integration extending into the 2030s, which includes Genie being integrated into Microsoft 365, Teams, and Copilot ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)). Databricks also has a partnership with OpenAI, valued at $100 million, to incorporate OpenAI's models into the platform ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)).

## Material Changes in the Last 30 Days

### Product and Platform Launches

The most significant launch is the second-generation Genie. Databricks describes it as an always-on enterprise agent that works autonomously, manages long-running work, and proactively routes decisions to people through a new priority inbox and email ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). Genie Ontology is positioned as an agentic ontology that maintains a horizontal view of how a company operates across data, people, and processes ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). Genie Search now covers more than 100 enterprise sources, including the lakehouse, Google Drive, Jira, and Confluence ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).

The Azure Databricks release notes show a dense November cadence. Key items are listed below.

| Date (2026) | Release | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Nov | AI Functions spend included in Unity Gateway budgets | GA | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 2 Nov | ai_decide uses a new model, reported 33% more accurate | Beta | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 9 Nov | New jobs compute defaults to Auto access mode | Release | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 10 Nov | Google Gemini 4 Carbon available on Unity Gateway | Release | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 10 Nov | Budget alerts can trigger webhooks | Beta | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 10 Nov | Genie One Chrome extension | Beta | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 11 Nov | Genie plugins for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok Bot/Cursor | Public Preview / release | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 11 Nov | Genie One desktop app for Windows | Beta | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 11 Nov | Feature Views enabled by default for compliance security profile | Release | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 13 Nov | OneLake external locations support file events | Public Preview | [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |

The release notes state that releases are staged and may reach some accounts a week or more after the listed date ([Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Some features may therefore not yet be visible to every customer.

### Partnerships and Distribution

The Genie connectors are the clearest partnership signal in the window. The Genie plugin for Microsoft 365 Copilot removes the need for @-mentions, and the Copilot Cowork version removes the need to create an OAuth app or edit a plugin manifest ([Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Connectors for ChatGPT and Claude require an administrator to set up the plugin for the workspace, after which each user signs in with an Azure Databricks account ([Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

No new formal partnership agreement was announced in the window. The Microsoft expansion and OpenAI deal described above are earlier events ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)).

### Hiring and Leadership

Lakewave reports 896 open roles on Databricks's careers page as of 14 November 2026, with nine in leadership ([Lakewave, 2026](https://lakewave.ai/company/databricks)). Recent leadership postings include:

- **Director, Enterprise (NSW)**, posted 12 November 2026 ([Lakewave, 2026](https://lakewave.ai/company/databricks))
- **Sr. Technology Partner Director, Security & Observability ISV Partnerships**, posted 10 November 2026 ([Lakewave, 2026](https://lakewave.ai/company/databricks))
- **Director, Strategic Programs & Operations, CAO**, posted 10 November 2026 ([Lakewave, 2026](https://lakewave.ai/company/databricks))

These are job postings, not confirmed appointments. Lakewave is a third-party aggregator, so the postings should be checked against the careers page before being relied on.

The leadership team is stable at the top. Ali Ghodsi is listed as Co-founder and CEO, and Ion Stoica as Executive Chairman ([Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/databricks-ceo)). Unify lists Ron Gabrisko as Chief Revenue Officer, Dave Conte as Chief Financial Officer, and Fermín J. Serna as Chief Security Officer ([Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/databricks-ceo)). Unify's page was last updated on 21 September 2026, so it predates the window.

### Funding and Corporate Finance

The most recent equity round in the materials is a $5 billion raise reported to the SEC on 12 August 2026, with 136 investors ([Lakewave, 2026](https://lakewave.ai/company/databricks)). This falls before the window. Lakewave reports seven equity raises totalling $19.6 billion over 20 months ([Lakewave, 2026](https://lakewave.ai/company/databricks)). A Unify source cites a CNBC headline placing the $5 billion round at a $190 billion valuation ([Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/databricks-ceo)). The CNBC article itself was not in the provided material, so the valuation is unverified here.

### Acquisitions

No acquisition was found in the 30-day window in the provided materials. Unverified: the acquisition history on Wikipedia was truncated in the source material ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)).

## Source Reliability Notes

| Source | Type | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Databricks Newsroom (Nov 2026) | Primary, company | High; authoritative for launch claims |
| Microsoft Learn Release Notes | Primary, platform documentation | High; dated and specific, but staged rollouts apply |
| Lakewave | Third-party aggregator | Medium; useful for hiring counts but contains inconsistent executive titles |
| Fundz | Third-party sales intelligence | Low to medium; the launch summary is useful, but the page is promotional |
| Unify | Third-party sales intelligence | Low to medium; contains an internal inconsistency on Ion Stoica's role and tenure |
| Built In | Aggregated LLM summary, not reviewed by Databricks | Low; headcount (about 2,200) and office count (25) are unverified |
| Flexera | Vendor blog (SaaS management) | Medium; recap dated 30 June 2026, outside the window |
| Atlan | Vendor blog (competing context-layer product) | Medium; potential commercial bias toward the "context layer" thesis |
| Wikipedia | Secondary, crowd-edited | Medium; used only for dated corporate events that cite primary reporting |

The Lakewave executive list also appears to contain implausible entries. It lists several people as "Chief Technology Officer" in the same filing, which conflicts with Unify's listing of Matei Zaharia as CTO ([Unify, 2026](https://www.unifygtm.com/insights/executives/databricks-ceo)). These entries have been excluded from this briefing.

## Items That Could Not Be Sourced

- Revenue, ARR, customer count, or margin figures for 2026 were not present in the materials.
- Pricing for Genie or the second-generation agent was not provided.
- Any confirmed executive appointment or departure in the window was not found.
- Regulatory, legal, or security incidents in the window were not found.
- The Series H press release referenced in the materials has no date or figures in the provided text ([Databricks, n.d.](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-closes-series-h-with-additional-participation-from-strategic-partners)).

## Analyst View

In my assessment, the November activity signals a shift in Databricks's go-to-market logic. The company is making Genie accessible from competitors' front ends, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude ([Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). This suggests Databricks is positioning its data and context layer as the system underneath any assistant, rather than requiring customers to adopt a single Databricks interface. The strategy reduces the risk of losing users to rival assistants, but it also places Databricks in a more complex governance position, because data is accessed through third-party clients.

The hiring pattern supports this reading. Roles in ISV partnerships for security and observability, and an enterprise director role for a regional market, point to a partner-led and enterprise-led distribution model rather than a purely direct sales motion. The large number of open roles is consistent with a company scaling after $5 billion of recent capital, though the postings alone do not show where investment is concentrated.

The cost dimension deserves attention. Budget alerts that trigger webhooks, the inclusion of AI Functions in Unity Gateway budgets from 1 November, and the Auto access default for jobs compute all point to cost governance as a product priority ([Microsoft Learn, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). This is consistent with the "AI cost in focus" theme noted at the Summit ([Atlan, 2026](https://atlan.com/know/ai-agent/databricks/databricks-data-ai-summit-2026-announcements)).

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Governance across third-party clients:** With Genie now reachable from Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude, how are permissions, audit trails, and data residency enforced when a query originates outside the Databricks workspace? Several of these connectors are still in Public Preview or Beta, so what criteria will move them to general availability?

2. **Cost predictability for agent workloads:** Always-on agents that manage long-running work could create unpredictable consumption. What pricing model and default guardrails apply to the second-generation Genie, and how will AI Functions spend in Unity Gateway budgets be forecast for enterprise customers?

# Pre-meeting briefing: Databricks, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026. All facts come from the search results below. No hires were found.

**Scale and growth**
- Ben Horowitz's essay (27 Oct) says Databricks has a revenue run rate above $7B, growing 80% year over year. Its Lakehouse is above $1.5B (growing over 100%) and Lakebase is above $100M. The figures are not audited and the essay gives no further breakdown. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- The same essay says agents now send Databricks more queries than people do. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-horowitz-says-databricks-hit-7b-as-agents-outquery-people)
- Databricks remains private. Its most recent valuation is $190B, and no IPO date or public S-1 had been announced as of October 2026. (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options)

**Launches and product**
- On 11 Nov, Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server. (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents)
- On Wednesday 11 Nov, Databricks launched agentic AI tools that continuously analyze business data. The updated Genie assistant runs in the background and makes proactive suggestions. A separate "Ontology" feature scans an organization's data. (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html)
- Commvault announced Data Activate for Databricks, which is not yet generally available. Early access is planned for December 2026 in select Azure regions. (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai)

**Deals and investment**
- On 20 Oct, HP announced it is moving its customer data platform into Databricks, targeting 40% lower costs. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- Wire headlines on the same page list "Databricks Plans $3B Investment in Europe and the Middle East" (dated 12 Nov) and "Databricks to Invest More Than $500M in the Netherlands." The results give no body text for either. (https://www.hpcwire.com/bigdatawire/2026/10/20/hp-moves-customer-data-platform-into-databricks-eyes-40-lower-costs)
- A company profile lists acquisitions, but the most recent ones fall outside the window: Panther Labs (1 Jun 2026) and Electric DB (1 Aug 2026). The profile itself is undated. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/7LlnrDq1nEGX)

**Gaps:** The Solutions Review weekly roundup (7 Nov) appeared only as a headline, so it contributed no usable facts. No hires were found in the results.

## Open questions
1. Can Databricks confirm the run-rate figures for the platform and for Lakehouse and Lakebase, and how each is defined?
2. How will the $3B Europe and Middle East commitment and the $500M Netherlands investment be deployed, and what does that mean for our region?
3. What is the timing for general availability of the Genie plugins and governed-data integrations such as Commvault's, and how will agent access be priced?

# Canva Meeting Briefing: Developments from 16 October to 15 November 2026

**Prepared for:** Meeting with Canva, 17 November 2026
**Information cut-off:** 15 November 2026
**Coverage window:** Approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026

---

## Executive Summary

Canva's most significant recent event is a restructuring announced on 4 November 2026 that affects 1,271 roles, or 22% of staff. The company describes this as the first major restructuring in its 13-year history ([Buzz Staff, 2026](https://www.news18.com/viral/canva-announces-first-major-layoffs-in-13-years-over-1200-employees-to-face-job-cuts-or-relocation-ws-l-10411859.html)). The change follows a more consequential financial signal from August 2026, when the company cut its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% after AI costs rose faster than expected ([The Information, 2026](https://x.com/theinformation/status/2086158004525699220); [Schulze, 2026](https://startupfortune.com/canva-slashed-its-2026-growth-forecast-after-ai-costs-blew-past-expectations)).

Within the 30-day window, I could verify no new product launches, senior leadership hires, or acquisitions. The product launches cited in Canva's newsroom are either older (May 2026) or undated in the source material, so they are treated separately below.

**My assessment:** The restructuring is best understood as a response to margin and cost pressure combined with slowing growth, not as a direct substitution of staff by AI, which is how Canva itself frames it. The central question for the meeting is whether Canva can bring AI serving costs down fast enough to reaccelerate growth. The layoffs address organisational speed and cost, but they do not by themselves answer that question.

---

## Recent Developments (Last 30 Days)

### Restructuring and Workforce Changes

Co-founder and CEO Melanie Perkins said that 1,271 people would "either lose their jobs, be asked to relocate or change roles" ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). She described it as "without doubt the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history" ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). In her staff communication, Perkins wrote that it had been "our hardest year yet," and that growth had "slowed for the first time in a decade" ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).

The organisational changes include the following:

- Product, Growth and Platform are being merged into one organisation ([LinkedIn News, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)).
- Sydney will become the "primary home" for more product teams ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).
- From next year, hybrid workers will be expected to spend two to three days a week in the office ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).
- Canva has staff in 37 countries, and some roles will move to centralised hubs ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).

Reported severance terms are summarised below. These come from secondary coverage and have not been confirmed against an official Canva document.

| Benefit (as reported) | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Base severance | At least six months' salary, including statutory entitlements | [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| Healthcare | 12 months where Canva already provides coverage | [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| Employee assistance | 12 months of Canva Care, covering family members | [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| Equipment | Employees keep company-issued MacBooks | [LinkedIn News, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140) |
| Start-up support | US$10,000 grants from a Canva Collective Fund, with no equity taken | [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| Career support | Coaching, interview preparation and résumé reviews | [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| Alumni network | Opt-in alumni directory shared with investors and partners | [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |

Canva has not published an exact layoff count. Perkins's figure covers redundancy, role changes and relocation requests combined, so the number of people who actually leave is still unknown ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

### Further Workforce Action Under Consideration

On 3 November, Capital Brief reported that Canva could announce another round of redundancies or a company-wide hiring freeze in November ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). **This is unverified.** It is a report of a report, and I could not locate the original Capital Brief article among the sources provided.

### Valuation Changes

Backers Blackbird Ventures and Airtree reportedly cut Canva's valuation from A$60 billion at the end of last year to about A$49 billion. Canva also reportedly cut its internal valuation because of rising AI expenses ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). Final Round AI reports the same move as a 17% cut to US$34.9 billion from a US$42 billion peak ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). The two figures are consistent once currency is accounted for. The timing of the backer markdown is described as "earlier this year" in the BBC report, so it may predate the 30-day window.

### Product and Technology Activity

| Item | Date | Status in this brief | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Canva Craft, the first in-house image generation model, built to lower AI serving costs | October 2026 (exact date not verified) | Within window (approximate) | [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs) |
| Canva AI 2.0, a conversational platform, research preview | 16 April 2026 | Outside window | [Distill, 2026](https://www.distillintelligence.com/news/canva) |
| "What's New" product roundup (Meta catalogue video tools, chart library, short links, colour themes, presenter notes) | May 2026 | Outside window | [Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/whats-new-may-2026) |
| Canva Brush, a vision-language model for design; Affinity for iPad; Muse from Meta | Undated in source | Cannot confirm timing | [Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/whats-new-may-2026) |

The newsroom page is dated May 2026, but it lists "Introducing Craft" in a "You might also like" section. This is a navigation artefact, and it cannot be used to place Craft's launch date. Note also that the page itself describes its launches as focused on "sharper AI, smoother workflows, and more ways to publish directly from Canva" ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/whats-new-may-2026)).

### Leadership Hires, Deals and Acquisitions

I did not find any verifiable senior leadership hires, board changes or acquisitions in the 30-day window. The most recent acquisition in the sources is Leonardo AI, bought in 2024 ([Schulze, 2026](https://startupfortune.com/canva-slashed-its-2026-growth-forecast-after-ai-costs-blew-past-expectations)). This should be checked directly before the meeting.

---

## Financial and Strategic Context

### Growth Outlook

Canva cut its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% in August 2026 ([The Information, 2026](https://x.com/theinformation/status/2086158004525699220); [Schulze, 2026](https://startupfortune.com/canva-slashed-its-2026-growth-forecast-after-ai-costs-blew-past-expectations)). Perkins told investors the revised figure was "below the ambitious goal we set at the beginning of the year," while calling it strong growth at Canva's scale ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). She also said Canva had slowed the rollout of its AI offerings to improve their economics, rebuild the technology architecture and reduce unit costs ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)).

The Information reported that unexpectedly heavy AI use drove up costs and that Canva was trying to make its AI products cheaper before growth could reaccelerate ([The Information, 2026](https://x.com/theinformation/status/2086158004525699220)).

### Key Operating Metrics

| Metric | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly active users (end 2025) | More than 265 million | [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Paid users (end 2025) | More than 31 million | [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Monthly active user growth in 2025 | 20% | [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| 2026 revenue growth forecast | Cut from 30% to 20% | [Schulze, 2026](https://startupfortune.com/canva-slashed-its-2026-growth-forecast-after-ai-costs-blew-past-expectations) |
| AI servicing cost reduction | Roughly 90%, through in-house models (company-reported) | [Schulze, 2026](https://startupfortune.com/canva-slashed-its-2026-growth-forecast-after-ai-costs-blew-past-expectations) |
| Roles affected by restructure | 1,271 (about 22% of staff) | [Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo) |

Canva's AI servicing cost reduction of roughly 90% is the most important number to verify. It is described in one source as a result of in-house models, and I could not find an independent confirmation.

### Position on AI and Layoffs

Canva says the restructuring is not an AI replacement exercise. The memo does not name AI as a reason, and Canva's position is that affected roles are not being replaced by AI ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). The memo does say that "New technology is transforming what people can create, how they create it, and what they expect from the products they use" ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

The external framing is different. TechCrunch links the forecast cut to "ballooning AI costs" and to competition from ChatGPT and Gemini, whose image tools let people build posters and slides without a design app ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

### Source Reliability Notes

Several sources in the provided material are inconsistent or unreliable:

- **ORM News** states that Canva reached "approximately $3.6B in value." This conflicts with the A$49–60 billion valuation range reported by the BBC and is most likely a data error. I have not used it for valuation ([ORM News, 2026](https://orm-tech.com/news/20260813-canva-cuts-2026-growth-forecast-by-a-third-on-ai-costs)).
- **ORM News** also states that Canva had "roughly $3B in GAAP revenue the prior year." I could not corroborate this from other sources, so I have not relied on it ([ORM News, 2026](https://orm-tech.com/news/20260813-canva-cuts-2026-growth-forecast-by-a-third-on-ai-costs)).
- **Job count:** Distill describes the cut as "1,271 jobs" ([Distill, 2026](https://www.distillintelligence.com/news/canva)). BBC and Final Round AI describe 1,271 roles affected, which includes relocation and role changes ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo); [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). The figure should not be presented as a headcount reduction.
- **Forecast-cut social media reaction:** Public commentary on The Information's headline disputed the logic of linking costs to revenue. This is noise, not evidence, and is not relied on here ([The Information, 2026](https://x.com/theinformation/status/2086158004525699220)).
- **Viral and aggregator coverage** (for example, social media video posts and "viral" news headlines) was treated as lower reliability and used only where it repeated primary reporting.

---

## Analysis

### What Changed

The most important change in the past 30 days is organisational. Merging Product, Growth and Platform into a single unit is an attempt to shorten the path from insight to shipped feature. A LinkedIn commentary piece argues that "the handoff between product and growth is where speed goes to die" ([LinkedIn News, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)). This is commentary, not Canva's own statement, but it describes the intended logic.

### Assessment

In my view, three conclusions follow from the evidence:

1. **The layoffs are a cost and speed measure, not a pivot.** The memo itself stresses fewer management layers, less overlap and small teams with clear ownership ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)). These are structural goals, consistent with a company trying to protect margin while it rebuilds its AI cost base.
2. **The growth problem is the more serious issue.** A 30% to 20% revision is a one-third cut in the growth rate ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). The restructure makes sense only if AI serving costs fall far enough to let growth reaccelerate. The 90% cost reduction claim is therefore the key number to test.
3. **Canva's stated reason and the external framing differ.** The company rejects AI as the cause of job losses, while press coverage links the forecast cut and workforce changes to AI costs and competition. Both can be true: AI costs drove the financial pressure, while the layoffs are described as organisational. The meeting should not assume that either framing is complete.

### Risks to Monitor

- Further workforce action (the reported hiring freeze or cuts) is unconfirmed but would be a second signal of cost pressure ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)).
- Relocation to Sydney and the stricter office attendance policy could drive attrition beyond the formal 1,271 figure ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).
- Competition from general-purpose AI tools may continue to pressure core design subscriptions ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).

---

## Recommended Meeting Focus

- Clarify the actual split between redundancy, role change and relocation, and the expected timeline.
- Test the AI cost-reduction claim with specifics: cost per generation, gross margin trend and the milestones that would trigger a return to higher growth.
- Understand how the merged organisation will change the roadmap, and which products or markets are being deprioritised.

---

## Three Open Questions to Ask

| # | Question | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Of the 1,271 roles affected, how many are expected to exit, change roles or relocate, and is any further round of cuts or a hiring freeze planned for the remainder of 2026? | Separates headcount reduction from relocation, and tests the reported November follow-on action ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). |
| 2 | What AI serving-cost and margin milestones must be reached before Canva expects growth to reaccelerate above the revised 20% forecast, and how confident is the company in the roughly 90% cost reduction? | Tests the central assumption behind the forecast revision and the restructure ([Schulze, 2026](https://startupfortune.com/canva-slashed-its-2026-growth-forecast-after-ai-costs-blew-past-expectations)). |
| 3 | Which products, markets or AI features are being deprioritised or slowed in the merged Product, Growth and Platform organisation, and how will that affect the roadmap for Affinity, Leonardo AI and in-house models? | Reveals strategic trade-offs that the public memo does not disclose ([LinkedIn News, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)). |

---

## Items Requiring Verification Before the Meeting

- The Capital Brief report on a possible November hiring freeze or further cuts ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)).
- The roughly 90% AI servicing cost reduction ([Schulze, 2026](https://startupfortune.com/canva-slashed-its-2026-growth-forecast-after-ai-costs-blew-past-expectations)).
- The exact launch date of Canva Craft, and the dates of Canva Brush, Affinity for iPad and Muse ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/whats-new-may-2026); [Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs)).
- The severance terms, which come from secondary coverage rather than an official Canva document ([Final Round AI, 2026](https://www.finalroundai.com/blog/canva-layoffs); [LinkedIn News, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)).
- Any leadership hires, deals or acquisitions in the window, which I could not verify.

Chris G | VC + Startups on Instagram: "Canva’s 2026 layoffs have a plot twist: the company is helping its former employees become entrepreneurs.

Imagine getting laid off and your employer offers to help fund your next startup. That’s essentially what Canva is doing.

CEO Melanie Perkins announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, or 22% of the workforce. Not all are being laid off; some face role changes or relocation.

But look at the exit package:

→ At least 6 months of salary
→ 12 months of healthcare where available
→ Employees keep their MacBooks
→ $10,000 startup grants through the Canva Collective Fund, with no equity taken
→ Career coaching and LinkedIn Premium

Now here’s what investors should actually pay attention to.

Canva lowered its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% as AI costs put pressure on its business model.

Meanwhile, Product, Growth, and Platform are being consolidated into one organization.

Translation: AI isn’t just changing what software companies sell. It’s changing the cost of delivering their products and how teams need to operate.

And here’s the overlooked opportunity: Canva’s departing talent could become the next generation of startup founders.

Losing your job is never easy. But giving employees financial runway, healthcare, and a chance to build something new is a much better exit than simply handing them a severance check.

The lesson for founders? How you treat employees on the way out says a lot about how you build a company.

Would you rather have six months of severance or a shot at funding your own startup?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Window:** Roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources found date from 2 to 10 November 2026.

## Summary
Canva has restructured sharply in early November, cutting about 22% of its staff. It has also expanded its AI partnership with OpenAI. Reports say a further round of cuts or a hiring freeze may follow, but Canva has not confirmed this.

## Restructuring and layoffs
- Canva is cutting 22% of its workforce, about 1,271 employees, as it flattens its org chart and consolidates teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- The company is merging its product, growth and platform teams and reducing "subspecialisation," which may leave remaining staff with broader roles (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- CEO Melanie Perkins said "small changes won't be enough" and that Canva needs to "re-found" itself around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Departing staff receive at least six months' salary, plus a $US10,000 grant for those starting a business or community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304). They also keep company MacBooks and get a free year of LinkedIn Premium (https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- Capital Brief reported previously unreported finance-division cuts in January, with 32 roles made redundant (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- Reports say Canva could make further redundancies or impose a hiring freeze in November, against a revised revenue growth outlook. Canva has not confirmed this (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).

## AI and partnerships
- Canva expanded its OpenAI deal, gaining broader access to OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 models. The companies will work on making these models cheaper to run. No savings or costs were disclosed (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- The deal came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- OpenAI already powers Canva Code, which builds interactive designs, websites and apps from text descriptions (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

## Marketing
- Canva launched a North America brand platform, "What Will You Canva Today?", created by agency GS&P (Goodby's first work). The campaign opened with TV spots, the first airing during NBC Sunday Night Football on 1 November (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

## Deals and hires
- **Hires:** No relevant Canva hires were found in the sources.
- **Acquisitions:** The only dated acquisitions in the sources are older than 30 days: Ortto (1 Apr 2026), Doohly ($30.00M USD, 1 Mar 2026), Scene Group and MangoAI (both 1 Feb 2026) (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp). No new deals in the window were found.

## Source caveats
Sources disagree on headcount ("1,271" in most reports; "just over 1,200" in Yahoo's tracker). The Tavily profile is undated and may be stale. No primary Canva statement was among the sources.

## Open questions
1. Is a further round of redundancies or a hiring freeze planned for November, and if so, in which teams?
2. How will the OpenAI deal and in-house models change Canva's cost structure and product roadmap, and what savings are expected?
3. What does the revised revenue growth outlook look like, and how do the restructuring and AI investments support it?

# Canva Pre-Meeting Briefing: Restructuring, Growth Outlook and Product Activity (30 Days to 15 November 2026)

**Prepared for:** Meeting with Canva, 17 November 2026
**Review window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026
**Status:** Based solely on the supplied sources. Items that could not be verified within the window are flagged in Section 5.

## 1. Executive Summary

Canva's most significant event in the window is a company-wide restructuring announced on 3 November 2026. The restructuring affects 1,271 people, about 22% of the workforce, through job losses, role changes or relocation to centralised hubs ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). Co-founder and CEO Melanie Perkins described the period as "our hardest year yet" and linked it to slowed growth ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).

The cuts follow a downgraded growth outlook. Canva reportedly reduced its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). Canva attributed the slowdown partly to high AI serving costs and slowed AI rollouts ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva); [AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout)).

**Our assessment:** The restructuring is primarily a response to growth deceleration and AI unit economics, not a direct substitution of staff by AI. The organisational merger of Product, Growth and Platform is the more consequential decision for the company's trajectory than the headcount figure. It targets execution speed, but it also concentrates delivery risk during a period of cost rebuilding.

## 2. What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### 2.1 Chronology

| Date (2026) | Event | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 Nov | Perkins sends "An Important Update on Our Team" to staff; restructuring announced | Confirmed (multiple outlets) | [Varley, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life); [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| 3 Nov | Capital Brief reports possible further cuts or a hiring freeze in November | Reported; original not reviewed | [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| 4 Nov | Wider press coverage; The Register reports Canva has not said how many will leave | Confirmed (secondhand) | [Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo); [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| 6 Nov | Fortune reporting cited on the August forecast cut | Secondhand, not directly reviewed | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| 9 Nov | Commentary on the restructuring published | Analysis, not primary fact | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| 10 Nov | Scheduled company-wide meeting | Scheduled, not verified as held | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| 11 Nov | Reorganised units to begin meeting | Scheduled, not verified as held | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |

### 2.2 Restructuring Details

- **Scale:** 1,271 employees affected, around 22% of the workforce ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). The figure covers people who lose roles, change roles or are asked to relocate, and Canva has not disclosed the number who will leave the company ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).
- **Organisation:** Product, Growth and Platform are merging into one organisation ([LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)). Canva is also naming Sydney the "primary home" for more product teams ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)).
- **Work model:** From next year, hybrid workers are expected to spend two to three days a week in the office ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo); [CTO Magazine, n.d.](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand)).
- **Stated rationale:** Perkins said the decision came after "months of thinking through how to set Canva up for the next chapter" ([Varley, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life)).

### 2.3 Severance and Employee Support (Reported)

Reported terms include at least six months' salary regardless of location, continued healthcare where available, career support, and a $10,000 grant for departing staff starting ventures or community projects ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva)). Other reporting adds 12 months of healthcare, retention of company MacBooks, and removal of the one-year vesting cliff for recent joiners ([LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140); [Amazing Workplaces, n.d.](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)). An opt-in alumni directory has also been created ([LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)). These terms are reported, and we could not verify them against the memo itself in the supplied material.

### 2.4 Financial and Growth Signals

| Metric | Figure | Date / Period | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026 revenue growth forecast | Cut from 30% to 20% | August 2026 | [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137); [Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva) |
| Q2 revenue | $921.9m, up 25.2% YoY, reported as missing guidance | Q2 2026 | [AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout) |
| Monthly active users | More than 265m (end 2025), up 20% during the year | End 2025 | [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Paid users | More than 31m (end 2025) | End 2025 | [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Prior-year revenue | $3.5bn; reportedly free-cash-flow profitable | Prior year | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Cost per AI task | Reported down nearly 90% since Canva AI 2.0 launch | Since April 2026 | [Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canva) |
| AI Pass price | USD $100 per user per month | Not dated in source | [AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout) |

Perkins acknowledged that the revised outlook is "below the ambitious goal we set at the beginning of the year" ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). She also said Canva had slowed the rollout of AI offerings to improve their economics and rebuild the technology architecture ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)).

### 2.5 Valuation Pressure (Earlier in 2026)

Backers Blackbird Ventures and Airtree reportedly downgraded Canva's valuation from A$60bn to about A$49bn ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). Canva also reportedly cut its internal valuation because of rising AI costs ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). A separate source gives a figure of about $35bn ([Amazing Workplaces, n.d.](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026)). The two valuation figures are not directly comparable and were reported at different points, so we treat the reported range as indicative only.

### 2.6 Acquisitions and Product Launches

- **Acquisitions:** The Tracxn database records seven acquisitions in 2026, and its most recent entry is Ortto in April 2026 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY)). Canva's own announcement covers Simtheory and Ortto and mentions Ortto's 40-person team ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/simtheory-ortto-join-canva)). **No acquisition within the 30-day window is verifiable from the supplied sources.**
- **Launches:** The newsroom pages supplied describe Canva AI 2.0, launched in April 2026 and called "the biggest product launch in our history" ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-create-2026-ai)). The "What's New" page is dated May 2026 and covers chart library updates, short links, Meta Catalog integration and TikTok ad publishing ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/whats-new-may-2026)). **No product launch dated within the 30-day window could be verified.**
- **Hiring:** No hiring announcements are verifiable within the window. The only hiring-related item is the reported possibility of a hiring freeze ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)).
- **Deals:** No partnership or commercial deal is verifiable within the window.

## 3. Analysis

### 3.1 Confirmed Facts vs. Inferences

| Statement | Classification | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| 1,271 employees (~22%) affected by the restructuring | Confirmed (multiple outlets) | [Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo); [Varley, 2026](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/canva-major-job-cuts-restructuring-workforce-relocation-working-life) |
| Growth forecast cut from 30% to 20% | Reported by multiple outlets; company acknowledged a lower outlook | [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |

| Implied workforce of about 5,800 | Inference (1,271 ÷ 0.22) | Derived from the figures above |
