### 3.2 Our Assessment

1. **The growth problem is the core issue.** A cut from 30% to 20% is a one-third reduction in the planned growth rate. Perkins describes the period as the first growth slowdown in a decade ([Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo)). A 25.2% year-on-year Q2 growth rate is still strong at scale, but it sits below the earlier ambition ([AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout)). The cuts reflect a reset of the cost base to match a lower growth expectation.

2. **The Product, Growth and Platform merger addresses a real speed problem but carries execution risk.** The argument that a growth function separated by ticket queues slows iteration is credible in an AI-driven market ([LinkedIn News, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)). However, the merger also consolidates decisions into one organisation while Canva is rebuilding AI infrastructure and cutting unit costs. If the rebuild slips further, the merged unit will carry the delay directly. This is our inference, not a reported finding.

3. **Competitive pressure is evident but not quantified.** A report cited by AI Weekly says Canva executives noticed increasing numbers of users turning to ChatGPT instead of Canva ([AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout)). The supplied material does not provide usage data to size this shift.

4. **The severance terms are above typical market practice in the sources.** One analysis describes Canva's 26-week severance as more than double the tech industry average ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). This is a third-party benchmark rather than a verified industry dataset, so we treat it as indicative.

5. **Communication sequencing is deliberate.** Affected staff received optional one-to-one meetings and retained Slack and Gmail access until the end of the week, followed by a company-wide meeting on 10 November and unit meetings from 11 November ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). This is reported, not independently verified.

## 4. Implications for the 17 November Meeting

- The meeting falls one week after the announcement and shortly after the 10–11 November sessions. Canva is likely in the early stages of implementing the new structure, so operational detail may still be settling.
- Discussion should separate headcount exits from role changes and relocations, because the 1,271 figure combines them.
- Any question about AI should be framed around unit economics and rollout timing rather than about AI replacing staff, as the sources do not support the latter.

## 5. Unverified or Limited-Confidence Items

| Valuation figures | A$49bn and about $35bn are not reconciled; timing differs | [Livingstone, 2026](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo); [Amazing Workplaces, n.d.](https://amazingworkplaces.co/canva-layoffs-2026) |
| Q2 revenue figure | Date of the report not stated; appears to predate the window | [AI Weekly, n.d.](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/canva-cuts-revenue-growth-forecast-on-ai-cost-blowout) |
| Newsroom "What's New" page | Dated May 2026, outside window; sidebar shows a later team update, so the page snapshot date is unclear | [Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/whats-new-may-2026) |
| Acquisition data | Tracxn is an aggregator, last updated 1 November, and its tables contain inconsistencies; no in-window deals | [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-canva/__LHKOZhxQIkd1nKd00xe8ZiSIZ1WlxGLsiY4nuztOWOY) |

## 6. Open Questions for Canva

1. **Headcount split and further action.** Of the 1,271 people affected, how many will leave Canva, how many will change roles, and how many will relocate? Is a further reduction or hiring freeze planned for November or December, as reported?

2. **AI economics and rollout timeline.** Canva reports a roughly 90% reduction in the cost of serving an AI task. What is the target cost per task for the rest of 2026 and 2027, and which delayed AI features are now scheduled, given that some were reported as running up to six months late?

3. **Growth ownership in the merged organisation.** Under the combined Product, Growth and Platform structure, who owns the revenue growth target, and how will success be measured? What evidence will Canva use to show that the merger has improved speed to market, given the competitive pressure from general-purpose AI tools?

## 7. Conclusion

Canva's position is that it is reorganising to restore speed and cost discipline after its first growth slowdown in a decade. The sources support that account, but they leave open the scale of actual exits, the timing of AI product delivery, and the commercial effect of competition from general-purpose AI tools. The most useful questions for 17 November concern how the merged organisation will deliver against a 20% growth target while it rebuilds its AI cost base.

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Summary:** Canva has cut about 22% of its workforce and is reorganizing around smaller teams, while expanding its OpenAI partnership. Sources are dated 2–10 November 2026. Reports also say a hiring freeze was under consideration.

**Changes in the last 30 days**

*Layoffs and restructure*
- Canva is cutting 1,271 jobs, about 22% of its workforce, and flattening its org chart (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- The company is merging its product, growth and platform teams and reducing "subspecialisation," which could leave remaining staff with broader responsibilities (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- CEO Melanie Perkins said "small changes won't be enough" and that Canva must "re-found" itself around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Departing employees get at least six months' salary, career coaching, a year of LinkedIn Premium, and $US10,000 grants for new businesses or community projects (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- Before the announcement, Capital Brief reported possible November cuts or a hiring freeze tied to a revised revenue growth outlook (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).
- Capital Brief also reported 32 finance-division redundancies in January (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

*AI and deals*
- Canva expanded its OpenAI deal, gaining broader access to GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6, days after launching its second in-house AI model. No savings or costs were disclosed (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- OpenAI already powers Canva Code (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

*Marketing launch*
- Canva launched a North America brand platform, "What Will You Canva Today?", created by GS&P, with TV spots starting 1 November during NBC Sunday Night Football (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

**Gaps and caveats**
- No new hires were found in the sources.
- The Tavily company profile lists acquisitions from March–April 2026 (Doohly, Ortto, SimTheory), which fall outside a 30-day window. The page is undated, so treat it as background only (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp).
- Source timestamps are inconsistent. The layoff date is given as 3 November in some items and 4 November in others.

# Razorpay: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Coverage window: 16 October to 15 November 2026.*

## Executive Summary

Razorpay's verifiable news flow in the 30 days before this meeting is thin. The most significant confirmed item is the final IFSCA licence for its GIFT City operations, announced on 3 November 2026 ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)). I found no confirmed product launch, leadership hire, or partnership dated within the window. The OpenAI ChatGPT Ads partnership, the AI leadership hires, and the Apple Pay launch all fall just outside it. Reports of a rumoured USD 500 million IPO appear in the source set, but they are unverified and should not be treated as established fact.

My assessment is that the GIFT City licence is the most consequential recent development for a counterparty engaged in cross-border B2B or treasury discussions. The IPO reports should be handled as a conversation topic, not a premise. The platform's active commercial incentive, the 0% platform fee offer for new merchants, is a useful lever for any merchant-side discussion.

## Context: Company Position

Razorpay is headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka, India ([Tavily Knowledge, n.d.](https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7)). According to a Built In profile, it is described as controlling a leading share of India's online payment gateway market, with very high total payment volume and millions of merchants ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/stability-growth)). The same profile reports rising income and core gateway revenue growth in FY24, with acceleration into FY25 ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/stability-growth)). These figures are third-party summaries, and I could not verify the underlying financial statements from the provided material.

The profile also describes a sequenced Southeast Asia expansion: Malaysia entry in 2022, a Singapore launch in March 2025, and plans for three to four more Southeast Asian markets by end-2026 ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/stability-growth)). Whether the end-2026 market target is still on schedule is not confirmed in the sources.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Summary Table

| Date | Development | Category | Within 30-day window? | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 Nov 2026 | Final IFSCA licence for GIFT City | Regulatory | Yes | [Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press) |
| 5 Nov 2026 | Video segment referencing "Razorpay IPO" | Media/Capital markets | Yes, but unverified | [YouTube, 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ciyZPf6NbMI) |
| Undated (2026) | Reports of a rumoured USD 500 million IPO | Capital markets | Date unconfirmed; likely recent | [The Paypers, 2026](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge) |
| 5 Oct 2026 | ChatGPT Ads partnership with OpenAI | Partnership | No (41 days prior) | [Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-partners-with-openai-to-expand-chatgpt-ads-in-india) |
| 4 Aug 2026 | Four senior engineering hires | Leadership | No | [Business Standard, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html) |

### Regulatory: GIFT City IFSCA Licence (3 November 2026)

The most concrete recent development is Razorpay's receipt of the final IFSCA licence for GIFT City. The company says the licence brings global investing, international collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities under a single regulated infrastructure ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)). According to the same release, integration timelines are cut from months to two to three weeks, and key investment platforms are expected to go live soon ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)).

The claimed reduction from months to two to three weeks is a company claim and has not been independently verified. The "soon" timing for investment platform go-lives is also undated. Both are reasonable questions for the meeting.

### Capital Markets: IPO Reports (Unverified)

Two sources in the set reference a potential Razorpay IPO. The Paypers reports that Razorpay is rumoured to seek a USD 500 million IPO, and places it among new-age Indian companies preparing to access public markets over the next 12 to 18 months, alongside PhonePe, Zepto, Oyo, and Infra.Market ([The Paypers, 2026](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-plans-usd-500-mln-ipo-amid-digital-payments-surge)). A BW Disrupt article from 6 October 2026 also describes Razorpay as "IPO-bound" ([BW Disrupt, 2026](https://www.bwdisrupt.com/article/razorpay-partners-with-openai-to-help-indian-brands-advertise-on-chatgpt-626982)).

**Verification flags:**
- The Paypers article is labelled as a rumour and does not show a publication date in the extracted text. Its placement among 13 November 2026 sidebar items suggests recency, but this is an inference.
- A YouTube item dated 5 November 2026 carries the title "Razorpay IPO," but its extracted content contains only page boilerplate. I could not verify what it says ([YouTube, 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ciyZPf6NbMI)).
- No regulatory filing or company confirmation of an IPO was found in the source set.

### Partnerships and Launches

No partnership or product launch dated within the window was confirmed. The OpenAI ChatGPT Ads partnership, announced on 5 October 2026, is just outside the window. Under it, Razorpay's Engage platform helps Indian brands prepare product catalogues and run campaigns on ChatGPT ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-partners-with-openai-to-expand-chatgpt-ads-in-india)). Brands named include Tanishq, Titan, Palmonas, Traya, Tata Neu, and Axis Max Life ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-partners-with-openai-to-expand-chatgpt-ads-in-india)). The company also says it uses an AI agent to track campaign performance and adjust campaigns, with human oversight ([BW Disrupt, 2026](https://www.bwdisrupt.com/article/razorpay-partners-with-openai-to-help-indian-brands-advertise-on-chatgpt-626982)).

A MitchelLake page lists related items titled "Product Launch · 2026-10-01" and "Partnership · 2026-10-05," but the titles are not provided, so they cannot be verified ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-strategic-hiring-2026-08-08)).

### Leadership and Hiring

No leadership hire dated within the window was confirmed. The most recent verified cluster is from August 2026. Razorpay hired four senior engineering executives from Microsoft, Salesforce, CRED, and Divyam.ai to build AI-driven financial infrastructure ([Business Standard, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)). The hires are Sudhir Reddy, Abhishek Agarwal, Bhavya Shivaprakash, and Anuj Mathur ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-strategic-hiring-2026-08-08)). CTO and co-founder Shashank Kumar said the hires will help build "AI-native financial infrastructure for businesses around the world" ([Business Standard, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)).

Earlier leadership moves remain relevant context. Praburam Rambadran joined as Senior Vice President, Engineering, in September 2025 ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2025](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-strengthens-tech-leadership-appoints-ex-google-leader-prabu-rambadran-as-sr-vice-president-engineering)). A LinkedIn post from Analytics India Magazine notes that since his arrival the company has shipped Agentic Payments, Agent Studio, and Connected Banking Agents ([Analytics India Magazine, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)).

## Ongoing Commercial Offer: 0% Platform Fee for New Merchants

Although not a 30-day development, Razorpay's 90-day 0% platform fee offer shapes merchant-facing discussions. Key terms from the company's guide:

| Term | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Eligibility date | KYC completed and account activated on or after 1 July 2026 | [Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026) |
| Credit amount | ₹5,00,000 Amount Credits, auto-applied | [Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026) |
| Duration | 90 days from activation | [Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026) |
| One redemption per PAN or bank account | Only the first activated MID qualifies | [Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026) |
| Pre-existing merchants | Those who transacted before 1 July 2026 are disqualified | [Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026) |
| Exclusions | Prepaid cards, corporate credit cards, AMEX, Diners Club, and all EMI-based methods | [Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026) |
| Unused credits | Lapse at the end of 90 days and cannot be redeemed for cash | [Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026) |

The guide cites a standard cost of 2% plus 18% GST on the fee. At ₹1 lakh monthly GMV, that is roughly ₹28,320 a year, which I checked: ₹12 lakh annual GMV × 2% = ₹24,000, plus 18% GST gives ₹28,320 ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).

**Analytical note:** The guide says the offer can end before day 90 if the ₹5,00,000 cap is exhausted. However, it is not stated whether credits are measured at fee value or transaction value. If they are measured at fee value, a merchant at roughly ₹1 lakh monthly GMV would consume only about ₹2,360 per month, so the 90-day window would bind long before the cap. This assumption needs confirmation against the live terms, which the guide itself says should be read directly.

## Analysis and Assessment

**1. Regulatory expansion is the strongest signal.** The IFSCA licence allows Razorpay to offer cross-border collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities through a single regulated entity ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)). For a counterparty, this may matter more than any product announcement, provided the go-live timeline holds.

**2. The AI narrative is consistent but the recent evidence is older.** The company's AI positioning is clear and repeated across its hires, the Vulcan model, and agentic commerce work ([Business Standard, 2026](https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-boosts-ai-push-with-senior-hires-from-microsoft-salesforce-cred-126080401040_1.html)). The most recent verified AI-related items, however, are from August to early October. No new AI launch was confirmed in the last 30 days.

**3. The IPO is a live but unconfirmed topic.** Multiple sources reference it, but none provides a filing, a timeline, or company confirmation. I would treat it as a question rather than a premise.

**4. Merchant acquisition is being pushed with pricing.** The 0% offer and its tight eligibility rules suggest Razorpay is competing for new, first-time merchants rather than existing ones. The exclusions also show that premium payment methods carry standard fees, which may matter for merchants with corporate or premium card volumes.

## Verification Log

| Item | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| IFSCA licence (3 Nov) | Confirmed by company | Stated in company newsroom; independent confirmation not found |
| Investment platform go-live "soon" | Unverified | No date given |
| USD 500 million IPO | Unverified rumour | Labelled rumoured; no filing found |
| YouTube IPO video (5 Nov) | Unverified content | Only title and boilerplate extracted |
| Product Launch (1 Oct) and Partnership (5 Oct) on MitchelLake | Unverified | Titles not provided; 1 Oct is outside window |
| Built In financial growth claims | Third-party summary | Underlying financials not provided |
| Sources not used | Excluded | A job-listing page (knok.work) was promotional and not relevant to business analysis; a Tavily entity page had no substantive content |

## Recommended Open Questions for the Counterparty

1. **GIFT City go-live:** Which investment platforms and cross-border products will go live first under the IFSCA licence, and what is the realistic timeline for the two-to-three-week integration cycle the company has announced for partners and merchants?

2. **IPO status:** Can you confirm whether Razorpay has started any IPO process, including regulatory filings, and how the company thinks about disclosure of material information while reports of a USD 500 million offering are circulating?

3. **Merchant economics after the offer:** How many merchants currently sit in the 90-day window, what share of them are expected to move to standard pricing (2% plus GST for covered methods), and what retention tools exist for merchants whose credits lapse, given that unused credits cannot be extended or redeemed for cash?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Razorpay
**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026
**Coverage window:** approx. 18 Oct – 17 Nov 2026

## Summary
Razorpay's IPO has moved through the regulatory process in the last 30 days. SEBI issued its final observations on the draft offer documents, and shareholders approved a fresh issue plus an offer for sale. The company also received a final licence to expand cross-border payments from GIFT City. I found no sourced news on hires or deals beyond the IPO.

## Regulatory and IPO
- SEBI gave its final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November, and the approval was reported on 13 November. Reuters had earlier reported that the company confidentially filed draft papers in June for an IPO of about $600 million. (https://www.thehindu.com/business/indian-fintech-firm-razorpay-gets-regulatory-nod-for-ipo/article71698143.ece)
- Shareholders approved a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 2,700 crore, alongside an offer for sale (OFS) that lets existing investors partly sell their holdings. Axis Capital, JPMorgan, Citi and Kotak Mahindra Capital are advising on the issue. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Inc42 headlined the approval as a ₹6,000 crore IPO, published 4 November. (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo)
- Before the approval, an industry roundup expected Razorpay to raise ₹5,000–6,000 crore through a fresh issue plus OFS. It said the price band and offer structure would be disclosed once the company files its Red Herring Prospectus (RHP). (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ip-os-mahanadi-coalfields-oyo-cult-fit-carlsberg-india-are-among-big-ticket-ip-os-expected-after-jio-platforms-listing/article-202719)

## Launches and Licences
- Razorpay received a final licence to expand cross-border payments from GIFT City. I only saw this as a headline on a Business Standard page dated 9 November, so the details are unverified. (https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/ifsca-proposes-model-portfolios-in-gift-city-by-research-entities-126110900766_1.html)

## Headcount (undated source)
- A company profile lists headcount at 4,033, down 16 over the year (−0.4%) and down 23 over the quarter. Southern Asia accounts for 3,102 staff. The profile is undated, so treat this as a snapshot rather than a 30-day change. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7)

## Hires and Deals
- No sourced reports of executive hires or acquisitions in the window. The only deal activity found is the IPO advisory mandate listed above.

## Source Notes
- The fresh-issue figure (₹2,700 crore) and the headline IPO size (₹6,000 crore) differ. Confirm the final offer structure before relying on either number.
- The ET synopsis is truncated at "Razorpay aims to secure Rs 5," so the target amount is not confirmed.

## Open Questions
1. What is the final offer size and split between the fresh issue (₹2,700 crore per ET) and the OFS, and when do you expect to file the RHP and set the price band?
2. What is the timeline and scope for the GIFT City cross-border payments licence, and will it affect the revenue or cost outlook presented to investors?
3. Headcount appears to be drifting down. Are there hiring or restructuring plans, especially around the IPO and the cross-border expansion?

runs.briefing:
# Razorpay Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Briefing Scope and Method

### Time Window and Basis

This briefing covers the 30 days before the report date of 15 November 2026, which runs from 16 October to 15 November 2026. Items dated outside that window are flagged in a separate section and are not treated as recent developments. Several items in the provided material carry no explicit date. These are labelled "undated" and are not presented as confirmed within the window.

### Source Reliability

Official Razorpay newsroom and blog pages were treated as primary sources for company statements. Third-party trade and industry outlets were used for corroboration and for reported (unconfirmed) claims. Job-board marketing, an entity-index page without content, and a video page with only footer text were excluded (see the final section).

## Executive Summary

Razorpay's most verifiable development in the last 30 days is the **final IFSCA licence for GIFT City**, announced on 3 November 2026. This licence is the company's clearest regulatory milestone in the period, and it supports a cross-border strategy. The most material unverified item is a **reported SEBI approval for an IPO**, which The Paypers describes as "reportedly" granted, with no confirmed date in the material provided. Product activity in the window centres on the **Sprint26 product release cycle** and the company's **AI-led positioning**, although the most prominent AI launches (Vulcan, RAY, Agentic Payments) fall outside the window.

**Analytical view:** Razorpay's public messaging in this period points to a shift from payment acceptance toward bundled regulated infrastructure, covering cross-border money movement, AI-driven payments, and banking. The IPO report, if confirmed, would change how much of this strategy becomes externally verifiable, since public-market disclosure would expose metrics that are currently only company-reported.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days (16 October – 15 November 2026)

### Regulatory and Corporate Milestones

Razorpay announced that it had received its final IFSCA licence for GIFT City. The company says the licence brings global investing, international collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities under a single regulated infrastructure ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026, November 3](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)). Razorpay also claims the licence cuts integration timelines "from months to 2–3 weeks," and says key investment platforms will "go live soon" ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026, November 3](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/press)). These timeline claims are company statements and have not been independently verified.

The Paypers reports that Razorpay has "reportedly" received a SEBI nod for an IPO ([The Paypers, n.d.](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-receives-sebi-approval-for-ipo)). The article's date is not visible in the material provided, so its timing relative to the window cannot be confirmed. The article also describes Razorpay's scope as covering payment acceptance, business banking, payouts, payroll, and lending, and reports investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV Partners, GIC, Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Lone Pine Capital, Alkeon Capital, and TCV ([The Paypers, n.d.](https://thepaypers.com/payments/news/razorpay-reportedly-receives-sebi-approval-for-ipo)). These investor details are historical and are not new in the window.

### Product Launches

Sprint26 is described as Razorpay's annual product launch, with the 2026 edition including over 100 product updates across six verticals: Agentic Stack, International Payments, Payment Gateway, D2C, Marketing, and Business Banking ([Awwwards, 2026, November 12](https://www.awwwards.com/razorpay-sprint26-the-future-of-payments.html)). The source is a design-showcase article, so the claim is useful for scope but is not an independent audit of the launches. The event's exact date is not stated in the material.

The company's FTX 2026 keynote, shared through a LinkedIn post, introduced four launches: Agentic Platform, Agentic Payments (enabling AI to complete transactions on behalf of users), Agent Studio, and Agentic Business Banking ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/razorpay_keynote-reimagining-money-movement-activity-7437771494610411520-QuVn)). This post is undated in the material, so it is treated as unconfirmed for the window.

### Leadership and Talent

Analytics India Magazine reports that Razorpay has added four senior engineering leaders: Sudhir Reddy (former CTO and co-founder of Divyam.AI), who joins as senior-most individual contributor for AI and data architecture; Abhishek Agarwal (Microsoft); Bhavya S. (Salesforce); and Anuj Mathur (CRED) ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)). The post is undated. The same source notes that these hires follow Praburam Rambadran's arrival as SVP of Engineering in September 2025, after which Razorpay shipped Agentic Payments, Agent Studio, and Connected Banking Agents ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)).

### Deals and Partnerships

No new partnership was confirmed with a date inside the window. The OpenAI partnership and the Vulcan launch both fall outside it (see below).

## Items Outside the 30-Day Window

The following items are relevant context but fall outside the window and should not be presented as recent news.

Built In is an employee-review platform, and its forward-looking market plans are unverified. The same source reports rising FY24 and FY25 revenue and record TPV, without figures in the material provided ([Built In, n.d.](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/stability-growth)).

## Commercial Context: The 0% Platform Fee Offer

Razorpay's 90-day 0% platform fee offer is a live merchant-acquisition term and may be relevant to a meeting if the user or their organisation is a prospective merchant. The key terms, as published on the company blog, are summarised below ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)).

| Term | Detail | Clause |
|---|---|---|
| Eligibility date | KYC completed and activated on or after 1 July 2026 | Clause 1 |
| Credit amount | ₹5,00,000 in Amount Credits, auto-applied | Step 3 |
| MID limit | Only the first activated Merchant ID per PAN or bank account qualifies | Clause 7 |
| Prior transactors | Merchants who transacted on Razorpay before 1 July 2026 are disqualified | Clause 8 |
| Excluded methods | Prepaid cards, corporate credit cards, AMEX, Diners Club, and all EMI-based methods | Clause 5 |
| Unused credits | Lapse at the end of 90 days and cannot be carried forward or redeemed for cash | Clause 10 |
| Standard fee | 2% plus 18% GST on the fee, per the blog's example | n/a |

The blog notes that the offer can end before day 90 if the ₹5,00,000 cap is exhausted first ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)). The blog also advises that the "exact offer duration, the activation date, and any caps are governed by the official terms," so the terms in the dashboard should be checked directly ([Razorpay Blog, 2026](https://razorpay.com/blog/razorpay-0-percent-platform-fee-offer-90-days-new-merchants-2026)). The offer is undated in the material and is therefore treated as current but not confirmed as a window event.

## Analytical Assessment

**1. Regulated cross-border infrastructure is the most concrete near-term signal.** The GIFT City licence is a formal regulatory outcome, which distinguishes it from product announcements. Its commercial impact depends on the "2–3 week" integration claim and on which investment platforms go live. Until those launches are visible, the claim should be treated as a company target.

**2. The IPO report is the largest potential change, but it is not yet verifiable.** A reported SEBI approval would normally be followed by public filings, which would expose audited financials and unit economics. The material does not contain financial figures for FY25 or FY26, so no financial conclusions should be drawn from it.

**3. AI-led positioning is consistent across the period, but the flagship launches are older.** The hiring of four senior engineering leaders in AI and data, and the reference to Agentic Payments, suggest sustained investment. However, Vulcan, RAY, and the first Agentic Payments launch sit outside the window, so the company's most recent AI *news* in the period is comparatively thin.

**4. Merchant acquisition appears to be intensifying.** The 0% offer, with a ₹5,00,000 cap and exclusions for premium methods, is designed to steer merchants toward UPI and standard cards. The exclusions indicate the company is protecting its higher-margin categories. Taken together, these terms suggest a deliberate push for volume at low initial price, with monetisation expected after the window closes.

## Open Questions to Ask

1. **IPO status and disclosure:** Can Razorpay confirm the status of the reported SEBI approval, and what timeline and disclosure obligations apply before any listing? This determines whether the metrics discussed in the meeting can be shared or should remain confidential.

2. **Agentic payments governance:** For Agentic Payments, which allow AI to complete transactions on behalf of users, how are liability, dispute resolution, and fraud responsibility allocated between Razorpay, the merchant, the AI platform, and the end customer?

3. **Post-offer pricing and retention:** After the 0% window and the ₹5,00,000 cap, what standard pricing will apply to merchants onboarded under the offer, and what retention data does Razorpay track to show how many merchants remain after the standard rate resumes?

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Razorpay

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window reviewed:** roughly 30 days to 14 November 2026. All facts below come from the search results provided.

## Summary

Razorpay has cleared the main regulatory step for an IPO. The most recent news is about the listing, with one GIFT City licence as the other notable item. I found no sourced facts on hires or deals beyond IPO advisers.

## What changed

**IPO approval**
- India's market regulator SEBI approved Razorpay's IPO, according to a document shown on Friday, 13 November 2026. The company had confidentially filed draft papers in June for an IPO of about $600 million, per Reuters. (https://www.thehindu.com/business/indian-fintech-firm-razorpay-gets-regulatory-nod-for-ipo/article71698143.ece)
- SEBI issued its final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Razorpay's shareholders approved a fresh share issue worth ₹2,700 crore, plus an offer for sale (OFS) in which existing investors can sell part of their holdings. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Axis Capital, JPMorgan, Citi and Kotak Mahindra Capital are advising on the offering. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Inc42 reported the SEBI nod on 4 November for an IPO it sized at ₹6,000 crore. The source was only a headline and summary, so the figure is unverified. (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo)
- Earlier coverage put the expected raise at ₹5,000–6,000 crore, through a fresh issue plus OFS, with price band and structure to follow in the red herring prospectus (RHP). (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ip-os-mahanadi-coalfields-oyo-cult-fit-carlsberg-india-are-among-big-ticket-ip-os-expected-after-jio-platforms-listing/article-202719)

**Launch**
- Razorpay received a final licence to expand cross-border payments from GIFT City. This is a headline on a Business Standard page dated 9 November, and I did not see the article body. (https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/ifsca-proposes-model-portfolios-in-gift-city-by-research-entities-126110900766_1.html)

**Hires and headcount**
- A company profile lists headcount at 4,033, down 16 year-on-year and 23 quarter-on-quarter, with 2 added in the last month. The page is undated, so it may fall outside the 30-day window. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7)

**Deals**
- No sourced deals found beyond IPO advisers and the GIFT City licence.

## Source gaps and conflicts

- **Issue size:** Sources give $600 million (The Hindu), ₹5,000–6,000 crore (Upstox), ₹6,000 crore (Inc42), and ₹2,700 crore fresh issue plus OFS (ET). These are not reconciled. The RHP should settle the figure.
- **Approval date:** ET says SEBI's observations were dated 3 November, while The Hindu reports the approval document was shown on 13 November.
- **Unusable result:** A market-movers article from HDFC Sky did not mention Razorpay in the excerpt, so I excluded it.

## Open questions

1. Once SEBI has approved the IPO, when will the RHP be filed, and how will the final size split between the ₹2,700 crore fresh issue and the OFS? (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
2. What does the GIFT City cross-border licence allow, and when will the expanded service go live? (https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/ifsca-proposes-model-portfolios-in-gift-city-by-research-entities-126110900766_1.html)
3. With headcount reported down year-on-year, what are the hiring plans for the next 12 months, and will the IPO proceeds fund any of them? (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7)

# Infosys Pre-Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026 | **Review window:** 18 October to 17 November 2026 | **Purpose:** Pre-meeting context for a 17 November 2026 discussion with Infosys

---

## Executive Summary

Infosys's last 30 days were dominated by three themes: a recurring stream of client and partner announcements (Truist, Canada's UNI Financial, Columbia University), a strategic workforce pivot toward specialist and AI-era roles, and a leadership succession already in motion with a CEO-designate named. Share-price weakness during the period, including a sharp one-day sell-off on 28 October tied to AI-trade concerns, suggests investors are still testing whether AI reduces the revenue base of traditional IT services. Several items carry weak or missing date and primary-source verification and are flagged in Section 7.

---

## 1. Key Facts at a Glance

| Indicator | Figure | Date | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reported revenue (cited) | ~US$20 billion | Oct–Nov 2026 | [Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) |
| Employees | 328,594 | March 2026 | [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys) |
| Market capitalisation | ₹4.66 lakh crore | Around 19 Oct 2026 | [StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement) |
| Share price (approx.) | ~₹1,145 (derived) | 13 Nov 2026 | [Moneycontrol, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT) |
| 52-week range | ₹980.40 to ₹1,728.00 | 13 Nov 2026 | [Moneycontrol, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT) |
| Day change | −0.84% | 13 Nov 2026 | [Moneycontrol, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT) |

*Note: The share price is approximated from the reported −₹9.70 move (−0.84%). The 52-week drawdown of roughly one-third is my calculation from these figures.*

---

## 2. What Changed: Corporate Calendar and Market Context

### 2.1 Financial Calendar

Infosys announced that it would release its second-quarter earnings on 23 October 2026, with a press conference at 4:30 p.m. IST and an earnings call at 6:00 p.m. IST ([StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement)). An earnings call transcript was filed under SEBI Regulation 30 on 28 October 2026 ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). **The actual Q2 FY27 results figures are not contained in the materials I reviewed and should be pulled from the filing before the meeting.**

Infosys also filed notice of an Investor Conference on 4 November 2026 ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). Infosys was among more than 40 companies with record dates during 2–6 November 2026 for dividends, bonuses, rights issues, or splits, though the specific entitlement is not confirmed in the sources reviewed ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).

### 2.2 Market Reaction

Infosys, TechM, TCS, and other IT stocks fell up to 5% on 28 October 2026 as a global AI trade rebound extended losses ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). Broader sentiment improved in early November. Sensex gained 1,233 points on 2 November, and foreign portfolio investors returned to net buying of about $1.2 billion over ten sessions, partly attributed to reconsideration of AI-related bets ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).

### 2.3 Regulatory and Reputational Items

- **France labour fine.** Infosys was fined €175,000 in July 2026 by DRIEETS Île-de-France after its working-time recording system was found to breach French labour rules ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)). This predates the review window but remains relevant to compliance discussions. A separate Deccan Herald report dated 29 July 2026 describes a ₹2 crore fine over time tracking ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)); the two figures should be reconciled before quoting either.
- **Hiring-test integrity.** A Times of India report dated 9 June 2026 described impersonation and cheating that paused hiring tests at Infosys ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)). This is outside the window but bears on talent-pipeline integrity.

---

## 3. Product and Platform Activity

No new flagship product launch was confirmed within the review window. The most concrete platform activity was client-facing deployments of Finacle, Infosys's banking platform:

- **Infosys Canada and UNI Financial Cooperation** advanced branch modernisation using Finacle Universal Banker, announced on 28 October 2026 ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).
- **Qorus-Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards 2026** winners were announced on 29 October 2026 ([Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).

Infosys's AI platform and Cobalt cloud offering were referenced in background material, but I found no evidence of a new launch dated within the window. **Flag:** The Cobalt citation on Wikipedia is dated 2025 and is therefore excluded from this period's activity.

---

## 4. Leadership and Workforce

### 4.1 Leadership Transition

The most significant leadership development is the designation of **Ashiss Kumar Dash as CEO-designate**. He shared the stage with incumbent CEO Salil Parekh at the Americas Confluence event in Washington, DC, where they discussed generating value from AI ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). The source does not state a handover date. **This should be confirmed directly with Infosys**, since it affects who should attend and who owns the strategic agenda after the meeting.

### 4.2 Workforce Strategy

Per Times of India, citing people familiar with discussions and three analysts, Infosys plans to shift up to one-third of its roughly 320,000 employees into specialist roles and build a team of 6,000 "frontier engineers" as AI reshapes IT work ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). Infosys reportedly said it has not restructured, which the report describes as a different approach from many peers. It is recruiting from leading Indian institutes and US campuses, often competing with AI labs for the same candidates. In some deals it is absorbing clients' surplus staff and redeploying them ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

**Discrepancy:** The Times of India figure of ~320,000 employees differs from Wikipedia's 328,594 as of March 2026 ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)). The difference may reflect timing, but I cannot confirm it from the sources.

### 4.3 Hiring and Pay

A People Matters post on LinkedIn reports that Infosys announced a phased salary revision beginning in October and reaffirmed its commitment to hire 20,000 freshers in the current financial year ([People Matters, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/people-matters_infosys-leadership-futureofwork-activity-7486351991623864320-xVwR)). A separate post on the same page says headcount fell by 532 in Q1 FY27 despite more than 4,000 fresher hires ([Business Connect Magazine, 2026](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/people-matters_infosys-leadership-futureofwork-activity-7486351991623864320-xVwR)). **Flag:** Both posts are dated only as "3 months" ago on the scrape, so their publication dates cannot be verified. The Q1 FY27 figures probably predate the window. Treat them as unverified until checked against the company's filings.

---

## 5. Deals, Partnerships, and Client Wins

| Date | Counterparty | Activity | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Oct 2026* | Columbia University | Launched Infosys Topaz–Columbia University Enterprise AI Center focused on responsible enterprise AI | [Unite.AI, 2026](https://www.unite.ai/infosys-and-columbia-university-launch-enterprise-ai-research-center) |
| 19 Oct 2026 | Truist | Expanded strategic partnership to build a Hyderabad Global Capability Center, onboarding 1,000+ employees | [StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement) |
| 28 Oct 2026 | UNI Financial Cooperation (Canada) | Branch modernisation using Finacle Universal Banker | [Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms) |
| 30 Oct 2026 | Internal (Hyderabad) | Expansion of Pocharam Development Center | [Economic Times, 2026](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms) |
| 12 Nov 2026 | Infosys Science Foundation | Infosys Prize 2026 awarded to six researchers | [Moneycontrol, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT) |

*The Columbia announcement is dated 1 October, which is outside the 30-day window. It is included for context.

**Assessment:** The Truist GCC is the most commercially significant item in the window. It reflects a trend in which clients consolidate vendors and move work into captive-style operations that Infosys runs or co-runs. This is a revenue model to probe at the meeting. The Pocharam expansion and the Truist GCC both point to Hyderabad as a delivery hub.

**Flag:** The Truist details come from an aggregator page that summarises the filing with AI-generated text ([StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement)). The contract value is not disclosed, and the primary exchange filing was not reviewed.

**Flag:** Wikipedia cites a Reuters report of a US$1.6 billion UK NHS deal, dated 14 October 2025 and retrieved 7 July 2026 ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)). This appears to be a 2025 event, outside the window, and no URL was provided, so I have not relied on it.

---

## 6. Analyst View

In my assessment, Infosys is in a deliberate transition rather than a crisis. Three signals support that reading:

1. **The workforce pivot is substantive.** Reassigning up to a third of staff to specialist roles and building a 6,000-person frontier-engineering cohort is a material bet on AI-era skills. If executed, it protects margins against commoditised work. If it lags, it risks attrition among experienced staff and loss of talent to AI labs.
2. **Client consolidation is a double-edged signal.** The Truist GCC deepens an account, but it also shows clients insourcing capability through captive centres. The growth question is whether Infosys captures the operating layer of those centres or loses scope.
3. **The valuation reflects scepticism.** A share price roughly a third below its 52-week high, plus a sharp sell-off on AI-trade concerns, suggests the market doubts that AI will expand services revenue fast enough to offset deflation. Management's answer on pricing and productivity will be central.

Infosys has not yet clearly quantified the revenue contribution of the new specialist roles or the cost of reskilling. That gap is the most important point to press on.

---

## 7. Verification Flags

| Item | Issue | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Q2 FY27 results content | Date confirmed; figures not in materials reviewed | Pull the results filing |
| Dividend/record date (2–6 Nov) | Infosys named in list; entitlement not stated | Confirm in exchange filing |
| Times of India workforce article | Publication date not visible in extract | Confirm date and "last week" reference |
| Headcount (320,000 vs 328,594) | Conflicting figures | Reconcile against annual report |
| Salary revision and 20,000 fresher target | Source is a LinkedIn post with no verifiable date | Verify with company statement |
| Q1 FY27 headcount decline (−532) | Source dated only "3 months" ago; likely pre-window | Verify with Q1 FY27 results |
| Truist deal details | Aggregator AI-generated summary | Verify with primary filing |
| France fine (€175,000 vs ₹2 crore) | Two figures, different sources | Reconcile before citing |
| Reuters NHS deal (US$1.6bn) | Dated 2025; no URL provided | Exclude unless confirmed |
| Ashiss Kumar Dash succession timing | No effective date given | Confirm with Infosys |
| YouTube CEO interview | Title only; no transcript or content | Review directly before citing |

**Excluded sources:** A PW Skills blog on Infosys hiring and a Built In employer profile were not used. Both are marketing or generic content, and the Built In page states its insights are AI-generated and not verified.

---

## 8. Three Open Questions for 17 November

1. **Workforce economics:** Of the up-to-one-third of staff planned for specialist roles, what share is expected to be funded through reskilling versus redeployment, what is the cost, and how will it affect margins and utilisation over the next four quarters?
2. **Leadership transition:** When will Ashiss Kumar Dash assume the CEO role, and how will the AI and talent strategies presented at the Americas Confluence change under his leadership?
3. **Captive and GCC model:** Following the Truist expansion, how does Infosys price and capture value from client-owned or co-run GCCs, and what share of its large-deal pipeline is now structured this way?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** 18 October to 17 November 2026. All facts below come from the search results provided.

## What changed

**Q2 results and guidance (23 Oct)**
- Q2 revenue was $5,145M. Reported revenue rose 1.3% year over year, and constant-currency growth was 1.5% year over year and 1.2% sequentially. Operating margin was 21.0%. AI revenue grew 29% sequentially to 10.5% of revenue. (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html)
- Large-deal total contract value reached $5.2B, 62% of it net new, including one deal above $2B. (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html)
- The ADR fell over 7% after Infosys lowered its annual revenue growth guidance. (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/infosys-adr-falls-over-7-as-it-major-lowers-annual-revenue-growth-guidance-everything-investors-need-to-know/article-202325)
- Results were followed by a management press conference and an earnings call. (https://www.niftytrader.in/markets/stocks-to-watch-today-oct-23-jio-infosysq2)

**Market reaction and analyst views**
- Shares fell 6.5% on 27 Oct after Q2 EPS missed estimates by $0.01. (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)
- BMO Capital raised its price target to $13 and kept a Market Perform rating on 26 Oct. (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)
- Infosys reported a decline in North America revenue amid sector slowdowns on 23 Oct. (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)
- A block trade of ₹69.49 crore was executed on the NSE on 23 Oct. (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)

**Investor relations**
- Management will attend non-deal roadshows in London and Edinburgh in November. (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)

**Launches and infrastructure**
- A new 1.1M sq ft block at the Pocharam campus in Hyderabad targets emerging technologies. (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/infosys-sets-up-new-1-1m-sq-ft-block-at-pocharam-campus-in-hyderabad-to-cater-to-emerging-technologies/articleshow/135366954.cms)
- The Hyderabad campus expansion was inaugurated with Telangana's Deputy Chief Minister, the IT Minister and CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka. It serves banking, retail, life sciences and manufacturing clients and includes radiant cooling and rainwater harvesting. Shares slid over 2% on the day. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)

**Hiring**
- Infosys expanded its Truist GCC in India and onboarded 1,000 colleagues on 19 Oct. (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)
- The company employs over 325,000 people across 59 countries. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)

**Other**
- The Infosys Prize 2026 was announced on 12 Nov in Bengaluru, with six researchers each receiving USD 100,000. (https://news.careers360.com/infosys-prize-2026-scholars-from-tifr-princeton-carnegie-mellon-uc-san-ranscisco-new-south-wales-singapore-universities-winners)

**Gaps:** The results contain no deal announcements beyond the Q2 totals, no sourced details on the Truist GCC or the roadshow dates, and nothing dated after 12 Nov. Some items are headlines only, and several share a single listing page rather than individual articles.

## Open questions

1. Given the guidance cut and the North America slowdown, what is management's revised view on growth in North America for the next two quarters?
2. How is AI revenue, now 10.5% of the total, being converted into large-deal wins, and what share of the $5.2B TCV pipeline is expected to close in the next quarter?
3. What are the hiring and capacity plans behind the Pocharam expansion and the Truist GCC onboarding, and how do they align with current demand?

# Infosys Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026 | **Look-back window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026 | **Meeting date:** 17 November 2026

## Executive Summary

Infosys's most consequential recent signal is a workforce strategy, not a product launch. Management reportedly plans to move up to one-third of its roughly 320,000 employees into specialist roles and build a team of 6,000 "frontier engineers," while stating that it has not restructured ([The Times of India, n.d.](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). A CEO-designate, Ashiss Kumar Dash, was also named alongside incumbent CEO Salil Parekh ([The Times of India, n.d.](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). Deal activity in the window was led by a Truist partnership to build a Hyderabad Global Capability Center (GCC) ([StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement)). Share-price sentiment is weak relative to the 52-week range ([Moneycontrol, n.d.](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT)).

## Material Changes in the Last 30 Days

### News and Market Context

- **Sector sell-off (28 October):** Infosys, TechM, TCS and other IT stocks fell up to 5% as the global AI trade rebounded ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).
- **Q2 results:** StockFin reports that Infosys scheduled its Q2 release for 23 October 2026, with a press conference at 4:30 p.m. IST and an earnings call at 6:00 p.m. IST ([StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement)). An earnings call transcript was filed under Regulation 30 on 28 October ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). **The sources do not include the reported Q2 revenue, margin or guidance figures.** These must be checked against the filing before the meeting.
- **Foreign investor flows (early November):** Foreign portfolio investors returned to net buying of Indian equities, with about $1.2 billion invested over ten sessions. Analysts linked the shift partly to concerns about the AI trade ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).
- **Share price (13 November):** Moneycontrol shows a day range of ₹1,135.50 to ₹1,155.00, a change of −₹9.70 (−0.84%), and a 52-week range of ₹980.40 to ₹1,728.00 ([Moneycontrol, n.d.](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT)). The page text is partly garbled, so the exact closing price should be confirmed. On these figures, the stock trades about 33% below its 52-week high and about 18% above its 52-week low.
- **Investor conference (4 November):** Infosys filed an announcement for an investor conference. The sources do not state its date, format or content ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).

### Product and Platform Launches

- **Finacle deployments:** Infosys Canada's UNI Financial Cooperation advanced branch modernization using Infosys Finacle Universal Banker (28 October) ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)). This is a client deployment, not a new product launch.
- **Finacle awards:** Winners of the Qorus-Infosys Finacle Banking Innovation Awards 2026 were announced on 29 October ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms)).
- **No new product launch was confirmed in the window.** The Cobalt cloud offering and Topaz AI platform appear only in older material, which is outside the 30-day window ([Wikipedia contributors, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)).

### Leadership and Hiring

| Item | Date | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plan to shift up to one-third of ~320,000 staff into specialist roles | Undated article; referenced "last week" Americas Confluence | Reported via anonymous sources and analysts; management said it has not restructured | [The Times of India, n.d.](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) |
| Target team of 6,000 frontier engineers | Same article | Reported; hiring from Indian institutes and US campuses, often competing with AI labs | [The Times of India, n.d.](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) |
| CEO-designate Ashiss Kumar Dash named | Same article | Named; effective date not in sources | [The Times of India, n.d.](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) |

Two points need attention. First, the 320,000 figure in the report differs from the 328,594 employees reported at March 2026 ([Wikipedia contributors, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)), so the base for the one-third target is unclear. Second, a People Matters post describes a phased salary revision starting in October and a commitment to hire 20,000 freshers this financial year ([People Matters, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/people-matters_infosys-leadership-futureofwork-activity-7486351991623864320-xVwR)). That post appears to be about three months old, so it falls largely before the window and is flagged as unverified in date.

### Deals and Partnerships

- **Truist (19 October):** Infosys announced an expanded strategic partnership with Truist to build a Global Capability Center in Hyderabad. The model consolidates multiple supplier relationships, onboards more than 1,000 employees, and reduces Truist's third-party dependency in its operations ([StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement)). This is the largest disclosed commercial event in the window, though contract value is not disclosed.
- **Pocharam expansion (30 October):** Infosys announced an expansion of its Pocharam Development Center in Hyderabad ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/infosys-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-10960.cms); [Moneycontrol, n.d.](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT)). Capacity figures are not in the sources.
- **Infosys Prize 2026 (12 November):** Six researchers were named winners by the Infosys Science Foundation ([Moneycontrol, n.d.](https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-notices/infosys/notices/IT)). This is a foundation activity and has no direct commercial impact.
- **Outside the window:** The Columbia University enterprise AI research center was announced on 1 October 2026, about 45 days before the report date ([Unite.AI, n.d.](https://www.unite.ai/infosys-and-columbia-university-launch-enterprise-ai-research-center)). It is context only.

## Regulatory and Reputational Watch Items

- **France:** Infosys was fined €175,000 in July 2026 by DRIEETS Île-de-France over a working-time recording system ([Wikipedia contributors, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)). This is outside the window but is still relevant to labour-practice diligence.
- **Hiring-test integrity:** A June 2026 report said impersonation and cheating had led to a pause in hiring tests ([Wikipedia contributors, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infosys)). This is outside the window and is cited only through Wikipedia's reference list. The original article was not accessible.

## Peer Context (Same 30-Day Window)

| Company | Date | Development | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| HCL Technologies | 10 Nov 2026 | Collaboration with PTC on a semiconductor PLM solution | [StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement) |
| TCS | 9 Nov 2026 | Schedule of November analyst and investor meetings | [StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement) |
| LTM | 12 Nov 2026 | AI-QEM quantum error mitigation available in the IBM Quantum Functions Catalog | [StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement) |

## Sources Flagged as Unverified or Low Reliability

| Item | Issue | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Salil Parekh Q&A on attrition, freshers and deal conversion | Only the title was accessible; content cannot be verified | [YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XFO3fRcKVD8) |
| "Infosys Hiring Watch 2026" article | Promotional content from a course provider; not relied on for facts | [PW Skills, 2026](https://pwskills.com/blog/web-development/infosys-hiring-watch-2026-what-it-signals-for-full-stack-development) |
| Salary revision and 20,000 fresher hiring | Post is about three months old; original article not accessed | [People Matters, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/people-matters_infosys-leadership-futureofwork-activity-7486351991623864320-xVwR) |
| Market capitalisation of ₹4.66 lakh crore | Figure is from a StockFin page dated 19 October; current value not confirmed | [StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement) |
| Q2 FY27 financial results | Release date confirmed, but no figures in the sources | [StockFin, 2026](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/INFY/2026-10-19/announcement) |

## Analyst View

In my assessment, the workforce plan is the most material development in the window, and the company's public position on it is the least consistent. A plan to move up to a third of the workforce into specialist roles is a major operating change, and it is hard to reconcile with a statement that the company has "not restructured." The likely reading is that Infosys is reshaping skills mix and deployment through attrition, redeployment and new hiring rather than through layoffs. That reading is plausible, but the sources do not confirm it. The redeployment of clients' surplus staff in some deals supports the view that the company is using deal structures to absorb talent shifts.

The Truist GCC mandate is commercially more concrete. Consolidating supplier relationships and onboarding more than 1,000 staff suggests a larger, longer-term financial-services engagement, which fits the company's push into GCC work. The main risk is that the stock has weakened: at about ₹1,155, it sits well below its 52-week high. The market appears to be pricing in AI-related disruption to IT services, and Infosys has not yet shown in these sources how its specialist-role strategy will protect margins.

Governance and reputation require attention. The CEO transition, the labour and hiring-practice issues, and the workforce reshaping are all linked to talent management. The meeting should treat them as one agenda item rather than separate topics.

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Workforce plan:** How does the plan to shift up to one-third of staff into specialist roles reconcile with the statement that Infosys "has not restructured," and what are the timeline, cost, and attrition or redeployment assumptions?
2. **Leadership transition:** What is the effective date for Ashiss Kumar Dash as CEO, and how will major client programmes, including the Truist GCC mandate, be governed during the handover?
3. **Q2 performance and controls:** What were the reported Q2 revenue, margin and guidance figures, and what controls now cover working-time recording and candidate identity verification following the French fine and the hiring-test pause?

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026. Sources are limited to the search results provided. Where a result gave only a headline, I cite the page where that headline appeared.

**Snapshot:** Infosys is a Bangalore-headquartered IT services company with over 325,000 employees across 59 countries (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece). Its Q2 results drove most of the recent news, and the stock fell after them.

## What changed

**Results and guidance**
- Q2 revenue was $5,145M. Reported revenue rose 1.3% YoY, constant-currency growth was 1.5% YoY and 1.2% QoQ, and operating margin was 21.0% (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- AI revenue grew 29% sequentially and made up 10.5% of revenue (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).
- Infosys lowered its annual revenue growth guidance. The ADR fell over 7% on 23 Oct (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/infosys-adr-falls-over-7-as-it-major-lowers-annual-revenue-growth-guidance-everything-investors-need-to-know/article-202325).
- Shares fell 6.5% after Q2 EPS missed estimates by $0.01 (27 Oct headline, https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- Shares slid over 2% on 2 Nov, and the Hyderabad campus expansion did not lift sentiment (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece).
- Headline-only items on the same page: BMO Capital raised its price target to $13 and kept a Market Perform rating (26 Oct), and North America revenue declined amid sector slowdowns (23 Oct) (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).

**Deals**
- Large-deal total contract value reached $5.2B, of which 62% was net new, including one deal above $2B (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/INFY/infosys-differentiated-ai-strategy-and-a-sharp-focus-on-value-unlock-sjalje8xfokm.html).

**Hires and capacity**
- Infosys expanded its Truist GCC in India and onboarded 1,000 colleagues (19 Oct headline, https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- A new 1.1M sq ft block opened at the Pocharam campus in Hyderabad to serve emerging technologies (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/infosys-sets-up-new-1-1m-sq-ft-block-at-pocharam-campus-in-hyderabad-to-cater-to-emerging-technologies/articleshow/135366954.cms).
- The Hyderabad inauguration was attended by Telangana's Deputy Chief Minister, the IT Minister, and CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka. The facility targets banking, retail, life sciences and manufacturing clients (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece).

**Investor relations and market activity**
- Management will attend non-deal investor roadshows in London and Edinburgh in November. The excerpt does not give the dates (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).
- A block trade of ₹69.49 crore was executed on NSE on 23 Oct (headline, https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108).

**Other**
- The Infosys Prize 2026 winners were announced on 12 Nov in Bengaluru. Each winner receives USD 100,000 (https://news.careers360.com/infosys-prize-2026-scholars-from-tifr-princeton-carnegie-mellon-uc-san-ranscisco-new-south-wales-singapore-universities-winners).

**Source gaps:** The results contain no launch announcements beyond the Hyderabad capacity expansion and no hiring data beyond the Truist GCC onboarding. Some figures differ by listing: the ADR fell over 7%, while the ordinary share fell 6.5%. Confirm which measure matters before the meeting.

## Open questions

1. What drove the cut to annual revenue growth guidance, and how is management seeing North America demand after the sector slowdown?
2. How much of the $5.2B large-deal TCV will convert to revenue in the next two quarters, and what is the plan to grow AI revenue beyond 10.5% of the total?
3. How is the Pocharam expansion tied to committed client demand, and what is the hiring plan for the new capacity?
