# Databricks Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing prepares a meeting with Databricks on 17 November 2026. It covers product launches, platform changes, partnerships, deals, and hiring signals from roughly 16 October to 15 November 2026, the 30 days before the current date. It ends with three open questions. Where a fact could not be confirmed from the supplied material, the briefing says so.

## Executive Summary

- **Genie One is being distributed beyond the Databricks workspace.** In November, Databricks added connectors and plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok Bot/Cursor, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, Slack, a Chrome new-tab extension, and a Windows desktop app ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 11](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Enterprise governance is being built into the AI layer.** Genie Search became generally available with permission-aware indexing, context-based ingress rules now cover partner AI platforms, and AI Function spend now counts toward Unity Gateway budgets ([Databricks, 2026, November 9](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 1](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Several deadlines fall within days of the meeting.** The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint reaches end of life on 30 November 2026, and a breaking change for variant shredding takes effect on 18 November 2026 ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)).
- **One acquisition was reported** (Row Zero), but the supplied material does not give its date or price.
- **No verifiable executive hires were found** in the supplied material for this window.

## Source Reliability Assessment

Sources were ranked by provenance, date, and independence. Official vendor release notes were weighted highest for product facts. Third-party aggregators were used only for context and flagged accordingly.

| Source | Type | Date Coverage | Reliability | Use in This Briefing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Databricks on AWS release notes, November 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) | Official vendor documentation | 6–11 Nov 2026 | High | Primary source for product changes |
| [Databricks on Google Cloud release notes, November 2026](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november) | Official vendor documentation (English content, French-locale URL) | 6–11 Nov 2026 | High | Primary source for product changes |
| [Azure Databricks release notes, November 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) | Official documentation (Microsoft Learn) | 1–11 Nov 2026 | High | Primary source; also the most complete list of November dates |
| [Azure Databricks "What's coming?"](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming) | Official forward-looking documentation | Upcoming dates | High | Deadlines and scheduled changes |
| [Databricks Community, October 2026 roundup](https://community.databricks.com/t5/product-platform-updates/what-s-new-in-databricks-october-2026/ba-p/175667) | Vendor community post | October 2026 | Medium | Context on dashboards and Genie |
| [Databricks Community, DAIS 2026 article](https://community.databricks.com/t5/community-articles/dais-2026-the-databricks-announcements-i-think-clients-should/td-p/159914) | Partner-authored commentary | June 2026 | Medium | Strategic framing only |
| [SaaS M&A and VC Deals (Row Zero)](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5) | Third-party deal tracker | Undated in supplied excerpt | Medium-low | Acquisition claim, unverified in detail |
| [Fundz product launch page](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146) | Third-party sales-intelligence vendor page | November 2026 | Low | Launch summary only; marketing content |

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Product Launches and the Genie One Expansion

The most significant change is the distribution of Genie One. On 11 November 2026, Databricks released the Databricks Genie plugin for ChatGPT. A ChatGPT admin configures the plugin for the workspace, and each user signs in with a Databricks account ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)). The same day, a Databricks Genie connector for Claude and a Grok Bot/Cursor plugin were released, both using the Genie One MCP ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 11](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

On the Microsoft side, a Public Preview plugin for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat lets users query Azure Databricks data without an @-mention. A second Public Preview plugin covers Microsoft Copilot Cowork and does not require creating an OAuth app or editing a plugin manifest ([Microsoft, 2026, November 11](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Existing installations of the Beta manifest-based plugin are not migrated automatically ([Microsoft, 2026, November 11](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

Other Genie One channels also launched:

- **Chrome extension (Beta, 10 November):** every new tab opens Genie One ([Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Windows desktop app (Beta, 11 November):** adds Windows to the existing macOS app ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Slack app (GA, 9 November):** users can message the app or mention @Genie in channels and group DMs ([Databricks, 2026, November 9](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

Fundz, a third-party sales-intelligence vendor, describes the launch as "the second-generation Genie, an always-on autonomous AI assistant for enterprise work" and dates it to 11 November 2026 ([Fundz, 2026, November 11](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)). This is a secondary characterization and should be checked against Databricks' own announcement.

### Genie Search and Knowledge Access

Genie Search became generally available on 9 November 2026. It indexes content from Google Drive, Jira, Confluence, and Workday. Databricks indexes each document's permissions alongside its content, so users only see documents they can already access in the source system ([Databricks, 2026, November 9](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 9](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Genie Search also powers org directories in Genie One, which draw on Workday profiles ([Databricks, 2026, November 9](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

### AI Models, Gateway, and Coding Tools

- **Google Gemini 4 Carbon** is available on Unity Gateway through Foundation Model APIs (10 November). Databricks states that customers are responsible for their own compliance with applicable terms ([Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 10](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **ChatGPT subscription support in Unity Gateway** (11 November) lets users bill Codex and ChatGPT desktop use to their own ChatGPT Go, Plus, Pro, or Enterprise subscriptions. Unity Gateway still governs access and usage ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code** is now configurable through `ug configure --agents copilot`, alongside Copilot CLI, with Claude, GPT, and open-source models (11 November) ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **ai_decide (Beta)** now uses a new model that Databricks says answers questions 33% more accurately, with unchanged low latency ([Microsoft, 2026, November 2](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **AI Function tasks for Lakeflow Jobs (Beta)** can run ai_parse_document, ai_extract, and ai_classify without SQL, processing only new or changed inputs ([Microsoft, 2026, November 4](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Publishing Unity Gateway Skills from GitHub (Beta)** uses a GitHub Action to publish skills to Unity Catalog on merges ([Microsoft, 2026, November 4](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

### Governance, Security, and Platform Changes

- **Partner AI platforms in ingress policies (10 November):** context-based ingress policies can now allow traffic from ChatGPT and Claude as partner platforms. Databricks maintains their published IP ranges ([Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Context-based ingress in sovereign regions (4 November):** the feature is now available in Azure Government and Azure China North 3 ([Microsoft, 2026, November 4](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Budget webhooks (Beta, 10 November):** budgets can trigger webhooks when spend thresholds are reached, routing events to incident, ticketing, or automation tools ([Microsoft, 2026, November 10](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026, November 10](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **AI Functions in Unity Gateway budgets (1 November):** spend from ai_parse_document, ai_extract, and ai_classify now counts toward Unity Gateway budgets on both batch and real-time paths ([Microsoft, 2026, November 1](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Unity Catalog wikis (Beta, 6 November):** data owners can document table meaning, use, and sources, and other viewers can comment and suggest edits ([Microsoft, 2026, November 6](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026, November 6](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Metastore restore (Public Preview, 6 November):** account admins can restore a deleted metastore by ID within 5 days of deletion ([Microsoft, 2026, November 6](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Okta connector (Beta, 3 November)** in Lakeflow Connect ([Microsoft, 2026, November 3](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Custom Python service policies (Beta, 11 November)** ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Feature Views** are now on by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile (11 November) ([Databricks, 2026, November 11](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

### Deals and Corporate Activity

Databricks acquired Row Zero, a company founded by former AWS and Tableau engineers. Row Zero's technology enables spreadsheets to handle more than one million live rows in a secure, cloud-native environment. Its last reported round was a $10 million Series A in May 2025 at an estimated $40 million valuation, per PitchBook. Financial terms of the acquisition are private ([SaaS M&A and VC Deals, n.d.](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5)). The supplied excerpt does not state the announcement date, so it cannot be confirmed that the deal falls within the 30-day window. The source also says Databricks is scouting for more startups, but gives no further detail.

### Hiring

The supplied material contains no verifiable executive or senior hires for this period. The Fundz page refers to hiring signals and lists several names, but these entries are hidden or gated and cannot be confirmed as Databricks appointments ([Fundz, 2026, November 11](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)). The meeting should not assume any leadership changes without confirmation.

| 30 Nov 2026 | Genie One MCP Beta endpoint (`/api/2.0/mcp/genie`) reaches end of life. The date was previously 31 October ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)) | Migrate to the GA `system.ai.genie_one_mcp` in Unity Gateway |
| 1 Dec 2026 or later | Billing begins for private network gateway usage ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)) | Cost planning |
| 1 Feb 2027 | AI Functions that require Runtime 15.4 LTS or above are no longer supported on runtimes below 17.3 LTS in SQL. ai_forecast, ai_top_drivers, vector_search, and the REST API are not affected ([Microsoft, 2026, November 5](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)) | Runtime upgrade planning |

## Context from Earlier in 2026

Some earlier announcements provide context, although they fall outside the 30-day window. In September 2026, Databricks reported GA releases for Spark Declarative Pipelines and metastore-level ABAC policies with explicit DENY rules in Unity Catalog. It also raised Genie Agent limits to 50 data sources per agent (from 30), 200,000 conversations per agent (from 10,000), and 100-page PDF uploads (from 20) ([Databricks Community, 2026, September](https://community.databricks.com/t5/product-platform-updates/what-s-new-in-databricks-september-2026/ba-p/173896)). In October, the company reported that AIBI Dashboards were being positioned as a replacement for Power BI and Tableau, with Genie extending into a co-pilot that builds dashboards and optimizes compute ([Databricks Community, 2026, October](https://community.databricks.com/t5/product-platform-updates/what-s-new-in-databricks-october-2026/ba-p/175667)). A partner's DAIS 2026 commentary summarizes the strategy as "bring context closer to data" and "bring governance closer to AI behavior" ([Databricks Community, 2026, June 19](https://community.databricks.com/t5/community-articles/dais-2026-the-databricks-announcements-i-think-clients-should/td-p/159914)).

## Analytical Assessment

Based on the supplied material, my view is that Databricks' November 2026 strategy is a distribution play. Genie One is no longer mainly a feature inside the Databricks workspace. It is being placed in the tools employees already use: ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Slack, Chrome, and the desktop. The governance features shipped in the same window (permission-aware Genie Search, partner-platform ingress rules, budget webhooks) suggest Databricks expects enterprise buyers to resist broad access unless controls come with it. The strength of this approach is that it meets employees where they work. The risk is that every new access path increases the surface that administrators must govern, and the change-management load falls on customers.

The cost-governance signals are also significant. Bringing AI Function spend into Unity Gateway budgets, adding budget webhooks, and offering bring-your-own ChatGPT subscriptions all point to metered AI usage becoming a visible line item that customers want to control. Customers adopting multiple AI channels will need a clear view of what each channel costs.

The Row Zero acquisition fits the pattern. Row Zero's spreadsheet engine for more than one million live rows is a plausible addition to the AI-spreadsheet and business-user layer. However, the supplied material does not show how Row Zero's product will be integrated, and the deal's timing and terms cannot be verified.

Finally, the deadline cluster in late November (variant shredding on 18 November, MCP endpoint end of life on 30 November) is a practical risk. These are not strategic issues, but they can break production workloads if teams are unprepared.

Limitations: this briefing relies on release notes and secondary aggregators. It does not include pricing, customer metrics, or confirmed executive appointments. The Fundz characterization of the Genie launch and the Row Zero deal details should be verified before being repeated externally.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Genie One MCP migration:** The Beta endpoint reaches end of life on 30 November 2026. What is Databricks' recommended migration path to `system.ai.genie_one_mcp` for customers who have built integrations on the Beta endpoint, and what support is available for those that cannot migrate in time? ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming))
2. **Pricing and budget controls for Genie and AI channels:** With AI Function spend now inside Unity Gateway budgets and Genie reaching ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, and Microsoft 365, how will usage across these channels be metered and attributed, and will budget webhooks cover Genie consumption as well as AI Functions? ([Microsoft, 2026, November 1](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Microsoft, 2026, November 10](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november))
3. **Row Zero integration and roadmap:** What is the announcement date and scope of the Row Zero acquisition, and how will its spreadsheet capabilities be integrated with Genie One, AIBI dashboards, and Unity Catalog governance? ([SaaS M&A and VC Deals, n.d.](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5))

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Developments from roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026, based only on the search results provided. No sources were found for executive hires.

**Caveat on the top story:** A 15 November report says a company "has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion," citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). The snippet does not name the target. I could not confirm that it is Databricks, so verify this before the meeting.

## Products and launches
- On 11 November 2026, Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents).
- An updated Genie can handle multi-step jobs that take extended time to complete (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-d5ce8d4f2e7d567c6d43a125_databricks-_genie_gives).
- The new agentic tools run in the background, shadow office workers, and make proactive suggestions. A separate "Ontology" feature scans organizational data (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html).

## Facilities and headcount
- Databricks opened its new headquarters at One Sansome in San Francisco, spanning 10 floors and over 200,000 sq ft. It plans to double headcount by 2027 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/databricks-san-francisco-headquarters-ai-office-22525207.php).

## Partners and ecosystem
- Commvault announced Data Activate for Databricks, a planned governed-data solution. Early access is planned for December 2026 in select Azure regions, and it is not yet generally available (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai).

## Financials and listing
- As of late October, Databricks had no announced IPO date and no public S-1. Its private valuation was reported at $190 billion, with annualized revenue above $7 billion (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options).

## Hires and other gaps
- No executive hires were found in the search results.
- A company profile lists M&A dated 2025 to August 2026, including Electric DB Inc. (2026-08-01) and Panther Labs (2026-06-01). None falls within the 30-day window, and the profile is undated (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/7LlnrDq1nEGX).

## Open questions
1. Is Databricks the company in the reported $9.4 billion Globex acquisition, and if so, what is the status and expected closing timeline?
2. How will governed access work across third-party agents such as ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot, and what is the rollout timing for the Genie One MCP server?
3. Where will the planned headcount doubling by 2027 happen, which roles are growing, and how does that fit with the IPO timing?

# Canva: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

## Executive Summary

Canva announced on 3 November 2026 a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, about 22% of its workforce. The reorganisation merges Product, Growth and Platform into one product organisation, simplifies management layers and concentrates more product teams in Sydney ([Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250); [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Canva describes the change as a response to its first growth slowdown in a decade, although the company remains profitable ([Bashir, 2026, November 4](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/canva-first-growth-slowdown-decade-092457264.html); [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)).

Over the same 30-day window, Canva's product news centred on enterprise positioning, but the source material for those launches is weakly dated (see the verification section). No leadership hires or deal announcements dated within the window could be confirmed from the provided material.

**Briefing window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026. Sources are classified as primary (company), tier-one or tier-two press, or commentary.

## 1. What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### 1.1 Restructuring and Workforce Changes

The core development is the restructuring announced in CEO Melanie Perkins' internal note, "An important update on our team," published on Canva's newsroom ([Canva, 2026, November 3](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update)). The note confirms several operational details:

- Employees leaving Canva keep access to Slack and Gmail until the end of the week so they can tell their teams.
- Org Leads were to share area-level changes by the end of that week.
- A Company All Hands took place on 10 November, followed by Org All Hands from 11 November ([Canva, 2026, November 3](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update)).

The scale of the change is reported consistently across outlets. Newsweek reports that 1,271 employees, 22% of the workforce, are affected. The figure includes staff being asked to relocate, so the number who will actually leave is not yet known ([Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). Canva has not disclosed how many affected people will leave the company ([Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Perkins' note is reported to have said the affected roles include job cuts, new roles and relocations to central hubs ([Bashir, 2026, November 4](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/canva-first-growth-slowdown-decade-092457264.html)).

Key structural changes are summarised below.

| Dimension | Reported detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Affected staff | 1,271 (about 22% of workforce), including relocations | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Org design | Product, Growth and Platform merging into one product organisation | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Management | Layers simplified; narrow roles combined | [LinkedIn, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140) |
| Geography | Sydney to become primary home for more product teams and other roles | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Severance | At least six months' salary (about 26 weeks) for departing staff | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Office policy | 2–3 expected office days per week (infographic in trade coverage) | [Gomes, 2026, November 12](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand) |
| Breakdown | No published breakdown by title, department or country | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |

**Assessment.** The restructuring is best read as an organisational-design decision. Canva's own framing, relayed by Newsweek and Niehues, is that the goal is to reduce handover delays and management layers, not to respond to a cash problem. Niehues states that a Canva spokesperson said AI is not replacing the affected roles ([Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Because relocations are counted in the 1,271 figure, the headline number overstates the expected net job losses. The severance terms (at least six months) are also notably generous compared with the 11.2-week technology-sector average for 2024 cited by Niehues ([Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

### 1.2 Further Cuts or a Hiring Freeze

A report from Capital Brief, relayed by People Matters, says Canva could announce another round of redundancies or a company-wide hiring freeze in November ([Srivastava, 2026, November 3](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). This is a secondhand report of a possibility, not a confirmed plan. Canva has not confirmed it in the materials reviewed. It should be treated as unverified.

### 1.3 Product and Enterprise Launches

MarTech Cube reports Canva's enterprise-oriented launches from the Canva Create event. The article's publication date is not shown in the material provided. The reported announcements include:

- **Canva Enterprise**, a new subscription for large organisations ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).
- **The biggest redesign in more than a decade**, described as a new experience designed for work ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).
- **Canva Courses and Work Kits**, new workplace learning products ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).
- **Data Autofill**, which pulls data from third-party sources such as Salesforce and the MLS, and **Bulk Create**, which generates designs from CSV or Excel files ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).
- **Affinity v2.5**, with variable font support and a stroke width tool, extending the Affinity acquisition to professional designers ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).

Company metrics cited in the same article include more than 185 million monthly active users, more than US$2.3 billion in annualised revenue, and use by teams at 95% of Fortune 500 companies ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)). Canva's Visual Economy Report is cited as finding that 92% of business leaders expect non-design employees to have design skills ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).

**Timing caveat.** Because the article date is not visible, I cannot confirm that these launches fall within the 30-day window. The product set is consistent with the enterprise strategy that Futurum analysed in May 2026, which is outside the window and is used here only as background ([Kirkpatrick, 2026, May 28](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/canvas-may-2026-launches-signal-an-enterprise-platform-ambition-beyond-design)).

### 1.4 Acquisitions

Demand Gen Report covers Canva's acquisition of Ortto and Simtheory, quoting Ortto and Simtheory's CEO Mike Sharkey on bringing their technology to Canva's user base ([Demand Gen Report, n.d.](https://www.demandgenreport.com/industry-news/news-brief/canva-acquisitions-expands-marketing-ai-capabilities/52546)). The article is undated in the material provided, and I cannot confirm when the deal closed or was announced. It should not be presented as a within-window deal without verification. The same article's claim that "a quarter of a billion people" use Canva monthly conflicts with the 185 million monthly active users cited by MarTech Cube ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)).

### 1.5 Leadership Hires

No leadership hires dated within the window were found in the materials reviewed. The Canva memo itself references "Leads" and "Org Leads" overseeing the reorganised areas, but does not name new appointments ([Canva, 2026, November 3](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update)). This gap should be checked against Canva's newsroom before the meeting.

## 2. Financial and Strategic Context

Canva's financial position is central to interpreting the restructuring. The main figures reported are:

| Metric | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 2026 revenue growth expectation | About 20% year-on-year | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Prior growth forecast (August 2026) | Cut from 30% to 20%, per Fortune | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Profitability | 2026 is the tenth consecutive profitable year, per the company | [Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Prior-year revenue | US$3.5 billion, per The Register | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Annualised revenue | More than US$2.3 billion (product-cited figure) | [MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products) |

The figures contain an apparent inconsistency. The US$3.5 billion prior-year revenue figure and the US$2.3 billion annualised revenue figure cannot both be read as the same measure without clarification. I would not rely on either as a precise current revenue figure without checking Canva's own disclosures.

Perkins described the change as "without doubt the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history" ([Poduval, 2026, November 4](https://uxuiopen.com/blog/canva-layoff)). She also said that small adjustments would not be enough to address the slowdown ([Bashir, 2026, November 4](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/canva-first-growth-slowdown-decade-092457264.html)).

## 3. Analysis and Assessment

**Our view: the restructuring is a bet that execution speed, not market access, is now the binding constraint.** The clearest signal is the merger of Product, Growth and Platform. A LinkedIn commentary by a growth leader argues that the handoff between product and growth is where speed is lost, and that specialists who cannot ship end to end are most at risk ([LinkedIn, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)). That argument is an opinion, but it is consistent with Canva's stated rationale.

Three points follow from the evidence:

1. **The headline number is not the job-loss number.** Because the 1,271 figure includes relocations and role changes, the actual number of departures will be lower and is not yet known ([Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). Any briefing should avoid treating 1,271 as a count of redundancies.

2. **The enterprise pivot and the reorganisation are linked.** The launches in the MarTech Cube coverage (Canva Enterprise, workflow and data integrations, Affinity for professionals) require cross-functional execution across product, growth and platform ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products); [Kirkpatrick, 2026, May 28](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/canvas-may-2026-launches-signal-an-enterprise-platform-ambition-beyond-design)). The merger is therefore plausibly a precondition for that roadmap rather than a separate cost measure.

3. **Sydney centralisation carries relocation and retention risk.** Relocation is part of the reported 1,271 figure, and the choice to move product teams to Sydney may affect the people willing to stay ([Greenwood, n.d.](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). Retention of key product and platform talent is a legitimate concern for the next quarter.

The unresolved issue is whether the reorganisation improves speed or simply removes capacity. The materials do not contain metrics on cycle time, release frequency or the cost of handovers. Without those, the claim that the merger will speed up delivery is unproven.

## 4. Verification and Source Reliability

| Item | Status | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Restructuring, 1,271 roles, 22% | Verified across multiple outlets | Canva newsroom reference; Newsweek; Yahoo/BeInCrypto; Niehues |
| Announcement date | Inconsistent: 3 November (Newsweek, Niehues, People Matters) vs. 4 November (CTO Magazine, Yahoo) | Flagged; the 3 November date is used here |
| All Hands dates (10 and 11 November) | Verified from primary source | [Canva, 2026, November 3](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update) |
| Further cuts or hiring freeze | Unverified; secondhand report | [Srivastava, 2026, November 3](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Enterprise launches | Content verified; date not visible | [MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products) |
| Ortto/Simtheory acquisition | Content verified; date not visible; user count conflicts with other source | [Demand Gen Report, n.d.](https://www.demandgenreport.com/industry-news/news-brief/canva-acquisitions-expands-marketing-ai-capabilities/52546) |
| Growth forecast cut (August 2026) | Outside window; cited second-hand from Fortune | [Niehues, 2026, November 9](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Enterprise strategy analysis (May 2026) | Outside window; background only | [Kirkpatrick, 2026, May 28](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/canvas-may-2026-launches-signal-an-enterprise-platform-ambition-beyond-design) |
| Leadership hires | None found in window | Not verified; check newsroom |
| Post-10 November developments | Not covered in the materials | Gap; must be checked before the meeting |

**Source reliability note.** The Canva newsroom memo is the primary source and should be weighted most heavily. Newsweek and Yahoo/BeInCrypto are general news outlets. Niehues, CTO Magazine, LinkedIn and UX/UI Open are commentary or consultancy content and contain interpretation. Niehues also has a commercial interest in consulting services. Commentary is cited here only for context, not for facts about Canva's decisions. The Capital Brief report is secondhand.

**Exit-package comparison caveat.** Niehues compares Canva's six-month severance with German statutory notice and severance rules. That comparison is specific to German employees and should not be generalised to Canva's Australian or global workforce.

## 5. Recommended Preparation for 17 November

- Confirm the status of the 10 and 11 November All Hands and what was said about the new organisation chart.
- Check Canva's newsroom for any leadership appointments and for the dates of the enterprise launches.
- Verify whether the Capital Brief report on further cuts or a hiring freeze has been confirmed or denied.
- Clarify the revenue figures (US$2.3 billion annualised versus US$3.5 billion prior year).

## 6. Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **What is the expected net departure figure?** Of the 1,271 affected staff, how many are role eliminations, how many are role changes, and how many are relocations? When will relocation decisions be final, and what is the expected number of departures?

2. **How will the merged product organisation measure success?** What decision rights, cycle-time or release-frequency metrics will the new Product organisation use to show that removing handovers has improved delivery speed, and how will this support the enterprise roadmap (Canva Enterprise, workflow automation, Affinity for professionals)?

3. **Is a hiring freeze under consideration, and how will critical capabilities be retained?** Does Canva plan a company-wide hiring freeze or further redundancies in November, as reported by Capital Brief, and what is the plan to retain the product, platform and specialist talent needed for the enterprise pivot, given the Sydney centralisation?

Chris G | VC + Startups on Instagram: "Canva’s 2026 layoffs have a plot twist: the company is helping its former employees become entrepreneurs.

Imagine getting laid off and your employer offers to help fund your next startup. That’s essentially what Canva is doing.

CEO Melanie Perkins announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, or 22% of the workforce. Not all are being laid off; some face role changes or relocation.

But look at the exit package:

→ At least 6 months of salary
→ 12 months of healthcare where available
→ Employees keep their MacBooks
→ $10,000 startup grants through the Canva Collective Fund, with no equity taken
→ Career coaching and LinkedIn Premium

Now here’s what investors should actually pay attention to.

Canva lowered its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% as AI costs put pressure on its business model.

Meanwhile, Product, Growth, and Platform are being consolidated into one organization.

Translation: AI isn’t just changing what software companies sell. It’s changing the cost of delivering their products and how teams need to operate.

And here’s the overlooked opportunity: Canva’s departing talent could become the next generation of startup founders.

Losing your job is never easy. But giving employees financial runway, healthcare, and a chance to build something new is a much better exit than simply handing them a severance check.

The lesson for founders? How you treat employees on the way out says a lot about how you build a company.

Would you rather have six months of severance or a shot at funding your own startup?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Developments from roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026, based only on the search results provided. Every fact is cited to its source URL.

## What changed

**Restructuring and layoffs**
- Canva is cutting about 22% of its workforce, or 1,271 employees, as it flattens the org chart and consolidates teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- The company is merging its product, growth and platform teams and aims to reduce "subspecialisation," so remaining staff may take on broader responsibilities (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- CEO Melanie Perkins said "small changes won't be enough" and that Canva needs to "re-found" itself around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Departing staff get at least six months' salary plus support. Severance includes a free year of LinkedIn Premium and keeping company MacBooks. A new fund offers US$10,000 grants to start a business or pursue a community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- Staff were given the day off, with further restructuring details to come at a company meeting (https://mashable.com/tech/canva-mass-layoffs-ai-restructuring).
- Before the cuts, a Capital Brief report said Canva could announce more redundancies or a hiring freeze in November amid a revised revenue growth outlook. Canva had not confirmed this (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).
- Capital Brief also reported previously unreported finance-division cuts of 32 roles in January (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

**AI and partnerships**
- Canva expanded its OpenAI deal, gaining broader access to GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6. The two companies will work on making these models cheaper to run, though no savings or costs were disclosed. The deal came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- OpenAI already powers Canva Code, which builds interactive designs, websites and apps from text descriptions (same source).

**Deals**
- A wire report says a company has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced).
- **Caution:** The excerpt does not name Canva. Do not treat this as a Canva deal until it is confirmed.

**Hires:** No hiring announcements were found in the results. The only hiring-related item is the reported possible freeze (above).

**Background (outside the 30-day window)**
- Canva is privately held, headquartered in Surry Hills, NSW, and was founded in 2012 (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp).
- Recent acquisitions listed include Ortto (April 2026), SimTheory (April 2026), and Doohly, reported at US$30M (March 2026) (same source).

## Open questions

1. With product, growth and platform teams merging and roles broadening, who now owns decisions on our account and roadmap, and which contacts have changed?
2. Given the reported revised revenue outlook and possible hiring freeze, how does this affect your plans and timing for the next 12 months?
3. Is Canva involved in the reported Globex acquisition, and if so, could it affect our contract, data-handling terms, or delivery timeline?

# Razorpay: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026 | **Window reviewed:** 16 October to 15 November 2026 (30 days)

## Executive Summary

Within the 30-day window, the only verifiable, dated developments are regulatory and capital-markets events: a final IFSCA licence for GIFT City and SEBI approval of an IPO. No verified product launch, senior leadership hire, or acquisition falls inside the window. The most recent verified launches and hires date from before 16 October. Coverage of the window is therefore thin and skewed toward corporate finance, so the meeting is best used to clarify the commercial pipeline behind the agentic-commerce strategy and the IPO timeline.

## Company Snapshot

Razorpay is an Indian payments company. Its newsroom describes it as "India's Omnichannel Payments Platform" ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). The company is reported to be valued at $7.5 billion, the figure cited in Economic Times coverage of its domicile shift ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). Its strategic emphasis in 2026 is agentic payments, positioned in its Sprint 2026 materials as "The Age of AI-Native Payments" ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)).

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Regulatory and Capital Markets

**SEBI IPO approval (3 November 2026).** The Securities and Exchange Board of India cleared Razorpay's IPO on 3 November 2026. The clearance is valid for 18 months from November 2026 ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)). The company filed draft papers confidentially with SEBI in mid-2026 ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)). No price band, opening date, or lead managers have been officially announced ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)).

**Reported IPO parameters (not officially confirmed).** Media reports put the issue size at ₹5,000–6,000 crore and the valuation at about $5 billion, with a working listing target of January–March 2027 and December 2026 flagged as the earliest possibility ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)). These figures come from reports rather than an official Razorpay announcement and should be treated as working estimates ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)).

**Final IFSCA licence for GIFT City (3 November 2026).** Razorpay's newsroom lists a 3 November 2026 story reporting that the company received its final IFSCA licence for GIFT City, to power cross-border money movement ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).

**Unverified headline (3 November 2026).** The newsroom also shows a 3 November 2026 entry describing global investing, international collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities under a single offering. The snippet is truncated and does not show the headline or company detail, so I cannot confirm its specifics ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).

### Products and Launches

No product launch dated within the 30-day window is verifiable from the material reviewed. The most recent dated launches are outside the window:

- **Razorpay Partners With OpenAI to Expand ChatGPT Ads in India (5 October 2026).** The newsroom notes that Razorpay Engage will let local brands activate campaigns and track results ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). This falls 11 days before the window opens.
- **Apple Pay acceptance (30 September 2026).** The newsroom reports that Apple Pay is live online and in-store with thousands of businesses, including Zepto ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). MitchelLake lists the date as 1 October 2026 and names additional merchants, including ixigo, IndiGo, Tata 1mg, and JioMart ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-product-launch-2026-10-01)).
- **Vulcan AI payments foundation model (18 August 2026).** Razorpay launched Vulcan, described as India's first AI payments foundation model, fueled by NVIDIA and AWS and trained on 4 billion transactions ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).
- **RAY on WhatsApp (2 September 2026).** Razorpay launched a conversational AI account manager, RAY, on WhatsApp, in partnership with IndusInd Bank ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).

The Sprint 2026 page lists more than 100 launches, including Payments on LLMs, Razorpay for ChatGPT Apps, Voice Payments, and an Agentic Dashboard, but the page is undated and I cannot place these items in the window ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)).

### Partnerships and Deals

No new acquisition or partnership dated within the window is verifiable. The most recent acquisition on record is PoshVine, which Razorpay acquired in September 2022 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)). The OpenAI ads partnership (5 October 2026) sits just outside the window ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).

Economic Times reports that NPCI and Razorpay are partnering with OpenAI on an agentic payments pilot in ChatGPT, with BigBasket among the first merchants ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). The article is undated in the material reviewed, so I cannot confirm whether it falls within the window.

### Leadership and Hiring

No senior leadership appointment dated within the window is verifiable. The relevant recent hires fall outside it:

- **Four senior engineering hires (5 August 2026).** Razorpay strengthened its AI leadership with four senior engineering hires. Shashank Kumar, Co-founder and CTO, said the team would support AI-native financial infrastructure for agentic commerce ([Veloxx Media, 2026](https://veloxxmedia.com/razorpay-strengthens-ai-leadership-with-four-senior-engineering-hires)). The individual names are not included in the material reviewed.
- **Praburam Rambadran as SVP Engineering (September 2025).** The Veloxx article states that Rambadran was appointed to this role in September 2025 ([Veloxx Media, 2026](https://veloxxmedia.com/razorpay-strengthens-ai-leadership-with-four-senior-engineering-hires)). Other sources spell the name differently, so the spelling should be confirmed before the meeting.
- **Apuarv Sethi as CMO (15 May 2026).** The newsroom reports Sethi's elevation to CMO, covering India and Southeast Asia ([Razorpay Newsroom, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).

MitchelLake records two Razorpay signals in the prior 90 days, against a fintech median of one across 64 tracked companies. These include a strategic hiring signal dated 8 August 2026 and a product launch dated 11 August 2026 ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-product-launch-2026-10-01)).

## Verification Gaps

- **Undated or undatable sources.** Several Economic Times items, the Sprint 2026 page, and a YouTube video on Razorpay's COO discussing "Netbanking 2.0" and "Agentic Commerce" ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ia5i2GZHlFc)) carry no verifiable publication date in the material reviewed. They are used here only as context.
- **Unverified IPO-related claims.** The Stock Market Tak YouTube video on the IPO carries no substantive content in the material reviewed ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dxIAx-syEGo)). The Economic Times report on IPO bankers (Axis, Kotak, Citi, and JPMorgan) is also undated ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). Neither should be treated as confirmed, and the IPO bank list conflicts with the IPO Market note that lead managers are not yet disclosed ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)).
- **Valuation conflict.** The Economic Times cites a last valuation of $7.5 billion ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)), while IPO Market reports an expected IPO valuation of about $5 billion ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)). The two figures measure different things, and the gap should be understood before discussing valuation.
- **Acquisition record.** A Tracxn page is titled "7 Acquisitions" but lists only five entries ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)). The Head and Tale summarises the M&A history, including the Ezetap acquisition in 2022 ([The Head and Tale, n.d.](https://theheadandtale.com/to-the-point/at-a-glance-razorpay-s-m-a-activity-since-its-first-acquisition-in-2019)).

## Analysis and Assessment

**My view:** The 30-day window is dominated by the pre-IPO regulatory track, not by commercial momentum. Two verified dated events (SEBI approval and the IFSCA licence) both fall on 3 November, and together they indicate that Razorpay is clearing the structural steps for a listing. The IFSCA licence matters particularly because it supports cross-border money movement from GIFT City, a sign of the international expansion that the company's recent product and partnership activity also points toward.

Second, the commercial narrative is concentrated in agentic commerce. Between August and October 2026, the verified items (Vulcan, RAY, the OpenAI ads partnership, and the ChatGPT pilot reported by Economic Times) all point the same way. However, the evidence is mainly company-authored or press-release material. Adoption, revenue, or merchant volumes for these products are not verified in the sources reviewed, so the strategic bet should be treated as promising but unproven at scale.

Third, the leadership picture is consistent with that bet. Engineering and AI hires in August and the 2025 SVP appointment show investment in the capability underpinning agentic products. I see no verified go-to-market or international leadership appointment in the window. That gap is worth probing, since a platform push into new geographies would normally be accompanied by commercial leadership.

Fourth, the valuation discrepancy is the main commercial risk to watch. If the IPO is priced near $5 billion against a reported last valuation of $7.5 billion, that implies a meaningful reset. This is a reported figure and should not be asserted as fact, but it is the question most likely to shape Razorpay's near-term priorities.

## Recommended Meeting Focus

1. Confirm the commercial status of the agentic products (pilot, limited release, or general availability), and the adoption metrics that are available to share.
2. Understand how the GIFT City licence will be used, and whether it signals specific cross-border products or markets.
3. Learn who is leading go-to-market and international expansion, given the engineering-heavy hiring record.

## Open Questions for the Meeting

runs.briefing:
# Razorpay: Pre-Meeting Briefing

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window covered:** Results dated 2–15 November 2026. Nothing was found for the earlier part of the 30-day window.

## What changed in the last 30 days

**Regulatory / launch**
- Razorpay received its final Payment Service Provider licence from the IFSCA, following in-principle approval in April 2026. The licence lets it move money in and out of India from GIFT City under one regulatory framework (https://yourstory.com/2026/11/startup-news-and-updates-daily-roundup-november-02-2026; https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-gets-final-ifsca-licence-cross-border-payments-gift-city-126110200734_1.html).
- The licence adds to Razorpay's existing RBI permissions for online, offline and cross-border payments (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/razorpay-gets-gift-city-licence-for-cross-border-payments/articleshow/135470766.cms).

**IPO**
- SEBI issued final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November 2026, clearing the way for the next listing stages (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).
- Reports put the issue at ₹5,000–6,000 crore with a $5 billion valuation target (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ipo-razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-5-000-6-000-crore-issue-eyes-5-billion-valuation/article-202997). Inc42 reports ₹6,000 crore (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo).
- ET says the company is reportedly exploring ₹5,500–6,500 crore and targets a potential 2027 listing (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).

**Deals**
- A 15 November item reports an agreed $9.4 billion acquisition by Globex Corporation, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **Caution:** the snippet does not name the target company, so it cannot be attributed to Razorpay from this source. Verify before the meeting.

**Hires**
- No hires were found in the search results.

## Company background (undated profile)

- HQ in Bangalore; privately held; B2B model (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7).
- 12 funding rounds, $834.43M total raised. Listed investors include TeleSoft Partners, Salesforce Ventures and Ribbit Capital (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7).

## Flags

- IPO size is reported differently across outlets (₹5,000–6,000 crore vs. ₹5,500–6,500 crore vs. ₹6,000 crore). Confirm the current figure.
- The Globex deal may not involve Razorpay.

## Open questions

1. With the GIFT City PSP licence now final, what is the timeline for launching cross-border money movement, and which corridors come first?
2. Given SEBI's clearance, what is the planned IPO size and timing, and is a 2027 listing still the target?
3. Can you confirm whether Razorpay is party to the Globex transaction reported on 15 November, and how any such deal would affect current partnerships?

# Infosys Pre-Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Coverage window: approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026. Items outside this window are labelled as background.*

## Executive Summary

Infosys's most material recent development is its Q2 FY27 results, released on 23 October 2026. Revenue and profit grew, headcount recovered, and large-deal bookings rose. However, management cut full-year FY27 constant-currency revenue growth guidance to 1–2% ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)). The company's workforce strategy is shifting toward specialist roles, AI-native fresher hiring, and outcome-based pricing ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). The provided sources contain no verified executive appointment, named product launch, or named deal announced within the 30-day window.

## Source Reliability and Scope

Not all supplied sources are suitable for a 30-day briefing. The table below records how each was weighted.

| Source | Date | Type | Use in this briefing |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) (Livemint) | 24 Oct 2026 | Mainstream financial news | **Primary** for in-window facts |
| [TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) (Times of India) | 29 Sep 2026 | Mainstream news, sourced from attendees | Background (outside window); strategy context |
| [Unstop, n.d.](https://unstop.com/blog/infosys-hiring-20000-freshers-fy27-guide) | Undated | Career-portal blog | Low reliability; figures conflict with Livemint and are not used as facts |
| [YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FN4pRie-8Xo) | Undated | Video headline only | Corroborates a 20K FY27 hiring headline; no detail |
| [Fujita, 2020](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/infosys-commits-to-hiring-12000-american-workers-expanding-us-footprint-130006173.html) (Yahoo Finance) | 1 Sep 2020 | Mainstream news, outdated | Excluded from current commitments; historical context only |

## Material Changes in the Last 30 Days

### Financial Results and Guidance

Infosys reported Q2 FY27 results on 23 October 2026 ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)). Key figures are below.

| Metric | Q2 FY27 / Current | Comparison | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Net profit | ₹7,823 crore (+6% YoY) | ₹7,364 crore, Q2 FY26 | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| Revenue from operations | ₹49,244 crore (+11% YoY) | ₹44,490 crore, Q2 FY26 | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| Large-deal TCV | $5.2 billion | $3.6 billion, prior quarter | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| FY27 revenue growth guidance (cc) | 1–2% | Previously 1.5–3% | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| Operating margin guidance | 20–22% (maintained) | — | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |

The company attributed the guidance cut to cautious client spending in certain verticals. Stronger demand from energy and utilities clients and higher AI-services spending supported growth ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)).

### Workforce and Hiring

- Headcount reached 332,542 at the end of September 2026, a net addition of 4,480 employees in Q2 FY27. This followed a decline of 532 in Q1 FY27. The H1 FY27 net addition is 3,948 ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)).
- Fresher hiring has passed 8,000 so far in FY27 ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)).
- A YouTube headline reports "20K New Hires In FY27" ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FN4pRie-8Xo)). Unstop attributes a 20,000-fresher FY27 target to CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka, citing a Q4 FY26 net reduction of 8,440 ([Unstop, n.d.](https://unstop.com/blog/infosys-hiring-20000-freshers-fy27-guide)). These Q4 figures conflict with Livemint's Q1 FY27 figure of −532, so the Unstop numbers are treated as unverified.

### Deals

- Large-deal TCV of $5.2 billion in Q2 FY27 was up from $3.6 billion in the prior quarter ([Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html)).
- Unstop cites a "$14.9 billion deal pipeline" ([Unstop, n.d.](https://unstop.com/blog/infosys-hiring-20000-freshers-fy27-guide)). This figure is undated and not corroborated, so it is excluded from the verified facts.
- No individually named client contracts appear in the provided sources for the window.

### Product and Strategy

- Infosys is emphasising outcome-based pricing and a model-agnostic strategy, and is working with open-weight models for enterprise customers who want more control over their data ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). This was reported from a September event, so it is background rather than a new in-window launch.
- Infosys Cobalt, described as the company's AI-powered cloud platform, was referenced at the same event ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

### Executive and Key Hires

- No executive appointment or key hire dated within the 30-day window appears in the provided sources. This is a gap in coverage, not confirmation that none occurred.
- CEO-designate Ashiss Kumar Dash shared the stage with incumbent CEO Salil Parekh at the Americas Confluence in Washington, DC ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). This event occurred in September, so it is background.

## Context Outside the 30-Day Window

### Specialist Workforce Plan (September 2026)

Infosys plans to move a quarter to a third of its workforce into specialist positions and to build a team of about 6,000 frontier engineers. More than 320,000 people work at the company, and 270,000 have received AI training, with 80,000 working on coding tools ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). Analysts cited in the same report said AI is pressuring headcount-based billing models ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

### U.S. Hiring Commitment (2020, Superseded)

Infosys's 2020 pledge to hire 12,000 U.S. workers over two years, part of a 25,000-job commitment over five years, is outdated ([Fujita, 2020](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/infosys-commits-to-hiring-12000-american-workers-expanding-us-footprint-130006173.html)). It should not be presented as a current commitment. It is useful only as evidence of the company's long-running U.S. localisation strategy.

## Verified Facts vs. Inference

| Statement | Classification | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Q2 FY27 net profit was ₹7,823 crore (+6% YoY) | Verified | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| FY27 revenue growth guidance was cut to 1–2% cc | Verified | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| Headcount was 332,542 at end-September 2026 | Verified | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| Large-deal TCV was $5.2 billion | Verified | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| Fresher hiring has passed 8,000 in FY27 | Verified (single source) | [Maniyar, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/infosys-headcount-rises-by-4-480-in-q2fy27-freshers-hiring-crosses-8-000-check-details-11792856755379.html) |
| 20,000 FY27 fresher hires is the target | Reported, not confirmed in primary filing | [Unstop, n.d.](https://unstop.com/blog/infosys-hiring-20000-freshers-fy27-guide); [YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FN4pRie-8Xo) |
| $14.9 billion deal pipeline | Unverified | [Unstop, n.d.](https://unstop.com/blog/infosys-hiring-20000-freshers-fy27-guide) |
| Pricing is shifting toward outcome-based models | Reported (September event) | [TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) |
| Guidance cut shows AI pricing transition is eroding growth | **Inference** | Derived from the guidance cut and the TOI pricing commentary; the company attributed the cut to client spending in certain verticals instead |
| Infosys is prioritising margin protection over top-line growth | **Inference** | Derived from maintained margin guidance, a cut to revenue guidance, and the pyramid rebuild |

## Analyst Assessment

My view is that the Q2 FY27 numbers show a company stabilising on headcount and margins while growing slowly. The main risk is top-line growth, not profitability.

1. **Growth is the binding constraint.** Revenue rose 11% in rupee terms in Q2, but full-year constant-currency guidance is only 1–2%. Rupee-reported growth is flattered by currency effects, so the gap between reported and constant-currency performance matters for interpreting the quarter.
2. **The bookings signal is positive but not conclusive.** A $5.2 billion large-deal TCV quarter, up from $3.6 billion, supports the view that demand is present. Still, TCV does not equal recognised revenue, and the guidance cut suggests conversion will be slow.
3. **The pyramid rebuild is a margin decision.** The 20,000 fresher target, the specialist shift, and the 6,000 frontier-engineer team all point to a lower-cost, AI-enabled delivery model. This supports the maintained 20–22% margin guidance, but it depends on AI productivity offsetting the revenue effect of moving away from billing by headcount.
4. **Leadership transition adds execution risk.** The CEO-designate was publicly introduced alongside the incumbent in September. The timing of a handover, and whether it changes strategy, is not stated in the sources.

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. How much of the 1–2% FY27 guidance reflects the transition from headcount-based to outcome-based contracts, and how much reflects client spending pullbacks in specific verticals? What share of the $5.2 billion Q2 TCV is priced on an outcome basis?
2. Given more than 8,000 fresher hires so far and a stated FY27 target of 20,000, how will fresher intake be balanced against reskilling for the specialist roles, and how will the 6,000 frontier-engineer team be sourced and funded?
3. What is the timeline for the CEO transition to Ashiss Kumar Dash, and are any changes planned to senior delivery or Americas leadership, including Anant Adya's role?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are limited to the search results provided.

**Caution on the acquisition item:** A 15 November report says "the company" agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, with closing expected next quarter. The report does not name the target, so I could not confirm that it refers to Infosys. Verify before raising it. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)

## Deals and Corporate Actions
- Reported agreement to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4B, per people familiar with the matter; target not named in the source. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)
- Interim dividend of Rs 26 per share, up 13% from Rs 23 a year earlier. Record date 3 November; payment 11 November. (https://indiantelevision.com/mam/infosys-cuts-fy27-growth-outlook-despite-strong-ai-revenue-and-deal-wins)

## Financial Outlook
- Infosys lowered its FY27 revenue growth outlook despite strong AI revenue and deal wins; operating margins were reported as steady. (https://indiantelevision.com/mam/infosys-cuts-fy27-growth-outlook-despite-strong-ai-revenue-and-deal-wins)
- Shares slid over 2% on 2 November as the Hyderabad campus expansion failed to lift sentiment. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)

## Facilities and Launches
- Hyderabad campus inaugurated on 2 November, designed for banking, retail, life sciences and manufacturing clients, with radiant cooling and rainwater harvesting. Attended by CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)
- Management held non-deal roadshows in London and Edinburgh, 2–4 November, with CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka and Head of IR Sandeep Mahindroo. (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)
- No product launches found in the results.

## Workforce and Hiring
- Infosys employs over 325,000 people across 59 countries. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)
- The US suspended eight technology firms, including Infosys, from permanent hiring of skilled international workers through a widely used visa pathway. (https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqj34j7dk771o)

## Legal and Regulatory
- Infosys said it is in talks with the US Department of Justice over how it classified certain H-1B employees in immigration filings. It said it cannot predict the outcome. (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/technology/tech-news/infosys-filing-to-sec-facing-investigation-from-department-of-justice-on-classification-of-h-1b-visa-employees-in-immigration-documents/articleshow/135252907.cms)

*Excluded: a company profile with an M&A entry dated March 2026 (outside the window; undated profile), and several results referring to the "Infosys Theater" at Madison Square Garden, which is unrelated.*

## Open Questions
1. Can you confirm whether the Globex Corporation agreement involves Infosys, and what it means for the timing and scope of our discussions?
2. What is driving the cut to the FY27 revenue growth outlook, and how do you expect margins to hold through the rest of the year?
3. What is the status of the DOJ H-1B investigation and the PERM hiring suspension, and how might they affect your US hiring and delivery capacity?
