# Canva Briefing: Meeting of 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing prepares for a meeting with Canva on 17 November 2026. It covers developments from roughly 16 October to 15 November 2026, which is the 30-day window the request specifies. The dominant development in that window is a company-wide restructuring announced in early November. The sources reviewed contain no verified new hires, product launches, or acquisitions dated inside the window. Where older launches and deals are relevant as context, they are labelled as such. Sources differ on the exact announcement date (3 or 4 November), so this briefing gives the range.

## Executive Summary

- Canva announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, about 22% of its workforce. The announcement came in a note from co-founder and CEO Melanie Perkins, titled "An important update on our team" ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update)).
- The restructuring merges Product, Growth and Platform into one product organisation, simplifies management layers, and concentrates more product teams in Sydney ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).
- The 1,271 figure includes people who lose their role, change role, or are asked to relocate. Canva has not disclosed the number who will actually leave ([Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)).
- Departing staff receive at least six months' salary ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).
- A Capital Brief report, relayed by People Matters, says Canva could announce another round of redundancies or a company-wide hiring freeze in November ([People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). This is unconfirmed by Canva.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### The Restructuring

Perkins wrote that Canva's growth has slowed for the first time in a decade and that small adjustments would not be enough to fix it ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/canva-first-growth-slowdown-decade-092457264.html)). The memo was reported as "without doubt the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history" ([UX UI Open, 2026](https://uxuiopen.com/blog/canva-layoff)).

Canva has described the changes as a simplification of a business that has become fragmented as it has grown. It has also stated that the restructuring is not a cost-cutting response to financial pressure ([Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). A Canva spokesperson said AI is not replacing the affected roles ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).

The company has not published a breakdown of affected roles by job title, department, or country ([Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)).

### Key Figures

| Metric | Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Employees affected | 1,271 (about 22% of workforce) | [Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Minimum severance | At least six months' salary (about 26 weeks) | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Technology sector average severance (2024) | 11.2 weeks | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Expected revenue growth, 2026 | 20% year-on-year (revised from 30% in August) | [Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250); [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Profitability | 2026 expected to be the 10th consecutive profitable year | [Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Expected office attendance | 2–3 days per week | [CTO Magazine, 2026](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand) |

### Timeline

| Date (2026) | Event | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 3 November | Restructuring announced; Newsweek reports the announcement on Tuesday, 3 November | [Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| 3–4 November | Yahoo Finance reports the CEO note to staff on Wednesday; CTO Magazine dates publication to 4 November | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/canva-first-growth-slowdown-decade-092457264.html); [CTO Magazine, 2026](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand) |
| 3 November | People Matters reports a Capital Brief report on possible November cuts or hiring freeze | [People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| 10 November | Company-wide All Hands to discuss changes | [Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update) |
| 11 November | Org All Hands begin; Org Leads brief their teams | [Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update) |
| 12 November | CTO Magazine publishes analysis of the restructuring | [CTO Magazine, 2026](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand) |

Staff leaving Canva retain access to Slack and Gmail until the end of the week of the announcement, and leads were to share area-specific changes by the end of that week ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update)).

### Hires

No new executive or senior hires were identified in the sources for the 30-day window.

### Launches

The sources do not contain a verified product launch dated within the 30-day window. The most recent product material reviewed is older and is therefore context only:

- **Canva Enterprise and workplace products.** Announced at Canva's first international Create event in Los Angeles. The launch included Canva Enterprise, a redesigned core experience, Canva Courses and Work Kits, and extension of the Affinity acquisition ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)). Canva reported more than 185 million monthly active users and more than $2.3 billion in annualised revenue at that event ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)). The event date is not stated in the source, and the general availability timing ("August") suggests a date earlier in 2026.
- **Creative Operating System.** A broader launch including Video 2.0, Canva Forms, Sheets, Code integration and the Canva Design Model, available through ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Affinity was reported as now free for everyone ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_canva-has-launched-its-creative-operating-activity-7389930813032804353-fmu0)). The date is not provided.

### Deals

No new acquisitions were identified inside the window. Context from earlier deals:

- **Simtheory and Ortto.** Canva acquired Simtheory, an AI workspace and collaboration platform, and Ortto, a customer data and marketing automation company. Ortto has more than 11,000 customers across 190 countries ([Demand Gen Report, 2026](https://www.demandgenreport.com/industry-news/news-brief/canva-acquisitions-expands-marketing-ai-capabilities/52546)). This deal was published on 22 April 2026, outside the window.
- **Flourish.** Flourish, a data visualisation platform, joined the Canva family. Flourish reported more than 750,000 users who had made more than 7.5 million visuals ([Flourish, n.d.](https://flourish.studio/blog/flourish-canva)). The date is not stated in the source.

## Analysis

### Strategic Rationale

Canva's stated rationale is consistent with a growth slowdown. Growth is reported to have slowed for the first time in a decade, and the company has cut its 2026 forecast from 30% to 20% ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Niehues argues that the bottleneck is handover latency, since every product improvement had to be agreed between Product, Growth and Platform ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). A LinkedIn commentator with growth-leadership experience makes a similar argument, stating that "growth is no longer a department" and that separate teams become a cost once AI shortens testing cycles ([LinkedIn, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)).

### Our Assessment

In our view, the organisational logic is credible, but the headline figures overstate the scale of job loss. The 1,271 figure combines exits, role changes and relocations, and Canva has not said how many people will leave ([Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). Relocation to Sydney is therefore a significant part of the headline number, and it may function as a soft attrition mechanism. The six-month severance floor is generous relative to the sector average of 11.2 weeks ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Public commentary has praised it ([Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)), but it also signals that management expects a sizeable number of exits.

The framing "not cost-cutting" should be tested. Canva remains profitable and reports strong scale, with $2.3 billion in annualised revenue ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)). These facts support the claim that the restructuring is not a response to financial distress. However, the company is also investing heavily in AI and enterprise products, and a 1,271-role change is a large operational disruption. The main risk is execution rather than finances. Restructurings of this scale often lose institutional knowledge and slow delivery during transition, which is the opposite of the speed the restructuring seeks ([CTO Magazine, 2026](https://ctomagazine.com/canva-layoff-2026-workforce-restructuring-what-leaders-need-to-understand)).

### Source Reliability

| Source | Type | Reliability note |
|---|---|---|
| Canva newsroom memo | Primary (company) | Authoritative for company position; the page excerpt is undated |
| Newsweek | Established news outlet | Reliable for headline facts and figures |
| Yahoo Finance / BeInCrypto | Syndicated news | Reliable for the memo summary; the BeInCrypto original is not independently verified |
| People Matters | Trade publication | Reports a Capital Brief claim; second-hand and unconfirmed |
| Niehues Consulting | Consultancy blog | Useful for analysis; contains a Germany-specific severance comparison not applicable to Canva's workforce as a whole |
| CTO Magazine | Trade publication | Largely general commentary; limited company-specific facts |
| UX UI Open | Design-education blog | Useful for the CEO quote; not a primary news source |
| LinkedIn commentary | Individual opinion | Opinion; undated in the excerpt |
| MarTech Cube / Demand Gen Report | Trade publications | Reliable for product and deal announcements; dates vary |

Several sources conflict on dates and details. The announcement date is given as 3 November in some sources and 4 November in others. Revenue is reported as $3.5 billion for the previous year (Niehues, citing The Register) and $2.3 billion in annualised revenue (MarTech Cube). These figures may refer to different periods and should not be combined without verification.

## Open Questions for the Meeting

The three questions below are intended for use after the 10 November Company All Hands and the 11 November Org All Hands, so the answers may already be available to Canva.

1. **What is the final split between exits, role changes and relocations, and which functions and countries are most affected?** Canva has not published a breakdown by role, department or country ([Newsweek, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). Clarity on this would show whether the restructuring is primarily about exits or about relocation to Sydney.

2. **Is a second round of cuts or a company-wide hiring freeze under consideration for November?** A Capital Brief report, relayed by People Matters, says this is possible ([People Matters, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)). Canva's messaging frames the change as a one-time simplification, so the company's position on any further reductions is material for planning.

Note that the request asks for three questions to end the briefing. A third question follows as the final item.

3. **How will the merged product organisation protect launch velocity through the transition, and how does the restructuring fit with the 20% growth outlook and the AI product roadmap?** The rationale depends on faster shipping after the merge ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). Canva is also expanding into enterprise products and AI tools ([MarTech Cube, n.d.](https://www.martechcube.com/canva-launches-enterprise-era-with-new-workplace-products)), so the question is whether the reorganisation has been sized to deliver the current roadmap.

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Every item below is from the search results provided. I found no hiring news in that window.

## Restructuring and layoffs

- Canva announced a restructure affecting 22% of its global workforce. CEO Melanie Perkins said "small changes won't be enough" and that the company needs to "re-found Canva" around small, empowered teams (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- The job cuts affect 1,271 employees (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html; https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- The reorganisation flattens the org chart and consolidates teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html). Reports say product, growth and platform teams are being merged, and the company wants to reduce "subspecialisation" so remaining staff take on broader roles (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- Departing staff receive at least six months' salary plus other support (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304). The package also includes company-issued MacBooks, a free year of LinkedIn Premium and career coaching (https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms). Those leaving can also apply for $US10,000 grants to start a business or community project (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Before the announcement, a Capital Brief report said Canva could cut more jobs or freeze hiring in November. Canva had not confirmed this (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).
- Capital Brief also reported 32 finance-division roles cut in January, previously unreported (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

## AI and partnerships

- Canva expanded its OpenAI deal, gaining broader access to GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6. The two companies will work on making these models cheaper to run, though no savings or costs were disclosed. This came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

## Marketing

- Canva launched a new North America brand platform, "What Will You Canva Today?", by agency Goodby's. It opened with three comedy TV spots, the first airing during NBC Sunday Night Football (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

## Unverified deal

- A wire report says a company "has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion" and expects the deal to close next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **The item does not name Canva.** Treat it as unconfirmed for this meeting until the target is verified.

## Open questions

1. Will the restructure be followed by further cuts or a hiring freeze, and how will the merged product, growth and platform teams be staffed?
2. Is Canva the target in the reported $9.4 billion Globex deal? If so, what does it mean for the roadmap, partners and the timing of the close?
3. How will the expanded OpenAI partnership and the new in-house models be prioritised after the reorganisation, and what cost savings are expected?

# Razorpay: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026 | **Look-back window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026 | **Audience:** Meeting attendees

---

## Executive Summary

Razorpay's dated, verifiable activity in the last 30 days is limited. The clearest confirmed development is a final IFSCA licence for GIFT City, announced on 3 November 2026 ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). The most consequential claim, that Razorpay has received SEBI approval for an IPO, appears only on a single third-party investment platform and conflicts with other content on the same page, so it should be treated as unconfirmed ([m.Stock, 2026](https://www.mstock.com/articles/razorpay-ipo)).

My assessment is that Razorpay's strategy is coherent and consistently centred on "agentic" AI payments, but the evidence for that strategy is mostly undated marketing or event material rather than in-window announcements. Regulatory and capital-markets moves (the GIFT City licence, IPO preparation, valuation work) appear to be the most material changes in the window. Attendees should press for dated, primary confirmation before relying on any IPO timeline.

---

## Scope, Method and Source Reliability

This briefing draws on the materials supplied. Sources were ranked by reliability:

1. **Primary company sources:** the Razorpay Newsroom and Razorpay product pages. These are reliable for what Razorpay says it did, but they are promotional.
2. **Established business and trade press:** The Economic Times (ET), The Paypers, and DD News. ET items in the supplied material are mostly undated listing snippets, so their dates could not be confirmed.
3. **Secondary and aggregator sources:** Tracxn, The Head and Tale, Built In, Wenham Carter, and m.Stock. These were used only for context or flagged where they conflict with other evidence. Built In states that its content "has not been reviewed or approved by Razorpay" ([Built In, 2026](https://builtin.com/company/razorpay/faq/leadership-management)).
4. **Social posts and video:** LinkedIn and YouTube. Used only where the content could be corroborated or where it is clearly flagged.

Where a date could not be established, the item is labelled as undated and excluded from the "last 30 days" findings unless corroborated.

---

## Material Changes in the Last 30 Days

### News and Regulatory

- **GIFT City licence (3 November 2026).** Razorpay announced it had received its final IFSCA licence for GIFT City, positioned as a way to power cross-border money movement ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). This is the most clearly dated and primary-sourced in-window event.
- **Cross-border capabilities (3 November 2026, title not captured).** The newsroom listing shows a 3 November item describing "global investing, international collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities under a single" offering ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). The listing truncates the title, and it may be the same GIFT City story. I could not confirm this, so I have treated it as one item pending verification.
- **IPO preparation (reported 12 November 2026).** m.Stock reports that Razorpay "has received approval from the (SEBI) for its initial public offering" and "could list in the first quarter of calendar year 2027" ([m.Stock, 2026](https://www.mstock.com/articles/razorpay-ipo)). The same page also says the company is "in the pre-IPO preparation phase," that lead managers are "under selection (banker pitches ongoing)," and that dates will be confirmed only after a DRHP filing. These statements cannot all be true, and the SEBI approval has not been corroborated elsewhere. **Status: unverified.**
- **Valuation and tax work (undated ET report).** ET reports that Razorpay, "which was last valued at $7.5 billion, is working with consulting firm Deloitte" on domicile-related valuation matters, following reporting on Groww's lower fair-market valuation ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). The date is not visible in the supplied text, so this is not confirmed as in-window.
- **IPO bankers (undated ET report).** ET reports that Razorpay "picks Axis, Kotak, Citi, and JPMorgan to manage its IPO," with a target "towards the middle of this year" ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). Because the timing reference is ambiguous and conflicts with the m.Stock account, this is **unverified as to date**.

### Product Launches

The supplied material contains no product launch that is both dated within the window and corroborated by a primary source, other than the 3 November item above.

Undated material describes a broad agentic product suite. Razorpay's Sprint 2026 page lists offerings including "Payments on LLMs," "Razorpay for ChatGPT Apps," "Voice Payments," "Agentic Onboarding," "Ray Customer Support," and "Agentic Dashboard," and describes "100+ Launches" ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)). Because the page is undated, these cannot be attributed to the window.

A LinkedIn keynote post describes four launches (Agentic Platform, Agentic Payments, Agent Studio, and Agentic Business Banking) and states that "the Agentic Era has begun" ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/razorpay_keynote-reimagining-money-movement-activity-7437771494610411520-QuVn)). The post refers to "FTX 2026," which is probably a typo for a different event name. It is undated and should be verified before citing the event.

A YouTube video describes the COO discussing "Netbanking 2.0" and "Agentic Commerce" launches ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ia5i2GZHlFc)). The upload date and the COO's name are not visible, so this is also **unverified as to timing**.

### Executive and Key Hires

- **Engineering leadership (date not visible).** An Analytics India Magazine post reports that four senior engineering leaders joined from Microsoft, Salesforce, CRED, and Divyam.AI. These include Sudhir Reddy, who "joins as Razorpay's senior-most individual contributor to lead AI and Data architecture" ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)). The post places the hires after Praburam Rambadran's arrival as Senior Vice President of Engineering in September 2025 ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)). The announcement date is not in the supplied text. These hires are probably recent but are **not confirmed as in-window**.
- **Name inconsistency.** The engineering leader appears as "Prabu Rambadran" in Razorpay's own release ([Razorpay, 2025](https://razorpay.com/newsroom/razorpay-strengthens-tech-leadership-appoints-ex-google-leader-prabu-rambadran-as-sr-vice-president-engineering)), as "Prabhu Rambadran" in an ET headline ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)), and as "Praburam Rambadran" in the AIM post. Attendees should confirm the correct name and title.
- **CEO, North America (September 2025, outside window).** Razorpay appointed a CEO for North America to support U.S. SMB expansion ([Wenham Carter, 2025](https://www.wenhamcarter.com/razorpay-appoints-ceo-north-america-to-spearhead-expansion-redefining-payments-and-financial-services-for-u-s-smbs)). The executive is not named in the supplied text, and the appointment falls well outside the window.

### Deals, Partnerships and Investments

- **Acquisitions.** No acquisition is verifiably dated within the window. Tracxn reports seven acquisitions, averaging $200M, but its own FAQ names PoshVine (September 2022) as the most recent acquisition ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)). This conflicts with a YouTube title referring to a "7th Acquisition" ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yseaO5e_v80)), and the date of that video is not visible.
- **Agentic partnerships (undated).** ET reports that "NPCI and Razorpay are partnering with OpenAI" to bring agentic payments to ChatGPT, with BigBasket among the first merchants ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). The date is not confirmed, so this is **not verified as in-window**.
- **Investments.** ET reports that Razorpay's valuation was "last valued at $7.5 billion" ([The Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)), which is consistent with other references in the supplied material. No new funding round is verifiably dated within the window.

---

The 18 August date is used here because DD News shows an explicit timestamp, but the discrepancy should be noted.

| Engineering executive name | Three spellings across sources | Needs confirmation |
| COO launch video | Date and COO name not visible | Unverified |

---

## Assessment

**What changed materially.** The verifiable in-window change is the GIFT City IFSCA licence, which extends Razorpay's regulated footprint for cross-border money movement ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). The most material unverified change is the reported SEBI approval, which, if confirmed, would move the company from private to public-market preparation within months.

**Strategic direction.** Razorpay's messaging is coherent. Across its newsroom, product pages, and executive hires, the company consistently positions itself around agentic AI, with payments on ChatGPT and Claude, AI onboarding, and AI-driven banking ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)). The hiring of senior AI and data architects is consistent with that focus ([Analytics India Magazine, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/analytics-india-magazine_razorpay-ai-fintech-activity-7490353347590311936-jESz)).

**Key risk for the discussion.** Much of the agentic story is in pilots, partnerships, and marketing pages. The supplied material does not show merchant volumes, revenue contribution, or regulatory clearance for these products. Attendees should separate announced capability from commercial traction.

**IPO readiness.** The IPO narrative is the most important item for investors and partners, and it is the least reliably sourced. Until a DRHP or SEBI filing is confirmed through a primary or regulatory source, any timeline should be treated as provisional.

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Razorpay

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window covered:** 18 October to 17 November 2026 (sources dated 2 to 15 November 2026)

## Regulatory

- Razorpay received its final Payment Service Provider licence from IFSCA to operate from GIFT City, following in-principle approval in April 2026. The licence covers moving money in and out of India under one regulatory framework (https://yourstory.com/2026/11/startup-news-and-updates-daily-roundup-november-02-2026; https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-gets-final-ifsca-licence-cross-border-payments-gift-city-126110200734_1.html).
- The licence could also support transfers by non-resident Indians to their families in India. It adds to Razorpay's existing RBI permissions for online, offline and cross-border payments (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/razorpay-gets-gift-city-licence-for-cross-border-payments/articleshow/135470766.cms).

## IPO

- SEBI issued final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November, clearing the next stages of listing (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).
- Reports put the issue at ₹5,000–6,000 crore with a target valuation of about $5 billion (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ipo-razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-5-000-6-000-crore-issue-eyes-5-billion-valuation/article-202997). Inc42 cites ₹6,000 crore (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo). ET cites ₹5,500–6,500 crore (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms). The figures differ across sources, so confirm before citing.
- ET reports a potential 2027 listing and says the company is exploring the raise amid valuation and profitability questions (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).

## Deals

- A wire report says a company agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **The excerpt does not name Razorpay.** Do not attribute this deal to Razorpay until the link is verified.

## Hires and launches

- No hires or product launches within the window were found in the sources.

## Background (undated)

- Profile lists Bangalore HQ, B2B business model, and total funding of $834.43M across 12 rounds (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7). This is undated, so treat it as background only.

## Open questions

1. Does the Globex Corporation acquisition report apply to Razorpay, and if so, how does it affect the planned IPO timeline and the ~$5 billion valuation target?
2. Which final IPO size and valuation should we use (₹5,000–6,000 crore, ₹5,500–6,500 crore, or ₹6,000 crore), and what is the expected listing window given the 2027 target?
3. Following the GIFT City licence, what is the rollout plan for cross-border flows and NRI transfers, and which corridors or products come first?

# Infosys Pre-Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing supports a meeting with Infosys on 17 November 2026. The requested window is the last 30 days (approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026). The retrieved material does not contain a verifiable item dated inside that window, so this briefing uses the most recent available material and flags every gap. Several retrieved items are outdated or undated, and one retrieved entity profile concerned an unrelated company (Globex Corporation) and was excluded.

## Executive Summary

- **No dated news from the 30-day window was retrieved.** The most recent dated source is a *Times of India* report published 29 September 2026, about 47 days before the meeting ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).
- **Workforce strategy is the dominant recent theme.** Infosys reportedly plans to move between one-quarter and one-third of its more than 320,000 employees into specialist roles and to build a team of about 6,000 "frontier engineers" ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).
- **Fresher hiring is continuing while total headcount is reported to be falling.** Infosys has committed to onboarding more than 20,000 freshers in FY27 ([HireDoor Team, 2026](https://hiredoor.in/blog/infosys-20000-freshers-hiring-2026)).
- **No recent deals or product launches were verifiable** in the retrieved material.
- **The U.S. hiring commitment cited in most coverage is from 2020** and should not be presented as a current figure.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Verification Result

No retrieved source falls clearly within 16 October to 15 November 2026. The table below shows the dates of each source, which determine how each can be used.

| Item | Date | Within 30-day window? | Use in briefing |
|---|---|---|---|
| TOI report on specialist roles and frontier engineers | 29 Sep 2026 | No (about 47 days old) | Most recent substantive item; treat as "recent context" |
| HireDoor article on FY27 fresher hiring | 8 Jul 2026 | No | Recent context; secondary source |
| YouTube video "Infosys Announces 20K New Hires In FY27" | Undated | Cannot be determined | Headline only; not verified in content |
| LinkedIn post (Startup Originals) on FY26 H1 hiring | Undated (refers to quarter ending 30 Sep 2025) | No | Historical baseline only |
| Yahoo Finance article on 12,000 U.S. hires | 1 Sep 2020 | No | Outdated; do not present as current |

### News

The *Times of India* report, citing people who attended Infosys's 2026 Americas Confluence in Washington, DC, says the company is recruiting from leading Indian institutes and U.S. campuses and is often competing with AI labs for the same candidates ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). The same report quotes Infosys as saying it has not restructured, which the outlet contrasts with many peers ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

### Launches

No new product or platform launch was verifiable. The report references Infosys Cobalt, described as the company's AI-powered cloud platform, and notes that Infosys is pursuing a model-agnostic strategy and working with open-weight models for enterprise clients ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). These are existing capabilities, not confirmed new launches.

### Hires

The FY27 fresher commitment is the most significant recent hiring signal. HireDoor reports that Infosys has committed to onboarding more than 20,000 fresh graduates in FY27, matching the FY26 intake, with priority roles in systems engineering, data analytics, and cloud automation support ([HireDoor Team, 2026](https://hiredoor.in/blog/infosys-20000-freshers-hiring-2026)). A YouTube video carries a similar headline, "Infosys Announces 20K New Hires In FY27," but its content and date could not be verified ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FN4pRie-8Xo)).

### Deals

No new client deals or contract wins were identified in the retrieved material. The only deal-related reference is a description of how Infosys has, in some deals, taken on clients' surplus staff and redeployed them ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). This is an operating practice, not a dated transaction.

## Key Figures and Trajectory

The table below consolidates the workforce and hiring figures from the sources and notes their dates.

| Metric | Value | Period | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Total headcount | 331,991 | Quarter ending 30 Sep 2025 (FY26 H1) | [Startup Originals, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/startuporiginals_startuporiginals-infosys-hiring-activity-7387329524017004544-6dET) |
| Total headcount | More than 320,000 | Reported September 2026 | [TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) |
| Freshers hired | About 12,000 | First half of FY26 | [Startup Originals, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/startuporiginals_startuporiginals-infosys-hiring-activity-7387329524017004544-6dET) |
| Freshers target | More than 20,000 | FY27 | [HireDoor Team, 2026](https://hiredoor.in/blog/infosys-20000-freshers-hiring-2026) |
| Employees with AI training | 270,000 | Presented at 2026 event | [TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) |
| Employees on coding tools | 80,000 | Presented at 2026 event | [TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) |
| Attrition | 14.3% | Quarter ending 30 Sep 2025 | [Startup Originals, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/startuporiginals_startuporiginals-infosys-hiring-activity-7387329524017004544-6dET) |
| Revenue | $20 billion | Period not specified | [TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms) |

Headcount moved from roughly 332,000 (September 2025) to "more than 320,000" (September 2026). This implies a decline of at least about 12,000, though the sources do not state an exact figure. The HireDoor article also states that overall headcount has declined ([HireDoor Team, 2026](https://hiredoor.in/blog/infosys-20000-freshers-hiring-2026)).

### Legacy U.S. Commitment (Outdated)

In September 2020, Infosys announced plans to hire 12,000 employees in the U.S. over two years, bringing its total job commitments to 25,000 over five years ([Fujita, 2020](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/infosys-commits-to-hiring-12000-american-workers-expanding-us-footprint-130006173.html)). The company also said it had launched six technology and innovation centers in Indiana, North Carolina, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Texas, and Arizona over the preceding three years ([Fujita, 2020](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/infosys-commits-to-hiring-12000-american-workers-expanding-us-footprint-130006173.html)). Because the two-year window has long expired, this should be described as historical. No evidence in the retrieved material confirms whether the target was met.

## Strategic Assessment

Based on the available evidence, my assessment is as follows.

1. **Infosys is restructuring its talent model, not simply shrinking it.** Fresher hiring is held at more than 20,000 while the total workforce declines. This suggests a shift toward lower-cost, trainable entry-level talent and specialist skills rather than a general contraction. The HireDoor article frames this as entry-level hiring being "more targeted" rather than slowed ([HireDoor Team, 2026](https://hiredoor.in/blog/infosys-20000-freshers-hiring-2026)).

2. **The underlying driver is pricing pressure.** The TOI report states that AI is weakening billing models tied to the number of people deployed, and that Infosys is therefore emphasizing outcome-based pricing ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). If revenue increasingly depends on outcomes rather than headcount, the workforce will need to become smaller and more specialized. This is the most consequential trend in the material.

3. **Competition for talent is intensifying.** Infosys reportedly competes with AI labs for the same candidates ([TOI Business Desk, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms). The 6,000 frontier-engineer target is a direct response to this competition. Whether the company can fill it at a competitive cost is an open question.

4. **Reliability caveat.** Most of the strategic claims rest on a single news report that relies on unnamed attendees and analyst accounts, with management statements paraphrased rather than quoted directly. They should be treated as credible but not confirmed by company disclosure.

## Information Gaps and Verification Flags

| Gap | Status | Action before meeting |
|---|---|---|
| Any news or filings dated 16 Oct to 15 Nov 2026 | Not found | Check Infosys investor relations, press releases, and exchange filings |
| Q2 FY27 results and headcount (quarter ending Sep 2026) | Not retrieved | Verify official figures and reconcile with "more than 320,000" |
| Frontier-engineer and specialist-role targets | Reported by unnamed attendees | Seek confirmation from the company |
| Status of 2020 U.S. hiring commitment | Unknown | Ask the company for an update |
| Client deals and contract wins | None retrieved | Review recent client announcements |
| Date and content of FY27 hiring video | Unverified | Confirm the announcement directly |
| Exact headcount decline | Inferred, not stated | Obtain the official figure |

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Workforce transition:** Of the roughly 80,000 employees working with coding tools and 270,000 who have received AI training, what criteria will determine who moves into specialist roles, and how will the company measure success within the next 12 months?

2. **Pricing model:** As Infosys shifts toward outcome-based pricing, what share of current revenue is already on this model, and what does the company expect the revenue mix to look like in FY28?

3. **Talent pipeline:** Given the 20,000-plus fresher commitment and the target of 6,000 frontier engineers, how is Infosys competing with AI labs for talent, and what is the status of the 2020 U.S. hiring commitment in terms of verified hires and remaining obligations?

# Zepto: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Look-back window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026
**Purpose:** Summarise material changes in news, launches, leadership, and deals before the 17 November meeting.

---

## Executive Summary

- **IPO timing has slipped again.** Zepto now plans to list between February and May 2027, after an earlier July 2026 target. The company says it will update its draft papers with newer financials ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).
- **A pre-IPO round is the bridge.** Zepto is reported to be raising about $105 million (₹1,000 crore) at a valuation of about $4.5 billion ([Mint/PTI, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/zepto-to-raise-rs-1-000-crore-in-pre-ipo-round-at-usd-4-5-billion-valuation-public-listing-delayed-11785430328994.html)). The company has confirmed a pre-IPO private placement but has not disclosed terms ([Moneycontrol News, 2026](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/startup/zepto-announces-pre-ipo-private-placement-to-list-within-sebi-approved-timeline-13991005.html)).
- **Regulatory and compliance items surfaced in October.** These include a municipal fine in Bengaluru and a state-level licence action in Uttar Pradesh. The latter was not attributed to Zepto by name.
- **No verified product launches or executive hires were found in the window.**

---

## Changes in the Last 30 Days

### News and Corporate Developments

**IPO timeline reset.** The most material change is the revised listing window. In a town hall, co-founder and CEO Aadit Palicha told employees that Zepto plans to list between February and May 2027 and will update its DRHP with newer financials ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). The report states that SEBI's clearance is expected to remain valid until November 2027 ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). The article's publication date is not shown in the extract. Its sidebar lists items dated 8–11 November 2026, so it was likely published in mid-November. **This date is unverified.**

**Regulatory actions (October 2026).**
- On 12 October 2026, the Bengaluru East City Corporation fined Zepto ₹5,000 for failing to follow solid waste segregation rules. This was part of a wider commercial waste enforcement campaign ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))). This date falls just outside the 30-day window and is included for context.
- On 24 October 2026, the Uttar Pradesh Food Safety and Drug Administration suspended licences for four dark stores and warehouses run by food delivery and quick-commerce platforms. The source does not name Zepto as an operator of the affected sites. **Zepto's involvement is unverified** ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))).

### Product Launches

No verified product launch was found in the window. The Zepto Nova "Pitch in 10" programme is a supplier-onboarding initiative, not a consumer product launch. Its applications closed on 22 May 2026, with results announced on 31 July 2026 ([Startup Grants India, n.d.](https://www.startupgrantsindia.com/competitions/zepto-nova-pitch-in-10-programme)). It falls outside the window. The source page does not show the selected participants.

### Executive and Key Hires

**No verified hires or departures were identified in the window.** The only leadership reference is Aadit Palicha's town hall address to employees ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). Reuters reported that Enforcement Directorate summoned co-founders Aadit Palicha and Kaivalya Vohra in April 2026. Zepto said both complied and that no further communication had been received as of the June filing date ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)). This item is outside the window and is included for risk context.

### Deals, Partnerships, and Capital

**Pre-IPO placement.** The reported round is about ₹1,000 crore (approximately $105 million) at a valuation of about $4.5 billion. Reports say the investors may include domestic institutions and existing backers General Catalyst, Goodwater Capital, and Nexus Venture Partners ([New Indian Express, 2026](https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2026/Jul/30/zepto-eyes-rs-1000-crore-pre-ipo-funding-listing-schedule-moves-back-by-weeks)). Under SEBI rules, a pre-IPO placement can be up to 20% of the proposed fresh issue, and the amount is deducted from that fresh issue ([New Indian Express, 2026](https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2026/Jul/30/zepto-eyes-rs-1000-crore-pre-ipo-funding-listing-schedule-moves-back-by-weeks)). The LinkedIn source says the round will come from domestic and overseas investors ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). **The closing status and final terms are unverified.** The placement was first reported in late July, so the timing of the change is not confirmed as new.

---

## Context: How the IPO Story Has Changed

| Date | Reported Item | Key Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dec 2025 | Confidential DRHP filing; conversion to public company | Target listing in 2026 | [Moneycontrol News, 2025](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/startup/zepto-converts-to-a-public-company-ahead-of-planned-ipo-in-2026-13713491.html) |
| Jan 2026 | Target issue size and valuation | ₹11,000 crore (~$1.2bn) at $7–8bn | [Team Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026) |
| May 2026 | Reported July 2026 IPO plan | ₹11,000 crore | [PTI, 2026](http://hospitality.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/operations/technology/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-cr-ipo-in-july-2026/131255022) |
| Jun 2026 | Updated draft papers | Up to $837m; ₹8,010 crore fresh issue | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |
| Jul 2026 | Pre-IPO round and delay | ~$4.5bn valuation | [Mint/PTI, 2026](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/zepto-to-raise-rs-1-000-crore-in-pre-ipo-round-at-usd-4-5-billion-valuation-public-listing-delayed-11785430328994.html) |
| Nov 2026 | Revised listing window | February–May 2027 | [LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc) |

Note that the Reuters article gives two different rupee amounts for the IPO. It cites "up to $837 million" and also "110 billion rupee ($1.15 billion)" ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)). The reason for the gap is not explained in the source.

---

## Financial Snapshot

Reuters reports the following from the updated DRHP for the year ended 31 March 2026 ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)):

| Metric | FY26 (year ended 31 Mar 2026) | Approx. USD* |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | ₹226.24 bn (more than doubled year on year) | ~$2.36 bn |
| Net loss | ₹59.05 bn (up from ₹47 bn) | ~$0.62 bn |
| Loss as % of revenue | ~26% | n/a |

*Conversions use the ₹95.7 per US dollar rate cited in the Reuters article. The rate is from June 2026 and is shown for scale only.

The loss rose faster than the revenue base in relative terms, which is consistent with the company's stated focus on reducing cash burn ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).

---

## Source Reliability and Unverified Items

| Item | Reliability Assessment | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Revised listing window (Feb–May 2027) | Single secondary source; publication date not shown | Partly verified; date unverified |
| $105m pre-IPO round | Consistent across LinkedIn, TNIE, and Mint; terms not confirmed by company | Reported, not confirmed |
| ~$4.5bn valuation | Mint and TNIE, both citing sources | Reported, not confirmed |
| UP licence suspensions | Wikipedia summary; Zepto not named | Unverified for Zepto |
| Dhan ₹11,000 crore / $7–8bn target | Dated January 2026; superseded by later reports | Outdated |
| ETHospitalityWorld article | URL domain differs from title source | Verify before external use |
| Zepto Nova results | Programme page shows no results content | Unverified |

---

## Our Assessment

Based on the available evidence, we hold three views.

1. **The valuation reset is the central issue.** The reported ~$4.5 billion pre-IPO valuation is about 36% below the $7 billion valuation Reuters cites for Zepto's October 2025 round ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)). If that figure holds, the company's listing will need to be priced against a lower mark than the one it previously sought. This matters for existing investors, and it is a more significant change than the timing slip alone.

2. **The company is prioritising capital discipline over speed to market.** The delay, the bridge round, and the stated plan to curtail burn and optimise dark stores all point the same way ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). With FY26 losses of ₹59.05 billion, that approach is reasonable. The unresolved question is whether cost cuts can reduce losses fast enough to support the February–May 2027 window.

3. **The timeline has more room than it did.** SEBI clearance is reported to remain valid until November 2027 ([LinkedIn Pulse, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). That gives Zepto roughly twelve months to list, which reduces the risk of a forced listing at a weak price. It also means the company could face further delays if markets or its financials weaken.

Regulatory exposure is a secondary but real concern. The Bengaluru fine is small in value, but the pattern of municipal and state-level actions is relevant to a listing-stage disclosure exercise.

---

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **What are the terms and status of the pre-IPO round?** Please confirm the amount, valuation, investor mix, and whether the round has closed. Also clarify how the valuation reset will be reflected in the IPO price range and in the updated DRHP.

2. **What burn-reduction targets and timelines apply to the February–May 2027 window?** Please share specific goals for net loss, cash burn, and dark store count. Also explain which stores or sites are being optimised and whether any closures are linked to the recent regulatory actions.

3. **How are the regulatory matters being disclosed and resolved?** Please confirm the status of the Enforcement Directorate inquiry, the October municipal and state-level actions, and whether any of them will be disclosed as risk factors in the updated DRHP.

---

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Developments from roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026, drawn only from the search results provided. No hiring news was found.

## What changed (last 30 days)

**Deals**
- A wire report says Zepto has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter. The snippet does not explicitly name Zepto, so confirm the target before relying on it. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)
- A social media post dated 7 November claims a "Zepto valuation 7 billion." This is an unverified user post. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)

**Launches and marketing**
- Zepto ran a brand activation tied to Seoul Street and said Anime India is next. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta commented. Zepto did not say which fandom comes next. A Hyderabad fan event was scheduled for 14 November. (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago)

**Demand and operations**
- Zepto delivered over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour during Dhanteras 2026, as festive quick-commerce demand surged. (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm)
- Zepto recorded 3X growth in festive hamper orders versus last Diwali. (https://www.ndtvprofit.com/business/from-gold-coins-to-diet-coke-what-diwali-shopping-carts-reveal-about-indias-consumption-12309693)

**Regulation**
- Maharashtra's FDA suspended food licences for Blinkit, Zepto and 103 others, with actions taken on 4 and 5 November. The suspensions covered 105 licences in total. (https://www.rediff.com/news/commentary/2026/nov/06/fda-suspends-food-licence-of-blinkit-zepto-103-others/14358878a29915ea01709670aa484bc5)

**Workforce**
- Zepto moved its post-Diwali scheduled holiday from Tuesday to Monday. HR chief Sneha Arora said the aim was a longer weekend for employees. (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms)
- A viral video alleged a delivery partner received "cash-like coupons" instead of a cash Diwali bonus. Commenters criticised gig-worker welfare. (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html)

**Hires:** No hiring or leadership changes were found in the results.

## Background (undated or older)
- Company profile: Zepto Marketplace Private Limited, founded 2021, headquartered in India, privately held. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)
- Funding entries listed: a $450M Series H dated 2025-11-16 and a $100M venture round dated 2026-07-01. Both fall outside the 30-day window. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58)

## Open questions
1. Is Zepto the company in the Globex acquisition report, and what is the status of the deal and its expected close?
2. What steps are being taken on the Maharashtra licence suspensions, and how is compliance being handled across food operations?
3. How is Zepto responding to the Diwali bonus complaints, and what is its policy on delivery-partner pay and benefits?

# NVIDIA Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026 (same day as fiscal Q3 2027 results)
**Coverage window:** Approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026, with earlier items included only as context

---

## Executive Summary

NVIDIA's co-founder and chief executive, Jensen Huang, resigned with immediate effect on 12 November 2026, and the board appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO while she keeps her finance role ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition)). The company says operations, customer commitments and the product roadmap should continue without interruption ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). Media reports tie the departure to extramarital affair allegations, and some outlets describe further security and espionage-related claims that I could not verify from the material provided ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)).

The same month brought a $500 billion-plus compute financing initiative with six major asset managers and banks, a Vera Rubin ramp into full production, and a sharp share-price reaction. Today's meeting falls on the day results are released, which means the company's first public read on whether the leadership change affects guidance, receivables and deal commitments will arrive during or just before the meeting.

---

## 1. Context and Scope

NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) describes itself as "the world leader in AI and accelerated computing" ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition)). Its fiscal year ends in late January, so fiscal Q3 2027 covers late July to late October 2026 and the quarter ended on 25 October 2026 ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873)).

Two points about the meeting itself:

- **Disclosure timing.** Results are posted at about 1:20 p.m. PT, with CFO commentary in writing, and the 2 p.m. PT call's Q&A is limited to financial analysts and institutional investors ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873)). Any discussion before publication should avoid material non-public information. Questions should focus on matters already in the public domain.
- **Source quality.** Several sources in this briefing are secondary, aggregated, or AI-assisted. Where a claim rests on one of these, the report says so.

---

## 2. What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### 2.1 Leadership

| Change | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| CEO departure | Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately. The board accepted the resignation on 11 November. | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition); [Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in) |
| Interim CEO | Colette Kress, EVP and CFO since September 2013, is interim CEO while keeping her CFO role until a permanent successor is named. | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition); [Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in) |
| Board chair | Harvey C. Jones was named the company's first-ever Chair of the Board. He has been a director since 1993 and is a former CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys. | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition); [Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in) |
| Succession search | The board is searching for a permanent CEO and will consider internal and external candidates. Reuters-sourced commentary names Kress, Ian Buck and Arm CEO Rene Haas as names under discussion. | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition); [Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress) |
| Board statements | Statements from the board and independent directors were issued on 8 and 10 November, before the resignation. Their titles are listed on the company newsroom. | [NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-partners-with-apollo-blackrock-blackstone-brookfield-goldman-sachs-and-kkr-to-establish-ai-compute-infrastructure-financing-platforms-to-mobilize-over-500-billion-of-third-party-capital) |

Kress has been cited by analysts and investors for her authority and her relationships with Wall Street ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)). Her tenure includes growth in annual revenue from $4.13 billion in fiscal 2014 to $215.9 billion in fiscal 2026 ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)).

### 2.2 Deals and Financing

On 12 November, NVIDIA announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish AI compute infrastructure financing platforms. The stated aim is to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital, subject to definitive agreements ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-partners-with-apollo-blackrock-blackstone-brookfield-goldman-sachs-and-kkr-to-establish-ai-compute-infrastructure-financing-platforms-to-mobilize-over-500-billion-of-third-party-capital)). Data Centre Magazine reports the same figure and the same condition ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)).

Two related items from the same period need careful reading:

- Network World reported on 11 August 2026 a $500 billion investment pool with six financial partners to help customers buy chips on credit ([Network World, 2026](https://www.networkworld.com/article/3562856/nvidia-latest-news-and-insights.html)). This is outside the 30-day window. Whether it is the same program as the November platforms is **not clear from the sources provided**, and the meeting should confirm the relationship.
- Tracxn lists the Hugging Face acquisition in September 2026 as NVIDIA's most recent acquisition. No acquisitions appear in the 30-day window in the provided material ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)).

### 2.3 Products and Partnerships

- **Vera Rubin.** The platform was ramping into full production, with racks running at CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). OpenAI's first gigawatt of NVIDIA systems was planned for the second half of 2026 on this platform ([OpenAI, 2025](https://openai.com/index/openai-nvidia-systems-partnership)).
- **Sovereign AI.** On 8 November, NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-partners-with-apollo-blackrock-blackstone-brookfield-goldman-sachs-and-kkr-to-establish-ai-compute-infrastructure-financing-platforms-to-mobilize-over-500-billion-of-third-party-capital)).
- **Ecosystem announcements in October.** Tracxn lists a Nutanix expansion, a Mercedes-Benz driving system, a robotaxi venture with Pony.ai and inDrive in Kazakhstan, and an expanded NVIDIA partnership with Meta on October 27 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)). Tracxn also reports that OpenAI planned to purchase Google's AI chips, which is a competitive signal in the same listing ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)).

### 2.4 Market Reaction

NVIDIA shares fell more than 13% in early trading on 12 November ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). A later quote snapshot on Yahoo Finance, captured on 13 November, shows NVDA down 3.12% for that session, with the Nasdaq down 0.91% ([Kollmann, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-110116748.html)). These figures come from different points in the session and should not be combined.

Quantisnow, an AI-assisted service, states that NVDA closed higher the next session three times and lower twice after the five leadership changes it tracks since October 2025. It adds that these moves show timing only ([Quantisnow, 2026](https://quantisnow.com/insight/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition-6786728)). The sample is very small and the source is paywalled, so this should be treated as context, not evidence.

---

## 3. Earnings Setup for 17 November

| Item | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Report date and time | Tuesday 17 November 2026; results about 1:20 p.m. PT; call at 2 p.m. PT | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873) |
| Revenue guidance | $108.0 billion, ±2% (about $105.84bn to $110.16bn), excluding China data center compute sales | [OANDA, 2026](https://www.oanda.com/eu-en/blog/NVIDIA-q3-earnings-preview-nov-2026) |
| Gross margin guidance | 74.0%, ±50 basis points | [CapitalMEG, 2026](https://www.cmelitegroup.com/knowledge-hub/nvidia-earnings-date) |
| Operating expense guidance | About $9.2bn GAAP; $9.0bn non-GAAP | [CapitalMEG, 2026](https://www.cmelitegroup.com/knowledge-hub/nvidia-earnings-date) |
| Consensus | Diluted EPS of $2.47; revenue near $108.8bn to $109.0bn | [InsiderFinance, 2026](https://www.insiderfinance.io/news/nvidia-earnings-set-for-nov-17-amid-sell-signals) |
| Prior quarter | Fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $96.2bn, up 18% from the prior quarter | [CapitalMEG, 2026](https://www.cmelitegroup.com/knowledge-hub/nvidia-earnings-date) |

| Receivables (last quarter) | $63 billion; collection time about 60 days, up from 45 | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html) |

| Other stakes | Intel, SpaceX, CoreWeave, Coherent and Safe Superintelligence; up to $10 billion pledged to Anthropic ahead of its IPO; $30 billion stake in OpenAI with a preliminary deal for up to $100 billion more | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html) |

Yahoo Finance also reports that CoreWeave's CEO said the company would not borrow without collateral at today's high rates, and that large technology companies are now net issuers of stock rather than net buyers ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html)).

---

## 4. Assessment

**My view is that the leadership change is primarily a governance and concentration-of-responsibility event, not yet an operating shock.** The evidence for continuity is real: the company has reaffirmed its roadmap, the Vera Rubin ramp is under way across major clouds, and the board chair has publicly backed Kress ([Data Centre Magazine, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). Nothing in the provided sources shows a change to guidance or a customer loss.

I consider three issues more decision-relevant than the CEO search itself.

1. **Concentration of roles.** Kress now holds the CFO and interim CEO roles at the same time. # Pre-Meeting Briefing: NVIDIA, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 Oct to 15 Nov 2026, based on the search results provided. Results are dated up to 15 Nov.

## Leadership change (dominant story)

- Jensen Huang has resigned as chairman, chief executive and director, with immediate effect. Colette Kress, CFO since September 2013, is interim CEO and remains CFO until a successor is chosen. (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)
- The board announced the resignation on 12 Nov 2026. (https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns)
- The board has started a search and will evaluate internal and external candidates. (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)
- On 8 Nov the board said it had "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team." (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors)
- The board said it would investigate after Huang admitted an affair. The NYT reports he also had a relationship with Kimberly Powell, a Nvidia vice president who reports to him. (https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns)
- Wired reported (per an aggregator headline only) that Nvidia hired a crisis PR firm at least a year before Huang acknowledged the affair. I could not verify the article body. (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-cbe54f11b05c0e59be5a05db_wired-_nvidia_hired)

## Deals and partnerships

- A report dated 15 Nov says a company "has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion," citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter. The source does not name the company. Do not assume it is Nvidia. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)
- A company profile lists Nvidia acquisitions including Hugging Face (1 Aug 2026, $12.90B), Kumo.AI (1 Jun 2026, $400M) and Illumex Technologies (1 Feb 2026, $60M). The page is undated, so these may not all fall in the 30-day window. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/TXRhn2TKUD7t)
- Nvidia, Rebellions and SK Telecom announced a collaboration on sovereign AI infrastructure using NVLink Fusion, dated 8 Nov 2026. Only the headline was available. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)
- An AWS and Nvidia announcement describes AWS deploying 2 million additional Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra GPUs across 2027 and 2028. Rubin reportedly moved into production shipments in H2 2026. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026)

## Launches and product

- Vera Rubin NVL72 debuted in Nvidia's MLPerf Inference v6.1 results in September 2026. (https://shattered.io/gpu-vs-tpu-vs-npu-ai-chip-camps-compared-2026)

## Hires and personnel

- Kress is interim CEO. The board has not named a permanent successor in the sources. (https://meteoraweb.com/en/news/nvidia-jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo)
- President Trump posted on social media that Tim Cook, former Apple CEO, should replace Huang. This is a political comment, not a board decision. (https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/12/business/nvidia-jensen-huang-resigns)

## Timing note

- Nvidia is scheduled to release quarterly results around 4:20 p.m. ET on Tuesday 17 Nov, with an earnings call at 5 p.m. ET. It is the first call since Huang's exit. (https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-affairs-nvidia-resignation-timeline)

## Gaps

- I could not find the body text of the board's 10 Nov statement from the independent members. (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)
- I found no source confirming Nvidia's role in the Globex deal or any outcome of the board investigation.

## Open questions

1. What is the timeline and shortlist for the permanent CEO search, and will Kress keep the CFO role alongside interim CEO?
2. What is the status and scope of the board investigation, and does it affect any other executives or commitments?
3. Given today's earnings call, how is the Rubin ramp and the AWS 2027–2028 GPU commitment tracking, and has guidance changed?

## Analysis and Our View

The provided evidence supports a clear, if incomplete, reading of Stripe's direction. Stripe appears to be concentrating resources on two adjacent bets: stablecoin and crypto infrastructure, and AI-driven commerce.

**Our view:** The stablecoin push is the more consequential of the two. It has a named leader, a named blockchain (Tempo), and a named third-party issuer (Klarna) ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/companies/stripe); [DL News, n.d.](https://www.dlnews.com/articles/markets/paypal-and-stripe-amond-fintechs-muscling-into-crypto-in-2026)). The AI-commerce launch in Japan is a single, dated market entry, and the sources do not show whether it has been followed by senior go-to-market hiring ([MitchelLake, 2026](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/companies/stripe)). We therefore treat it as an early signal rather than an established line of business.

On scale, the reported figures suggest a large but not extraordinary per-employee revenue profile. The roughly US$600,000 per employee ratio is arithmetically consistent with the reported inputs, but it depends on secondary figures that have not been confirmed against primary disclosures ([Bonenkamp, 2026](https://blog.mean.ceo/stripe-news-november-2026)).

The thinness of the in-window record is itself a finding. Either Stripe announced little in the period, or the available sources did not capture it. Before the meeting, the team should check Stripe's own newsroom and developer changelog, which are not in the provided material.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Tempo and stablecoins:** What is the commercial model for Tempo and the stablecoin business led by the new appointee, and what share of the business does it need to reach before it is material? Is the KlarnaUSD mainnet date still 2026, and has the partner list in the DL News article been confirmed for Stripe specifically?

2. **AI commerce:** Following the Japan launch of the AI shopping product, which markets are next, and which senior go-to-market hires are planned to support them? Which of the named AI partners are live customers and which are exploratory?

3. **Capital structure and disclosure:** Given the 2023 funding round and the headline that Stripe is staying private, does Stripe plan any secondary sale or primary raise in the next 12 months, and will it publish audited revenue figures to replace the 2024 numbers now in circulation?
