# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Stripe, 17 November 2026

**Window:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are the search results provided; no other information was used.

## Deals

- Stripe's acquisition-related news in the results is thin. One report says the company agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced, 2026-11-15). **The excerpt does not name Stripe**, so confirm that this item concerns Stripe before relying on it.
- Reports in several outlets say Stripe and Advent International bid more than $53 billion for PayPal, framed as a stablecoin-and-wallets play. These are reports, not confirmed transactions (https://www.financexmagazine.com/post/stablecoins-storm-the-rails-swift-builds-a-blockchain-and-wero-hits-52-million-payments-just-had, 2026-11-09).
- Stripe's company profile lists OpenRouter, Inc. (7.50B USD, dated 2026-08-01), Clerky, Inc. (2026-08-01) and Valora, Inc. (2025-12-01). These fall outside the 30-day window, so treat them as background. The profile is undated (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/igPwhNOUwEGy).

## Launches and Product

- **Global Payouts wallet capability:** US businesses can send stablecoin payouts directly to crypto wallets in 160+ markets. It launched in public preview in early November 2026 (https://cryptonews.net/news/market/33703716, 2026-11-04).
- **Stablecoin prototype:** Stripe is reportedly building a stablecoin prototype that combines Bridge's issuance and settlement capabilities with its payments stack. The source attributes this to CoinGape. Bridge itself was acquired for $1.1B last year (https://www.financexmagazine.com/post/stablecoins-storm-the-rails-swift-builds-a-blockchain-and-wero-hits-52-million-payments-just-had, 2026-11-09).
- **Celo / MiniPay:** MiniPay's integration of Link by Stripe went live on 12 November, giving users in the EU and US a one-click fiat-to-stablecoin onramp. MiniPay has more than 20 million wallets (https://www.tradingview.com/news/coinmarketcal:ce753058b094b:0-celo-minipay-integrates-link-by-stripe-for-one-click-stablecoin-purchases-12-nov-2026, 2026-11-12).

## Hires

No hiring news was found in the results. Stripe's leadership changes should be checked separately before the meeting.

## Market Context

- AI assistants from Meta and others have recently been enabled to make purchases on cardholders' behalf, which banks are racing to address. The excerpt does not mention Stripe (https://www.wsj.com/finance/ai-bots-are-using-credit-cards-banks-are-racing-to-keep-up-c30dda30, 2026-11-13).

## Excluded

Several results matched the name "Stripe" but concern other subjects, including a sports team, a university, and a fashion item. They were excluded.

## Open questions

1. **Globex:** Is Stripe the party in the reported $9.4 billion agreement, and if so, how does a pending acquisition affect partnership or roadmap commitments we discuss?
2. **Stablecoins and PayPal:** What is the timeline for the stablecoin prototype and Bridge integration, and what is Stripe's position on the reported PayPal bid?
3. **Global Payouts:** When does the wallet payout capability move from public preview to general availability, and which markets are next after the 160+ currently covered?

# Shopify Meeting Briefing: Material Changes, 18 October to 17 November 2026

**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026 | **Review window:** 18 October to 17 November 2026 | **Prepared:** 15 November 2026

## Executive Summary

Most verifiable Shopify activity in the 30-day window is product and compliance news, not executive moves or deals. The main items are the Rollouts catalog-scheduling expansion for Black Friday/Cyber Monday (BFCM), the EU product-identifier requirement that took effect on 1 November, and the scheduled Q3 2026 results call on 3 November. I found no verified executive hires, partnerships, or acquisitions in the window. Several items rely on secondary trackers and could not be confirmed against Shopify's own changelog, so they are flagged below.

## Scope and Source Reliability

Shopify's own pages were treated as the most reliable sources. Shopify's press-release index and the Canvas announcement are primary. Third-party trackers (The Common Thread Co., Huptech Web, Fudge, Mastroke) were used only where primary confirmation was unavailable, and each such item is marked as unverified. Items dated before 18 October are shown only as context.

## 1. Product and Platform Changes

### 1.1 Rollouts Expands to Full Catalog Scheduling (23 October)

A secondary tracker reports that Shopify expanded Rollouts to schedule entire product catalogs. Brands can set when catalogs go live, switch between them at set times, and bundle pricing changes with theme and checkout updates in one deploy. The tracker lists three capabilities: scheduled catalog changes, A/B testing of offers, and coordinated launches ([The Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)).

The same tracker notes that Rollouts gained discount support on 2 October, with "Experiment mode" on the Grow plan and above splitting traffic 50/50 and needing 7 to 14 days for significance ([The Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)). That date falls before the window.

**Verification flag:** The 23 October entry states that Black Friday was "29 days away." From 23 October, Black Friday (27 November) is 35 days away, so the tracker contains an internal inconsistency. The feature itself is **[UNVERIFIED]** against Shopify's primary changelog.

### 1.2 Shopify Canvas (Context: Launched 1 October)

Canvas is a generative-AI design surface that lets merchants build and edit themes with Sidekick, Shopify's AI agent. Shopify states that it is "rolling out over the coming days" ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/introducing-canvas)). Canvas launched outside the window, but its rollout continued into it.

Canvas does not yet support third-party themes, Markets, Rollouts, translations, or app blocks at launch ([Wijsmuller, 2026](https://askphill.com/blogs/blog/shopify-canvas)). Ask Phill's review also reports that Shopify says Sidekick made more than 25 million theme edits in the first half of 2026. This figure is attributed to Shopify through a third-party reviewer and is **[UNVERIFIED]** directly ([Wijsmuller, 2026](https://askphill.com/blogs/blog/shopify-canvas)).

### 1.3 EU Product Identifier Requirement (Effective 1 November)

A tracker reports that the EU requires three product identifiers (GTIN, EAN, UPC, or ISBN) on each direct-to-consumer parcel under €150. Brands using Shopify Shipping or Managed Markets must add barcodes by 1 November or face blocked label purchases and customs rejections ([The Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)).

**Verification flag:** This is a regulatory requirement reported by a secondary source. I did not find a primary Shopify or EU source in the provided material, so the enforcement details are **[UNVERIFIED]**.

### 1.4 App Activity Visibility (Undated)

A third-party source describes a new app activity view showing data access, Admin API activity over 30 days, and permission changes ([Mastroke, n.d.](https://blog.mastroke.com/news/latest-shopify-updates-2026)). The publication date was not provided, so it **cannot be confirmed as falling within the window**.

## 2. Corporate Activity

### 2.1 Q3 2026 Results (3 November)

Shopify's 6 October advisory states that it will report results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 before markets open on 3 November, with a call at 8:30 a.m. ET ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/shopify-q3-2026-financial-advisory)). The results date is confirmed.

A related-article link on the same page is headlined "Shopify Sustains Rapid Growth with Revenue Up 32% and Free Cash Flow Margin of 22%" ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/shopify-q3-2026-financial-advisory)). The page does not show its date, and it may refer to Q2 or Q3. **The headline's figures and period are [UNVERIFIED]**, and this briefing should not rely on them until the release itself is checked.

### 2.2 Earlier Financial Context

Shopify's press index lists "Shopify Delivers Big: 30%+ Growth Across GMV, Revenue, Gross Profit, and Free Cash Flow" dated 5 August 2026, which predates the window ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/search)). Shopify also announced a $3 billion increase to its share repurchase program on 2 June 2026 ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/search)).

## 3. Hires, Partnerships, and Deals

| Category | Window findings (18 Oct to 17 Nov) | Latest verified item | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Executive or key hires | None identified | Jeanne DeWitt Grosser joined the board, 16 June 2026 ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/search)) | No in-window hire verified |
| Partnerships | None identified | Spring '26 Edition five-app showcase, 17 June 2026 ([Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/search)) | No in-window partnership verified |
| Acquisitions and investments | None identified | Organic Traditions Series A, 21 July 2026, with Shopify listed as a participant ([PrivSource, 2026](https://www.privsource.com/firms/shopify-aorg_LeDj5bBKrp)) | Tracker reports one deal in the last 12 months |
| Historical context | Deliverr, $2.1 billion, closed July 2022 ([PrivSource, 2026](https://www.privsource.com/firms/shopify-aorg_LeDj5bBKrp)) | Largest acquisition to date ([BetaKit, n.d.](https://betakit.com/shopify-delivers-1-2-billion-usd-deliverr-deal-to-expand-fulfillment-network)) | Context only |

The Deliverr transaction was reported as 80% cash and 20% Class A shares ([Built In San Francisco, n.d.](https://www.builtinsf.com/articles/shopify-acquires-deliverr-2b-ecommerce-logistics)). The information on the Organic Traditions round was taken from a deal-tracking database and is not a Shopify announcement.

## 4. Deadlines and Forward-Looking Items

| Date | Item | Source | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 November 2026 | EU product identifiers required | [The Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly) | Secondary only |
| 3 November 2026 | Q3 2026 results and call | [Shopify, 2026](https://www.shopify.com/news/shopify-q3-2026-financial-advisory) | Confirmed |
| 27 November 2026 | BFCM catalog activation (brand-recommended) | [The Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly) | Secondary only |
| 1 March 2027 | Script tag deprecation, second phase | [The Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly) | Secondary only |

The Script tag deprecation applies to all plans, including Shopify Plus. The first phase was 1 October 2026 ([The Common Thread Co., 2026](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/every-shopify-update-in-2026-updated-weekly)).

The Scripts shutdown on 30 June 2026 was a major disruption for Plus stores with complex discount logic and is useful context for how Shopify handles deprecations ([Fudge, 2026](https://www.fudge.ai/blog/shopify-updates-june-2026)).

## 5. Analysis

The window's verifiable activity points to a clear pattern. Shopify's near-term product effort is focused on AI-assisted building (Canvas and Sidekick) and on merchant-controlled launch management (Rollouts). Both are aimed at reducing launch risk during peak trading periods. Canvas is not yet ready for enterprise use because of gaps in app blocks, Markets, and Rollouts support ([Wijsmuller, 2026](https://askphill.com/blogs/blog/shopify-canvas)). Rollouts catalog scheduling therefore has more relevance for enterprise customers than Canvas does, and Shopify should be asked to clarify how the two relate.

The Q3 results on 3 November are the most significant scheduled event. The results will show whether growth in Sidekick and Canvas usage is supporting the financial trend, but the headline figures should be checked against the release itself before use.

The compliance deadlines (EU identifiers, Script tags) mean that merchant-side work is heavy. Shopify's support for enterprise merchants during these transitions is a relevant point for the meeting.

## 6. Limitations

- Most window items rely on secondary trackers that were not checked against Shopify's changelog.
- Shopify's press index in the provided material was an undated snapshot, so some dates were inferred.
- No primary sources for executive moves, partnerships, or deals in the window were provided.

## 7. Three Open Questions for Shopify

1. **Rollouts and Canvas for enterprise:** Will Rollouts catalog scheduling and discount experiments be available to Plus and enterprise merchants on the same terms as other plans, and what is the timeline for Canvas support for app blocks, Markets, and Rollouts?
2. **EU identifier enforcement:** Since the 1 November deadline, have any Shopify Shipping or Managed Markets label purchases or customs submissions been blocked for missing identifiers, and what support is available for brands that have not completed the migration?
3. **Post-results priorities:** Following the 3 November Q3 results, what are Shopify's priorities for Sidekick and Canvas in the coming quarter, and what migration support will be offered for the 1 March 2027 Script tag deprecation?

# Pre-meeting briefing: Shopify, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** News, launches, hires and deals from roughly 17 October to 17 November 2026, drawn only from the search results provided. Earnings-call content was not reviewed.

## What changed

**Financial results (Q3, quarter to 30 Sept 2026)**
- Revenue grew 32% (32% in constant currency), and free cash flow margin was 22%. (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow)
- Per a third-party summary of the 10-Q, Shopify Payments carried 68% of $119B in GMV. (https://fourweekmba.com/ai-shopify-filing-shopify-payments-carried-68-of-119b-in-gmv)
- Pre-results guidance was for revenue growth in the low thirties, operating expenses at 33–34% of revenue, and a free cash flow margin in the high teens to low twenties. (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/29/ai-boom-or-margin-bust-the-hidden-catalysts-set-to-move-shopify-stock-nov-3)
- A headline reads "Shopify Plunges 17% as GMV and Subscription Revenue Miss Estimates," but the results do not give a URL for it, so I have not relied on it.

**Deals and partnerships**
- A report says a company was agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4B, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced) **Caution:** the snippet does not name Shopify. Confirm the target before raising this.
- lululemon added Shop Pay to its US and Canadian e-commerce sites. (https://retailtechinnovationhub.com/home/2026/11/1/who-will-be-the-ai-winners-this-holiday-season-last-weeks-most-read-retail-technology-articles)

**Launches and product**
- Shopify is extending into merchant advertising, with a pay-per-sale model that its VP of product for merchant marketing says takes on media risk. Shopify has also added SEO to the product. (https://ppc.land/googles-core-update-may-run-until-three-days-before-black-friday)
- Background from before the window: on 21 September, Shopify and Meta announced merchants can sell inside Meta's AI assistant Muse, with Shop Pay handling checkout. (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/29/ai-boom-or-margin-bust-the-hidden-catalysts-set-to-move-shopify-stock-nov-3)

**Hires and headcount**
- Headcount is 30,025, up 5,330 (21.6%) over the year and up 1,499 in the quarter. The source page is undated. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/yIg9BumgrtmF)
- I found no specific executive hires in the results.

**Source gaps:** The two dates for the Q3 press release conflict. Its metadata says 21 October, but the text refers to results announced 3 November. The 3 November date is consistent with the call and the 10-Q.

## Open questions

1. Is Shopify a party to the reported $9.4B Globex transaction, and if so, what does the deal mean for merchant and partner commitments during the close period?
2. How is the pay-per-sale advertising model performing against the Q3 guidance and the 17% share price fall, and what GMV and subscription metrics are behind the reported miss?
3. With Shop Pay now in large retailers such as lululemon and inside Meta's Muse, where do we fit in its checkout and marketing roadmap, and what integration or co-marketing support is available for us?

# Databricks Pre-Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing prepares for a meeting with Databricks on 17 November 2026. It covers developments from approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026 (the 30 days before the report date), including news, product launches, leadership hires, and deals. It closes with upcoming dates that fall near the meeting and three open questions. Where sources conflict or are weak, this is noted. Official Databricks release notes and press materials are treated as primary sources. Third-party trackers, vendor marketing pages, and community posts are used only for context or corroboration.

## Executive Summary

- **Distribution strategy:** In the last 30 days, Databricks extended Genie One into the tools knowledge workers already use. These include ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Cursor, Slack, Chrome, and Windows ([Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026c](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Governance tightening:** Releases focused on access control and cost visibility, including partner-platform ingress rules, budget-triggered webhooks, and AI Function spend in Unity Gateway budgets ([Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).
- **Investment:** Databricks announced roughly $3 billion across Europe and the Middle East (11 November) and more than $500 million in the Netherlands (10 November) ([Databricks, 2026e](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-adds-key-leaders-accelerate-hiring-ramp-product-investment-response-rapid-global-growth)).
- **M&A pause in the window:** The sources reviewed show no new acquisitions announced within the 30-day window. The most recent is Row Zero (24 September) ([SaaSRise, 2026](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5); [Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-databricks/__h71WlGEvmuefCzSdZogxaGihmuCYu0rBKj3hkmJQF7M)).
- **Time-sensitive customer risk:** The Genie One MCP Beta endpoint reaches end of life on 30 November 2026, and variant shredding becomes default on 18 November 2026 ([Databricks, 2026d](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/whats-coming)).

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### News and Strategic Announcements

On 11 November, Databricks published a press release headlined "Databricks Launches New Always-on Genie: Autonomous AI for Complex Enterprise Work" ([Databricks, 2026e](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-adds-key-leaders-accelerate-hiring-ramp-product-investment-response-rapid-global-growth)). A third-party listing describes this as a second-generation Genie that manages long-running enterprise tasks and offers proactive assistance through a priority inbox ([Fundz, 2026](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)). The listing is marketing-oriented, so the product claims should be verified against Databricks documentation before the meeting.

Earlier in the window, the October product roundup described Genie expanding beyond basic Q&A into an end-to-end co-pilot that builds dashboards, optimizes compute, and surfaces automated insights ([Databricks Community, 2026](https://community.databricks.com/t5/product-platform-updates/what-s-new-in-databricks-october-2026/ba-p/175667)). The same roundup described AI/BI dashboards as moving toward a full replacement for Power BI and Tableau, paired with automated bulk migration ([Databricks Community, 2026](https://community.databricks.com/t5/product-platform-updates/what-s-new-in-databricks-october-2026/ba-p/175667)). Note that these are community-authored summaries, and the "replacement" framing is editorial.

### Product Launches and Releases

The table below lists dated releases within the window, from the Azure, AWS, and GCP November release notes unless otherwise indicated.

| Date (2026) | Release | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Nov | AI Functions usage (ai_parse_document, ai_extract, ai_classify) included in Unity Gateway budgets | GA behavior change | [Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 2 Nov | ai_decide uses new model with 33% higher answer accuracy, with low latency maintained | Beta | [Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 3 Nov | Managed Okta connector in Lakeflow Connect | Beta | [Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 4 Nov | Context-based ingress control in Azure Government and Azure China North 3 | Available | [Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 4 Nov | AI Function tasks for jobs | Beta | [Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 4 Nov | Unity Gateway Skills publishing via GitHub Action | Beta | [Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 6 Nov | Unity Catalog wikis | Beta | [Databricks, 2026b](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 6 Nov | Restore deleted metastore via REST API (up to 5 days after deletion) | Public Preview | [Databricks, 2026b](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 9 Nov | Genie Search (indexes Google Drive, Jira, Confluence, Workday with permissions) | GA | [Databricks, 2026b](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 9 Nov | Genie app for Slack | GA | [Databricks, 2026b](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 9 Nov | New jobs compute defaults to Auto access mode | Default change | [Databricks, 2026b](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 10 Nov | Budget alerts trigger webhooks | Beta | [Databricks, 2026b](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 10 Nov | Gemini 4 Carbon on Unity Gateway | Available | [Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 10 Nov | Genie One Chrome extension | Beta | [Databricks, 2026b](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 10 Nov | ChatGPT and Claude allowed as partner platforms in ingress policies | Available | [Databricks, 2026c](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 11 Nov | Genie One desktop app for Windows (macOS already available) | Beta | [Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 11 Nov | Bring your own ChatGPT subscription to Codex via Unity Gateway | Available | [Databricks, 2026c](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 11 Nov | GitHub Copilot in VS Code via `ug configure --agents copilot` | Available | [Databricks, 2026c](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november) |
| 11 Nov | Write custom service policies in Python | Beta | [Databricks, 2026b](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/release-notes/product/2026/november) |

The Genie One MCP integrations are the most consequential cluster. The release notes describe Genie plugins or connectors for ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Bot/Cursor, each requiring the customer's admin to set up the integration and each user to sign in with their Databricks account ([Databricks, 2026c](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november); [Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). On Azure, a Microsoft 365 Copilot plugin (Public Preview) lets users ask questions without an @-mention, and a Microsoft Copilot Cowork plugin (Public Preview) does not require creating an OAuth app or editing a plugin manifest ([Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Existing Beta manifest-based installations are not migrated automatically ([Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)).

### Partnerships and Ecosystem

Databricks' partnership posture is broadening across model and tool vendors. Gemini 4 Carbon is available through Unity Gateway ([Databricks, 2026a](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Unity Gateway also now supports GitHub Copilot, Codex, and Claude, GPT, and open-source models ([Databricks, 2026c](https://docs.databricks.com/gcp/fr/release-notes/product/2026/november)). Earlier partnership context includes a July 2026 expanded integration with Microsoft that extends into the 2030s ([Wikipedia, n.d.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Databricks)). This is outside the 30-day window but is relevant to the competitive picture.

### Leadership and Hiring

The sources reviewed contain **no verified executive appointment or notable hiring announcement within the 30-day window**. The most recent executive announcement cited is the appointment of Simon Davies as SVP and GM for Asia Pacific and Japan on 20 April 2026 ([Telosi, 2026](https://telosi.io/vr/databricks)). The Fundz page references hiring signals and named contacts, but its personnel entries are hidden or unverified and are not used here ([Fundz, 2026](https://app.fundz.net/products/databricks-product-launch-917146)). Confirm current leadership ahead of the meeting.

### Deals and Investment

| Date (2026) | Event | Within 30 days? | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 Nov | More than $500M investment in the Netherlands | Yes | [Databricks, 2026e](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-adds-key-leaders-accelerate-hiring-ramp-product-investment-response-rapid-global-growth) |
| 11 Nov | ~$3B investment across Europe and the Middle East | Yes | [Databricks, 2026e](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-adds-key-leaders-accelerate-hiring-ramp-product-investment-response-rapid-global-growth) |
| 24 Sep | Row Zero acquisition (terms undisclosed) | No (just outside) | [SaaSRise, 2026](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5) |
| 13 Aug | $5B round at $190B valuation | No | [Telosi, 2026](https://telosi.io/vr/databricks) |

Investment in Europe and the Middle East is a material development in the window. The $190 billion valuation figure comes from a secondary tracker and should be verified against Databricks' own release. The SaaSRise analysis suggests that Databricks may have paid a premium for Row Zero, but this is speculation because the price was not disclosed ([SaaSRise, 2026](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5)).

There is a **source discrepancy** on the Panther deal. Tracxn lists 16 June 2026 as the acquisition date ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-databricks/__h71WlGEvmuefCzSdZogxaGihmuCYu0rBKj3hkmJQF7M)), while Telosi reports the announced intent on 16 June and completion on 3 August ([Telosi, 2026](https://telosi.io/vr/databricks)). Tracxn counts 23 total acquisitions, with six in 2026 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-databricks/__h71WlGEvmuefCzSdZogxaGihmuCYu0rBKj3hkmJQF7M)). CEO Ali Ghodsi has said more acquisitions are planned ([SaaSRise, 2026](https://www.saasrise.com/deals/databricks-buys-row-zero-and-is-scouting-for-more-startups-to-acquire-0cf62ecf-edbc-447c-934d-7ef5822b8bd5)).

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026
**Basis:** Search results only. No outside information added.

## What changed in the last 30 days

**Deals**
- A wire item dated 15 Nov 2026 reports that a company has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, per people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **The item does not name the target.** Do not assume it is Databricks until this is confirmed. The domain is also unfamiliar, so treat the item as low-confidence.
- Commvault announced "Data Activate for Databricks," a planned governed-data solution with early access in December 2026 in select Azure regions. It is not yet generally available (https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:a912a3a702a15:0-commvault-cvlt-plans-governed-data-solution-for-databricks-ai, 10 Nov 2026).

**Product launches**
- On 11 Nov 2026, Databricks launched native Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot. Other compatible agents can connect through the Genie One MCP server (https://www.unite.ai/databricks-launches-native-genie-plugins-for-four-ai-agents).
- Databricks unveiled an updated Genie that can handle multi-step jobs taking extended time (https://mezha.net/eng/news/mezha-d5ce8d4f2e7d567c6d43a125_databricks-_genie_gives, 11 Nov 2026).
- Databricks launched agentic tools that run in the background and proactively assist workers. A separate "Ontology" feature scans organizational data (https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/day-anthropic-office-push-databricks-220704968.html, 12 Nov 2026).

**Corporate and facilities**
- Databricks opened its new San Francisco headquarters at One Sansome, spanning 10 floors and over 200,000 square feet. The company plans to double its headcount by 2027 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/databricks-san-francisco-headquarters-ai-office-22525207.php, 11 Nov 2026).
- Databricks has no announced IPO date. Its private valuation is reported at $190 billion, with annualized revenue above $7 billion (https://smartasset.com/investing/databricks-ipo-date-timeline-valuation-and-investment-options, 25 Oct 2026).

**Hires**
- I could not find any hiring or leadership changes in the results.

**Other**
- A Solutions Review roundup for the week of 6 November lists "Updates from Databricks," but the results contain no details (https://solutionsreview.com/business-intelligence/analytics-and-data-science-news-for-the-week-of-november-6-updates-from-databricks-ocient-smartsheet-more).

## Open questions

1. Is Databricks a party to the Globex Corporation agreement reported on 15 November, and if so, what are the terms and expected closing timeline?
2. Genie plugins now reach four major AI agents, and results can still be truncated for very large queries. What guidance should customers follow for large-scale use, and when will the Genie One MCP server and updated Genie be generally available?
3. With headcount set to double by 2027 and Commvault's Azure-region early access planned for December, what is Databricks' roadmap for partner integrations and regional availability?

# Canva: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Coverage window: approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026. Items I could not verify are marked **[Unverified]**.*

## Executive Summary

Canva is in the middle of its most significant internal change in the period reviewed. On 3 November 2026 it announced a restructuring affecting 1,271 employees, about 22% of its workforce, through job losses, role changes and relocations ([Greenwood, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). The change merges Product, Growth and Platform into one product organisation, simplifies management layers and concentrates more product teams in Sydney ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). The stated trigger is slowing growth. My assessment is that the restructuring is primarily an operating-model change aimed at faster product delivery, but it is being pursued under visible financial pressure. The growth slowdown, not the headcount figure, is the most material signal for the meeting.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Restructuring and Workforce

| Item | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Announcement | Co-founder and CEO Melanie Perkins's note "An important update on our team" | [Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update) |
| Scale | 1,271 roles, about 22% of workforce; includes relocations, so final exits are not yet known | [Greenwood, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Org change | Product, Growth and Platform merge into one product organisation | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations) |
| Location | Sydney to become the primary home for more product teams and other roles | [Greenwood, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250) |
| Exit terms | At least six months' salary (about 26 weeks) for departing staff | [Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations); [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |
| Timeline | Company All Hands on 10 November; Org All Hands from 11 November | [Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update) |
| Pre-announcement reporting | Capital Brief had reported possible November cuts or a hiring freeze | [Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137) |

Canva has not published a breakdown of the affected roles by title, department or country ([Greenwood, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). Per a Canva spokesperson, AI is not replacing the affected roles ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). This is a company statement relayed by a third party, not a primary Canva source I could verify.

### Financial Context

- Canva is privately held and reported about US$3.5 billion in revenue for the previous year, and states it is profitable on a free cash flow basis ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)).
- Canva expects about 20% year-on-year revenue growth and says 2026 will be its tenth consecutive profitable year ([Greenwood, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)).
- In August 2026, Canva reportedly cut its 2026 growth forecast from 30% to 20% ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). I could not access the Fortune original cited there, so treat this as secondary reporting.
- Perkins said growth had slowed for the first time in a decade and that small adjustments would not be enough ([Bashir, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/canva-first-growth-slowdown-decade-092457264.html)).
- Perkins described the moment as "without doubt the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history" ([Poduval, 2026](https://uxuiopen.com/blog/canva-layoff)).

### Product Launches

- **Within the 30-day window:** I found no verified product launch dated between 16 October and 15 November 2026.
- **Recent but outside the window:** Canva announced enterprise-oriented features in May 2026, including workflow automation, data integrations and team collaboration ([Kirkpatrick, 2026](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/canvas-may-2026-launches-signal-an-enterprise-platform-ambition-beyond-design)). The September 2026 release covered websites, a PayPal app, Sheets collaboration, Whiteboards and brand kit automation ([Canva, 2026](https://www.canva.com/design-school/resources/whats-new-canva-sep26)).
- **[Unverified] Canva Create 2026 / "Canva AI 2.0":** A YouTube video references this launch ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qYTLCKzMYcU)), but the video page does not show a verifiable date. I could not confirm its date or contents.

### Executive and Key Hires

- **[Unverified]** I found no verified executive or key hire announcements in the window. The restructuring also reduces management layers ([Greenwood, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)), so leadership changes are likely, but I could not confirm any named appointments or departures.

### Deals and Partnerships

- **[Unverified]** A headline lists "Canva expands design creation inside Google Gemini," but I have no source URL, publication date or details for it. I have not treated it as fact.
- I found no verified acquisitions or partnerships announced in the window.

## Analysis

**Opinion:** The restructuring is best read as an attempt to shorten the time between insight and shipped product. Niehues argues that the delay comes from handovers, since each improvement had to be agreed between Product, Growth and Platform ([Niehues, 2026](https://www.niehuesconsulting.de/en/blog/canva-restructuring-lessons-for-organisations)). A growth leader on LinkedIn makes a similar point, arguing that AI-driven competition makes separate teams a cost ([LinkedIn, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/news/story/canva-announces-restructuring-affecting-over-1200-jobs-7754140)). This view is credible, but it is not independently verified and comes from practitioners rather than Canva.

Canva's framing as a simplification rather than a cost cut is plausible given continued profitability ([Greenwood, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)). However, a 10-point cut in growth guidance, the reported consideration of a hiring freeze ([Srivastava, 2026](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137)), and a 26-week exit package together point to both productivity and cost discipline. The generous exit terms are also a retention and reputational tool. Commentators have praised them ([Greenwood, 2026](https://www.newsweek.com/canva-exit-package-praised-tech-company-announces-layoffs-12662250)).

The key risk is execution. Merging three large units during a 10–11 November communication cycle, with relocations to Sydney and an undisclosed exit count, creates uncertainty in product roadmaps and enterprise customer confidence. The enterprise push from May 2026 ([Kirkpatrick, 2026](https://futurumgroup.com/insights/canvas-may-2026-launches-signal-an-enterprise-platform-ambition-beyond-design)) makes that uncertainty more consequential.

## Three Open Questions for Canva

1. **Workforce outcome:** Of the 1,271 affected roles, how many will be exits, role changes and relocations, and when will the final figures be known? How many roles in the merged product organisation are in Sydney, and what relocation terms and deadlines apply?

2. **Operating model:** Which decision rights and metrics will the single product organisation use to show that handover delays have fallen? What will change in the roadmap and release cadence over the next two quarters?

3. **Growth and investment:** With 2026 growth guided to about 20% after the earlier cut, what are the priorities for enterprise workflow, integrations and AI platform investment? Is the hiring freeze in effect, and if so, which functions does it cover?

runs.briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Canva, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026. Sources below are dated 2 to 15 Nov 2026 unless noted.

## What changed

**Restructuring and layoffs**
- Canva is cutting 22% of its staff, about 1,271 employees, as it flattens its org chart and consolidates teams (https://www.computerworld.com/article/3816579/tech-layoffs-this-year-a-timeline.html). Yahoo Tech puts it at "just over 1,200" (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- CEO Melanie Perkins said Canva must "re-found" itself around "small, empowered teams," and that "small changes won't be enough" (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304).
- Product, growth and platform teams are being merged (https://tech.yahoo.com/general/breaking-news/article/tech-layoffs-tracker-2026-all-the-job-losses-across-canva-squarespace-amazon-microsoft-apple-meta-and-others-141507340.html).
- Departing staff get at least six months' salary plus support (https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-11-04/canva-restructure-job-losses/107344304), keep their company MacBooks and receive a free year of LinkedIn Premium (https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/canva-layoffs-2026-meet-ceo-melanie-perkins-who-plans-to-give-away-80-of-her-billion-dollar-fortune-as-1271-jobs-are-cut/articleshow/135575689.cms).
- Capital Brief reported that Canva could announce further redundancies or a hiring freeze in November. Canva has not confirmed this (https://www.peoplematters.in/news/strategic-hr/canva-layoffs-in-november-company-reportedly-weighs-job-cuts-or-hiring-freeze-53137).
- Capital Brief also reported finance-division cuts of 32 roles in January, which were previously unreported (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

**AI and partnerships**
- Canva expanded its OpenAI deal, gaining broader access to GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6. The companies will work on lowering running costs, though no figures were disclosed. This came days after Canva launched its second in-house AI model (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).
- OpenAI already powers Canva Code, which builds interactive designs, websites and apps from text prompts (https://www.startupdaily.net/topic/business/canva-doubles-downw-with-openai-just-days-after-launching-its-2nd-in-house-ai-model).

**Marketing**
- Canva launched a new North America brand platform, "What Will You Canva Today?", created by agency GS&P, with TV spots, out-of-home and social work (https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/419113/canva-unveils-campaign-by-new-agency-gsp.html).

**Deals and hires**
- A wire report says a company agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, expected to close next quarter. The snippet does not name Canva. **Treat as unconfirmed for Canva** (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced).
- No Canva hires or senior appointments in the window were found in the results.

## Caveats
- Layoff figures vary slightly (1,271 vs. "just over 1,200").
- The Capital Brief hiring-freeze and finance-cut reports are secondhand.
- A Canva profile lists earlier acquisitions (e.g., Ortto, Doohly), but these fall outside the 30-day window and are undated in the source, so they are excluded (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/wafeqPWRLzYp).

## Open questions
1. With the restructure merging product, growth and platform teams, who are our current counterparts, and which workstreams are being deprioritized or delayed into 2027?
2. Has Canva confirmed whether any further redundancies or a hiring freeze are coming in November, and how would that affect our support and delivery timelines?
3. Does the expanded OpenAI partnership change pricing, data handling or feature availability for enterprise customers, and is the Globex transaction relevant to us in any way?

# Razorpay: Pre-Meeting Briefing for 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026. Coverage window: approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026. Items outside this window or without a verifiable date are labelled.*

## Executive Summary

Razorpay's most significant verified development in the past 30 days is regulatory and capital-markets related. Its newsroom reports a final IFSCA licence for GIFT City on 3 November 2026 ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). A same-day IPO approval from SEBI is reported by a single secondary source, not by Razorpay itself ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)). Product news is steady but mostly dated before the window. Verified executive hires and acquisitions inside the window were not found in the material reviewed.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Regulatory and Corporate Developments

Razorpay announced that it received its final IFSCA licence for GIFT City, which it says will power cross-border money movement ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). The same newsroom listing dated 3 November 2026 also features a launch that brings global investing, international collections, settlements, and multi-currency capabilities under a single offering. The headline is truncated in the source, so the full product details could not be verified ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).

On the listing front, IPO Market reports that SEBI granted approval for Razorpay's IPO on 3 November 2026, valid for 18 months ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)). A separate weekly fintech roundup describes a reported approval for a proposed ₹50–60 billion (about $529–634 million) IPO ([This Week in Fintech, n.d.](https://www.thisweekinfintech.com/p/razorpay-eyes-ipo-as-dealmakers-target-insurance-and-payments-exits-deep-reads)). IPO Market states that the company has not announced a price band, opening date, or lead managers, and that issue size, valuation, and timing are media-reported estimates ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)).

### Product Launches and Partnerships

The newest dated product items in the window are the 3 November multi-currency and global-investing launch and the GIFT City licence noted above ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). Razorpay's Sprint 2026 page describes more than 100 launches under an "agentic" framing. These include Payments on LLMs, Razorpay for ChatGPT Apps, Voice Payments, Agentic Onboarding, Ray Smart Assist, Ray Customer Support, an Agentic Dashboard, and a Razorpay Dashboard on Claude ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)). The page carries no date, so it cannot be confirmed as within the window. The page also lists New Global Accounts for exporters in the UAE, Australia, Switzerland, and Canada ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)).

Earlier 2026 launches fall outside the window but provide context. On 30 September, Razorpay enabled Apple Pay for online and in-store payments, with merchants including Zepto ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)). On 5 October, Razorpay partnered with OpenAI to expand ChatGPT Ads in India ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)); this is 11 days before the window opens but is the most relevant partnership signal. Other 2026 items include the Vulcan AI payments foundation model on 18 August and the RAY WhatsApp assistant with IndusInd Bank on 2 September ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).

Undated press coverage reports an NPCI and Razorpay pilot of agentic payments on ChatGPT, with BigBasket among the first merchants ([Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). The same source reports a UPI payment partnership with Curlec and NPCI International for Indian tourists in Malaysia ([Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). Neither item can be dated within the window.

A YouTube interview with the COO discusses launches including "Netbanking 2.0" and "Agentic Commerce." The page provides only a title and platform boilerplate, so its date and content could not be verified ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ia5i2GZHlFc)).

### Executive and Key Hires

No executive or key hire dated within the 30-day window was verified. The most recent verified appointments are:

- **Apuarv Sethi**, elevated to CMO on 15 May 2026, covering India and Southeast Asia ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)).
- **Four senior engineering hires** to strengthen AI leadership, reported on 5 August 2026. Shashank Kumar, Co-founder and CTO, is quoted in the article ([Veloxx Media, 2026](https://veloxxmedia.com/razorpay-strengthens-ai-leadership-with-four-senior-engineering-hires)).

The Veloxx article also cites the appointment of "Praburam Rambadran" as SVP of Engineering in September 2025 ([Veloxx Media, 2026](https://veloxxmedia.com/razorpay-strengthens-ai-leadership-with-four-senior-engineering-hires)). Other sources spell the name "Prabhu Rambadran" or "Prabu Ram," and the Sprint page lists a different SVP Engineering, Vivek Agarwal ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)). Spelling and role details should be confirmed before they are referenced externally.

### Deals and M&A

Tracxn records seven Razorpay acquisitions in total, with none completed in the current calendar year. Its most recent listed deal is PoshVine (September 2022) ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)). The Head and Tale traces the acquisitions from Thirdwatch (2019) through Ezetap (2022) and BillMe (2023) ([The Head and Tale, n.d.](https://theheadandtale.com/to-the-point/at-a-glance-razorpay-s-m-a-activity-since-its-first-acquisition-in-2019)). No new acquisition inside the window was found.

Media reports say Razorpay appointed Axis Capital, Kotak Mahindra, JP Morgan, and Citibank as IPO bankers. The date of this report could not be confirmed ([Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)).

## Financial and Corporate Context

The company's reported last private valuation is **$7.5 billion**, cited in several Economic Times pieces ([Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). IPO Market, by contrast, cites a "target valuation" of about **$5 billion** (reported, not confirmed) ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)). This is a material discrepancy and should be treated as unresolved.

Economic Times reports that Razorpay completed a "reverse flip" back to India, having previously domiciled in the US when it raised funds from Y Combinator. The same outlet reports that a peer, Groww, faced a tax valuation issue, and that Razorpay, last valued at $7.5 billion, is working with Deloitte on a similar fair-market-value matter ([Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)). Dates for these reports are not shown.

An older Economic Times item reports that Razorpay surpassed $100 billion in annual gross transaction value. The article is undated and may refer to an earlier period, so it should not be treated as current ([Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)).

Strategically, Economic Times reports that Razorpay scaled back offline field expansion after the Ezetap acquisition, focusing instead on merchants needing both online and offline payments ahead of its IPO. This report is undated ([Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)).

## Market Context

MitchelLake records two Razorpay signals in the last 90 days, above a fintech median of one across 64 tracked companies. Its Razorpay profile is anchored to the 1 October Apple Pay launch ([MitchelLake, n.d.](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-product-launch-2026-10-01)). MitchelLake also notes that Cashfree launched "Checkout for Agents" and that Adyen reports 45% of surveyed consumers are uncomfortable with AI-completed purchases ([MitchelLake, n.d.](https://mitchellake.com/intelligence/wire/razorpay-product-launch-2026-10-01)). Both data points indicate competitive pressure in agentic checkout and an adoption-trust gap.

## Verification Flags

|---|---|---|
| SEBI IPO approval, 3 November 2026 | **Single-source, unconfirmed by Razorpay** | IPO Market only ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)) |
| IPO size (₹5,000–6,000 crore), valuation (~$5bn), listing window (Q1 2027) | **Reported estimates** | Media-sourced; explicitly unconfirmed ([IPO Market, 2026](https://www.ipomarket.in/news/razorpay-ipo-2026-drhp-date-price-review)) |
| Valuation ($7.5bn private vs. ~$5bn IPO target) | **Conflicting** | Economic Times vs. IPO Market |
| IPO timing ("mid-year" vs. Q1 2027) | **Conflicting and undated** | Economic Times vs. IPO Market |
| Multi-currency/global investing launch (3 Nov) | **Headline truncated** | Newsroom listing only ([Razorpay, 2026](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)) |
| Agentic/ChatGPT pilot with NPCI and BigBasket | **Undated** | Economic Times ([Economic Times, n.d.](https://m.economictimes.com/tech/razorpay/2?from=mdr)) |
| Sprint 2026 product list | **Undated** | Razorpay ([Razorpay, n.d.](https://razorpay.com/sprint/26)) |
| COO interview on Netbanking 2.0 and Agentic Commerce | **Content unverified** | Title only ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ia5i2GZHlFc)) |
| IPO stock-market video | **Content unverified** | Title only ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dxIAx-syEGo)) |
| Acquisitions in the window | **None found** | Tracxn shows none in 2026 ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-razorpay/__ARWa67NVJPe3TC11rYSBnp-0zVHbDAze4xZvzRsZzAI)) |
| Executive hires in the window | **None verified** | Latest verified hires are dated May and August 2026 |
| Name of SVP Engineering | **Inconsistent spelling** | Veloxx, Economic Times, and Sprint page differ |

## Assessment

In our view, the 30-day picture is driven by regulatory and capital-markets progress rather than by commercial acceleration. The GIFT City licence and the reported SEBI approval move Razorpay toward a listing and widen its cross-border offering. However, the strongest product narrative, agentic commerce, rests largely on undated pages and partner announcements without disclosed volumes. Revenue contribution from these channels is not quantified in the material reviewed.

Two points deserve scrutiny before the meeting. First, the valuation gap between the $7.5 billion private mark and the roughly $5 billion IPO estimate is large enough to affect how investors and the company frame the listing. Second, the absence of verified hires or acquisitions in the window is notable for a company reportedly preparing to list. This may reflect the limits of the available data rather than a true lull.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **IPO sequencing and valuation:** Can Razorpay confirm the status of the SEBI approval and the timing of its updated draft prospectus? How does management reconcile the reported $7.5 billion private valuation with the roughly $5 billion IPO target?

2. **Agentic commerce economics:** What share of TPV or revenue currently flows through ChatGPT, Claude, and in-app agentic checkouts? Which of these pilots, such as the NPCI and OpenAI arrangement, have moved from pilot to scaled production?

3. **Cross-border and tax structure:** What is the go-live timeline for the GIFT City licence and multi-currency offering, and which corridors come first? What is the status of the fair-market-value and tax matter following the reverse flip, and could it affect the IPO timetable?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Razorpay
**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026
**Coverage window:** Last 30 days (approx. 18 October to 17 November 2026)

## Summary
Razorpay's regulatory and capital-markets position moved sharply in early November. It received a final GIFT City cross-border licence and SEBI clearance for an IPO. One mid-November report of a large acquisition may or may not involve the company, and it needs verification before the meeting.

## What changed

**Regulatory**
- Razorpay received its final Payment Service Provider licence from the IFSCA to operate from GIFT City, following in-principle approval in April 2026. The licence lets it move money in and out of India under a single regulatory framework (https://yourstory.com/2026/11/startup-news-and-updates-daily-roundup-november-02-2026; https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/razorpay-gets-final-ifsca-licence-cross-border-payments-gift-city-126110200734_1.html).
- The licence adds to existing RBI permissions for online, offline and cross-border payments. Coverage notes the licence could also support transfers by non-resident Indians to their families (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/razorpay-gets-gift-city-licence-for-cross-border-payments/articleshow/135470766.cms).

**Capital markets / IPO**
- SEBI issued final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).
- Reports put the issue at ₹5,000–6,000 crore with a valuation target of about $5 billion (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ipo-razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-5-000-6-000-crore-issue-eyes-5-billion-valuation/article-202997). Inc42 reports ₹6,000 crore (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo).
- The Economic Times reports a possible 2027 listing and a ₹5,500–6,500 crore fundraise, amid valuation and profitability questions (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms).

**Deals**
- A report dated 15 November says a company agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **The source does not name Razorpay. Do not attribute this deal to Razorpay until confirmed.**

**Hires and leadership**
- No Razorpay hires or leadership changes were found in the sources.

## Background (undated)
- Headquartered in Bangalore; privately held; B2B model. Total raised about $834.43M across 12 rounds (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7).

## Gaps
- No confirmed new product launches or hires in the window.
- The Globex item is unverified as it relates to Razorpay.
- Reported IPO size and valuation differ across outlets.

## Open questions
1. Does the reported Globex Corporation agreement (15 November) involve Razorpay, and if so, how would it affect the IPO timeline and the 2027 listing plan?
2. With the GIFT City PSP licence now final, what is the launch timeline for cross-border money movement, and which corridors (such as NRI remittances) are the priority?
3. What is the target IPO size and valuation (reports range from ₹5,000 to ₹6,500 crore and about $5 billion), and how is the company addressing profitability concerns?

# Infosys Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

*Prepared 15 November 2026 for a meeting on 17 November 2026. Scope: 16 October to 15 November 2026 ("last 30 days").*

## Purpose and Source Position

This briefing covers material developments in the 30 days before the meeting, drawing only on the sources supplied. The most important finding is a gap: **I could not verify any Infosys news, product launch, executive hire, or deal dated within 16 October to 15 November 2026.** The most recent dated items fall just outside that window (late September and July 2026). The briefing therefore reports the nearest verified developments and labels each one clearly.

Source reliability varies. The Times of India report is a mainstream newspaper article that cites people familiar with the discussions ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). The LinkedIn post and HireDoor blog are secondary summaries of company disclosures and are weaker sources, so their figures should be checked against Infosys's own filings before the meeting.

## Executive Summary

- **No verifiable news inside the 30-day window.** Any claim of a recent October or November 2026 development should be treated as unconfirmed until checked.
- **Most recent strategic signal (late September 2026):** Infosys reportedly plans to move a quarter to a third of its more than 320,000 employees into specialist roles and build a team of about 6,000 "frontier engineers" ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).
- **Workforce posture (Q1 FY27, reported July 2026):** Headcount fell by 532 to 328,062 while more than 4,000 freshers were hired and the FY27 fresher target of 20,000 was reaffirmed ([Startup Originals, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/startuporiginals_startuporiginals-infosys-hiring-activity-7387329524017004544-6dET)).
- **Our assessment:** Infosys is managing an AI-driven transition by rebalancing its workforce rather than cutting it, and it is doing so while its growth outlook has been tempered. The central test for the meeting is whether this rebalancing can be sustained without weakening delivery or client trust.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days (16 October to 15 November 2026)

### News

No Infosys news items dated within the window were present in the supplied material. The Times of India piece, dated 29 September 2026, is the latest dated coverage and falls about 47 days before the report date ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

Its central content, as reported, is as follows:

- Management shared these plans at the three-day Americas Confluence in Washington, DC, and the company reportedly acknowledged the AI-led challenge to its headcount-based model ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).
- An executive presentation reportedly showed 270,000 employees had received AI training and 80,000 were working with coding tools ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).
- Infosys reportedly emphasised outcome-based pricing and a model-agnostic strategy, including work with open-weight models for enterprise customers ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

### Product Launches

**Not verified in the window.** The only product reference is to Infosys Cobalt, described as the company's AI-powered cloud platform, mentioned as part of the Americas Confluence speaker lineup ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). This is an existing platform, not a new launch.

### Executive and Key Hires

**Not verified in the window.** The Confluence coverage names CEO-designate Ashiss Kumar Dash alongside incumbent CEO Salil Parekh, who shared the stage on AI value creation ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). This indicates a leadership transition, but the source does not give an effective date or a formal announcement, so the timing and terms cannot be confirmed.

Other leaders named in the same coverage are Anant Adya (head of Americas delivery and leader of Infosys Cobalt) and Anand Swaminathan (executive vice president and global industry leader) ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). Their roles are as described in that report and were not otherwise confirmed.

### Deals

**No new deal announced within the window was verified.** The most recent deal metric is US$3.6 billion in large deal bookings in Q1 FY27 ([Startup Originals, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/startuporiginals_startuporiginals-infosys-hiring-activity-7387329524017004544-6dET)). The Times of India report also says that in some deals Infosys takes on clients' surplus staff and redeploys them ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). Note the headcount discrepancy. The Times of India report says "more than 320,000," while the LinkedIn summary gives 328,062 for June 2026. These are consistent in direction but should be reconciled with Infosys's official filing.

## Excluded and Unverifiable Material

- **Yahoo Finance commitment to hire 12,000 US workers** ([Fujita, 2020](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/infosys-commits-to-hiring-12000-american-workers-expanding-us-footprint-130006173.html)): **Excluded as stale.** The article is dated 1 September 2020. Its named president (Ravi Kumar), hiring target, and six US centres describe a past programme. Its market-ticker data is undated and was not used.
- **YouTube video, "Infosys Announces 20K New Hires In FY27"** ([YouTube, n.d.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FN4pRie-8Xo)): **Unverifiable.** Only the title is available, with no date or transcript. The 20,000 figure matches other sources, but I did not rely on this item.
- **Tavily "Globex Corporation" entity page** ([Tavily, n.d.](https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/jEC1wAk9b5jG)): **Excluded.** It describes an unrelated industrial machinery company, not Infosys.
- **Fresher hiring claims in the HireDoor blog** ([HireDoor Team, 2026](https://hiredoor.in/blog/infosys-20000-freshers-hiring-2026)): **Lower reliability.** It is a job-board blog. Its claims about hiring focus and delivery hubs (Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad) were not verified against company disclosures.
- **Attribution inconsistency:** One LinkedIn post credits the FY27 fresher target to CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka after Q4 FY26 results, while another credits CEO Salil Parekh on the Q1 FY27 call ([Startup Originals, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/startuporiginals_startuporiginals-infosys-hiring-activity-7387329524017004544-6dET)). The attribution is unconfirmed.

## Analyst Assessment

My view is that Infosys is not shrinking in a defensive way, nor expanding aggressively. It is changing the *composition* of its workforce. Three signals support this:

1. **Headcount is flat to slightly down**, but it is up year over year, which suggests stabilisation rather than contraction.
2. **Fresher intake is being held at 20,000**, which secures a pipeline for AI-trained, lower-cost talent.
3. **Salary revisions are being phased in**, which is a retention tool aimed at experienced staff whose attrition has edged up to 13%.

The main risks are structural. The Times of India report says AI is pressuring the headcount-based pricing model ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)). If outcome-based pricing does not replace lost volume, margin and growth could be pressured even as the company reports strong bookings. The lowered upper end of FY27 revenue guidance is consistent with that concern ([Startup Originals, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/startuporiginals_startuporiginals-infosys-hiring-activity-7387329524017004544-6dET)). The fact that Infosys says it has not restructured, unlike many peers, is a meaningful differentiator if sustained ([Times of India, 2026](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/infosys-plans-to-shift-up-to-one-third-of-320000-employees-into-specialist-roles-build-a-team-of-6000-frontier-engineers-as-ai-reshapes-it-jobs/articleshow/134539780.cms)).

## Three Open Questions to Ask

1. **Pricing transition:** What share of FY27 revenue is now on outcome-based or non-headcount pricing, and what margin profile do you expect as that mix grows?
2. **Specialist workforce:** Of the one-quarter to one-third of staff planned for specialist roles, how many have been reskilled so far, and what is the timeline and funding for the 6,000 frontier engineers?
3. **Guidance and talent:** Given the lowered upper end of FY27 revenue guidance, what triggers would lead you to revisit the 20,000 fresher target or the phased salary revision schedule?

## Results and Corporate Communications

- Infosys announced its Q2 results on 23 October 2026, covering the quarter ended 30 September 2026 (https://www.infosys.com/investors/reports-filings.html, 2026-10-23). The excerpt does not include figures or guidance.

## Hiring

- Infosys is recruiting freshers for Specialist Programmer roles for 2024, 2025 and 2026 graduates, with packages of up to ₹21 LPA (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfUpNY_y_Ww, undated). The application deadline was 6 November 2026 (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfNK6qkTchu, undated).
- A Facebook post advertises an off-campus full-stack hiring drive with a ₹75,000 joining bonus and the same 6 November deadline (https://www.facebook.com/61593111200858/videos/-infosys-off-campus-hiring-alert-2026-know-talented-full-stack-developers-from-t/1470733355162785, undated). Treat these social posts as secondary sources.
- Infosys CTO Rafee Tarafdar said hiring now emphasises first-principles thinking, learnability and proactive problem-finding, and that Infosys trains engineers both with and without AI tools (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/videos/what-does-infosys-today-look-for-when-hiring-people-infosys-cto-rafee-tarafdar/videoshow/134961357.cms, 2026-10-18).

## Launches and Products

- No product or service launches were found in the search results. Infosys's website lists service areas including Innovate (Blockchain, Engineering Services, IoT), Assure (Cyber Security, Quality Engineering) and Accelerate (Enterprise Agile DevOps, API Economy & Microservices, Application Modernization, Cloud). These are standing offerings, not new launches (https://www.infosys.com/investors/reports-filings.html, undated section).

## Company Snapshot

- Infosys Limited is a public IT services and consulting company headquartered in Bangalore, founded in 1981 (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/Gbd7vUUlzCYP, undated).

- No verified news, launches or deal confirmation from Infosys itself in the 30-day window.
