# Zepto Meeting Briefing: 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026
**Scope:** Developments from approximately 16 October to 15 November 2026, with earlier context where needed for interpretation.

## Purpose and Scope

This briefing prepares the team for the 17 November 2026 meeting with Zepto. It covers what changed in the last 30 days across news, launches, hires, and deals, places those changes against the company's financial and IPO background, and closes with three open questions. Sources are prioritised by reliability: regulatory filings and wire reports first, followed by established business media, then secondary aggregators. Where sources conflict, the conflict is noted.

**Evidence limitation:** The available material contains no verified Zepto hiring announcements and no product launches within the 30-day window. These gaps are reported as findings rather than filled with assumptions.

## Executive Summary

- **The IPO has slipped again.** Zepto now plans to list between February and May 2027, according to remarks by co-founder and CEO Aadit Palicha at an employee town hall ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). This follows a July 2026 target that was reported in May ([Economic Times, 2026](http://hospitality.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/operations/technology/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-cr-ipo-in-july-2026/131255022)).
- **A pre-IPO round is planned.** Zepto intends to raise a $105 million pre-IPO round from domestic and overseas investors, while curtailing burn and optimising dark stores ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).
- **Regulatory clearance remains valid.** SEBI's clearance is expected to stay valid until November 2027 ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).
- **Unit economics remain the central issue.** FY26 revenue more than doubled, but losses widened to ₹5,905 crore ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).

## Company Snapshot

| Attribute | Detail | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Business | Quick-commerce grocery and essentials delivery in under 10 minutes via dark stores | [Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price) |
| Founders | Aadit Palicha (MD and CEO), Kaivalya Vohra (Whole-time Director) | [Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html) |
| Corporate status | Converted to a public limited company in December 2025 | [Moneycontrol, 2025](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/startup/zepto-converts-to-a-public-company-ahead-of-planned-ipo-in-2026-13713491.html) |
| IPO bankers | Axis Capital, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Motilal Oswal, HSBC, JM Financial, IIFL Capital | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |
| Proposed IPO size | Up to $837 million (fresh issue of ₹8,010 crore plus OFS) | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

| Date (2026) | Development | Category | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mid-Nov (sidebar dated 8–11 Nov) | IPO window moved to February–May 2027 | Deal / Timeline | [Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc) |
| Mid-Nov | $105 million pre-IPO round planned | Deal | [Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc) |
| 24 Oct | UP Food Safety and Drug Administration suspended licences of four dark stores and warehouses operated by food delivery and quick-commerce platforms | Regulatory | [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company)) |
| Oct (reported) | Unlisted share price reported to have fallen about 30% from April highs despite SEBI approval | Market signal | [Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price) |
| Oct (status check) | No IPO open date, price band, or listing date announced | Timeline | [Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price) |

### IPO Timeline and Pre-IPO Round

The most material change is the revised listing window. Palicha told employees that Zepto now plans to list between February and May 2027 and will update its DRHP with newer financials ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). This is a clear departure from the July 2026 plan reported by the Economic Times in May 2026 ([Economic Times, 2026](http://hospitality.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/operations/technology/zepto-plans-to-float-rs-11000-cr-ipo-in-july-2026/131255022)).

The company intends to use the extended clearance window to raise the $105 million pre-IPO round. The stated aims are to curtail burn, optimise dark stores, and align with investors' valuation expectations ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)). The reference to aligning valuation expectations suggests that the pre-IPO pricing may differ from earlier marks, though the source does not state a figure.

Earlier reporting on the IPO size and structure remains relevant. The June 2026 updated DRHP included a fresh equity issue of up to Rs80.10 billion and an offer for sale of up to 113.46 million shares, with a possible pre-IPO placement of up to Rs16.02 billion ([Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html)). Any pre-IPO proceeds would be deducted from the fresh issue size, according to the same report ([Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html)). This means the $105 million round may affect the eventual fresh issue.

### Regulatory and Compliance Developments

On 24 October 2026, the Uttar Pradesh Food Safety and Drug Administration suspended licences for four dark stores and warehouses operated by food delivery and quick-commerce platforms after state inspections found non-compliance with food safety standards ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))). The sources reviewed do not name Zepto as one of the affected operators, so the team should confirm whether any Zepto facilities were involved.

Two other matters are older but still open:

- **Enforcement Directorate inquiry:** The ED summoned founders Palicha and Vohra in April 2026, seeking information on foreign investments, shareholding, and income tax returns. The company said it complied and had received no further communication as of the June filing ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)).
- **Municipal waste fine:** The Bengaluru East City Corporation fined Zepto ₹5,000 on 12 October 2026 for failing to follow solid waste segregation rules, a penalty that falls just outside the 30-day window ([Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))).

### Launches, Hires, and Deals

- **Launches:** No new product or service launches were identified in the window. The Zepto Nova "Pitch in 10" programme, run with Startup India and DPIIT, had a registration deadline of 22 May 2026 and an application result date of 31 July 2026. It is now closed ([Startup Grants India, 2026](https://www.startupgrantsindia.com/competitions/zepto-nova-pitch-in-10-programme)).
- **Hires:** No senior hires or departures were identified in the sources.
- **Deals:** The planned $105 million pre-IPO round is the only deal activity identified. Zepto was not named in the weekly funding rundown's top deals for the week reviewed ([Inc42, n.d.](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/zepto-stalls-ipo-weekly-funding-rundown-shadowfaxs-fy27-outlook-8yrnc)).

## Financial Context

### FY26 Performance

| Metric | FY26 Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | ₹22,624 crore (₹226.24 billion), more than doubled | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |
| Net loss | ₹5,905 crore (₹59.05 billion), up from ₹4,700 crore | [Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html) |
| Loss as share of revenue | About 26% | Calculated from the figures above |
| Order volume CAGR (FY24–FY26) | About 119.5% | [Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html) |
| Cash and equivalents | About ₹56.8 billion | [Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo) |
| Annual cash burn | About ₹35 billion | [Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo) |

At the Reuters exchange rate of about ₹95.7 per dollar ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)), the FY26 net loss is roughly $617 million. The company loses about a quarter of each rupee of revenue. On cash alone, the balance covers roughly 1.6 years of current burn, before the fresh issue or the pre-IPO round (calculated from the figures above).

Amquest notes that Blinkit, which is listed through Zomato, is at breakeven. It also identifies a gap of about ₹76 per order between Zepto and Blinkit that Zepto would need to close ([Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo)).

### Valuation Reference Points

Valuation figures vary across sources and should be reconciled before the meeting:

- Zepto raised $450 million at about $7 billion in October 2025 ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)).
- Precize describes the $7 billion valuation as a feature of early 2026 fundraising ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).
- The DRHP discloses a weighted-average price of ₹37.74 per share for the Series H rounds of October–November 2025. On about 12.60 billion fully diluted shares, Amquest calculates an implied equity value of roughly $5.6 billion ([Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo)).
- Dhan reported a target valuation of $7–8 billion for the IPO in January 2026 ([Dhan, 2026](https://dhan.co/blog/news/zepto-ipo-update-2026)).

The gap between the $5.6 billion prospectus-implied value and the $7–8 billion press-reported range is material to any IPO pricing discussion.

## Key Risks

1. **Unit economics and profitability.** Losses widened while revenue grew, and public investors are likely to focus on whether losses are narrowing per order ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price); [Amquest Education, 2026](https://amquesteducation.com/research/zepto-ipo)).
2. **Competitive pressure.** Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart are backed by listed parents with deeper balance sheets ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).
3. **Valuation pressure.** The 30% fall in unlisted share prices after approval suggests secondary-market scepticism ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).
4. **Regulatory exposure.** The ED inquiry, the licence suspensions affecting platforms in Uttar Pradesh, and municipal penalties add operational and compliance risk ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html); [Wikipedia, 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zepto_(company))).
5. **Dark-store capital intensity.** About ₹1,629 crore of the fresh issue is earmarked for roughly 1,904 new dark stores, an average of about ₹86 lakh per store if spread evenly. The actual allocation per store is not disclosed in the sources ([Precize, 2026](https://www.precize.in/blogs/zepto-ipo-pre-ipo-share-price)).

## Analyst Assessment

In my judgement, the revised timeline is more likely a reflection of weak public-market readiness than a purely procedural delay. Three signals support this view. First, the company is raising a pre-IPO round to align with investor valuation expectations, which implies a pricing gap. Second, the company is also pursuing burn reduction and dark-store optimisation, suggesting that the cost base is being reset ahead of listing. Third, the company is extending its clearance window rather than pressing for a near-term launch.

The strongest positive case rests on growth: order volumes compounded at about 119.5% over two years, and revenue more than doubled in FY26 ([Yahoo Finance / Retail Insight Network, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/quick-commerce-company-zepto-targets-094837090.html)). The strongest negative case rests on losses, which widened in absolute terms and still represent roughly a quarter of revenue ([Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/indian-quick-commerce-firm-zepto-204629885.html)). My view is that the February–May 2027 window is achievable only if Zepto shows visible progress on per-order losses in the next two quarters. Without that, further delay or a lower valuation is more likely than an IPO at the earlier $7–8 billion ambition.

This assessment rests largely on press reports and secondary aggregators rather than primary company disclosures for the most recent period. It should be tested against management's own data in the meeting.

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. **Valuation and unit economics:** What valuation range is management targeting for the $105 million pre-IPO round, and what adjusted EBITDA per order or contribution margin milestones must be met before the updated DRHP is filed?
2. **Burn and dark-store plan:** Which dark-store cohorts are being optimised or closed under the burn-reduction programme, and what is the target monthly burn and runway through the IPO window?
3. **Regulatory status:** Has the Enforcement Directorate inquiry progressed since the June filing, and were any Zepto facilities affected by the October 2026 licence suspensions in Uttar Pradesh?

# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Zepto, 17 November 2026

**Window covered:** roughly 18 October to 17 November 2026. Items outside this window are marked as background.

**Source gaps:** The results include no hires, and no product launches beyond a marketing campaign.

## Deals

- **Reported acquisition by Globex Corporation.** The company has reportedly agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, per people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). *Caveat: the snippet does not name Zepto. Confirm the target before relying on this.*
- **Funding (background, outside window).** Tavily's profile lists a $100M venture round dated 1 July 2026 and a $450M Series H dated 16 November 2025 (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/YT08vmcifB58).

## Marketing and Campaigns

- **Seoul Street / anime campaign.** Zepto's brand push drew coverage in October. Chief brand officer Chandan Mendiratta is quoted, and Zepto declined to name the next fandom. Fans were due to queue in Hyderabad on 14 November (https://www.animationxpress.com/latest-news/zepto-lands-in-seoul-street-anime-india-is-up-next-the-fans-got-there-years-ago).

## Festive Trading

- **Dhanteras.** Zepto reported delivering over 14,000 gold and silver coins in one hour (https://indiabusinesstrade.in/dhanteras-2026-zepto-delivers-over-14000-gold-and-silver-coins-in-one-hour.htm).
- **Diwali baskets.** Zepto recorded 3X growth in festive hamper orders versus last Diwali, and fashion purchases doubled, led by ethnic wear (https://www.ndtvprofit.com/business/from-gold-coins-to-diet-coke-what-diwali-shopping-carts-reveal-about-indias-consumption-12309693). *The article's phrasing is ambiguous about whether the fashion figure is Zepto-specific.*

## Workforce and People

- **Extra holiday.** Zepto moved its post-Diwali holiday from Tuesday to Monday. Chief HR officer Sneha Arora cited a longer family weekend (https://m.economictimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/india-inc-lights-up-diwali-with-longer-weekends-flexible-work-and-extra-pay-for-festive-shifts/articleshow/135618893.cms).
- **Bonus backlash.** A viral video of a delivery partner receiving "cash-like coupons" instead of a bonus drew criticism of worker welfare (https://www.news18.com/viral/zeptos-diwali-bonus-video-goes-viral-delivery-partner-gets-cash-like-coupons-instead-of-money-peanuts-in-the-name-of-a-bonus-ws-l-10418467.html). A social media post also cited a "valuation 7 billion" figure, which is unverified (same source).

## Regulatory

- **Maharashtra FDA action.** The FDA suspended food licences for Blinkit, Zepto and 103 others, out of 105 suspended licences statewide. The actions were taken on 4 and 5 November (https://www.rediff.com/news/commentary/2026/nov/06/fda-suspends-food-licence-of-blinkit-zepto-103-others/14358878a29915ea01709670aa484bc5).

## Open Questions

1. Is Zepto the company in the reported Globex acquisition, and what does the deal mean for our discussions and timing?
2. What is the status of the Maharashtra food licence suspensions, and what steps are being taken to restore operations?
3. How is Zepto addressing the Diwali bonus concerns and delivery-partner compensation, and will the bonus structure change?

# NVIDIA Briefing: 16 October to 15 November 2026

Prepared for a meeting on 17 November 2026. NVIDIA reports Q3 FY2027 results that day at about 1:20 p.m. PT, with the earnings call at 2 p.m. PT [1].

## Leadership and News Coverage

The most material change is the leadership transition, which the company announced on 12 November 2026 [1][2].

- **12 Nov:** Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO, and Board member, effective immediately. Colette Kress, EVP and CFO since September 2013, was named Interim CEO and will remain CFO until a permanent successor is named. The Board is searching internally and externally, with no stated timetable [1][2].
- **11 Nov:** The Board appointed Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair. Jones has served on the Board since 1993 and is a former CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys [1][2]. The 8-K reports the Board seat count falling from 11 to 10 (derived in a third-party analysis; not verified against the filing) [URL not captured].
- **10 Nov:** A statement from the independent Board members was issued [1]. Its content was not captured in the research.
- **8 Nov:** The Board announced an independent investigation, overseen by a committee of independent directors with outside counsel, following reporting that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. The Board said it had "no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised" [1].
- **8 Nov:** Huang issued a message to the company admitting an extramarital affair. The New York Times first reported the story, and a Yahoo Finance republication links the matter to a business executive the U.S. government reportedly considers to be working with Chinese intelligence. These allegations are reported, not confirmed by the company [URL not captured].
- **Market reaction:** One report says NVIDIA's stock fell about 5.18% after the news. The date and exchange are not confirmed [URL not captured].

## Product or Service Launches

No product or service launch dated within the window was verified. The research returned no results for this category. The Meta expansion (see Deals) covers deployment of Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs, Spectrum-X, and BlueField-4 but is a customer deployment, not a launch [1].

## Executive and Notable Hires

- **11–12 Nov:** The leadership appointments above are the only executive or board appointments verified in the window: Harvey C. Jones as Chair (11 Nov) and Colette Kress as Interim CEO (12 Nov) [1][2].
- **No external executive hire** was verified for the window.
- **Context (outside window):** A third-party analysis lists earlier 2026 Item 5.02 changes, including the CAO transition in May and the EVP transition in August. These fall outside the 30-day window and were not verified against primary filings [URL not captured].

## Deals, Partnerships, Acquisitions, and Investments

- **26 Oct:** NVIDIA will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering, subject to closing conditions. The two companies also expanded their partnership on the Muse family of models. Meta plans to deploy Vera Rubin and Vera CPUs, Spectrum-X Ethernet, and BlueField-4, and will consider NVIDIA OpenShell and Sentry [1]. A CNBC Africa report dated 27 Oct describes the announcement as made "on Tuesday," so the date is 26 Oct per the newsroom, with a one-day discrepancy in press coverage [URL not captured].
- **Meta's financing context:** Meta is seeking up to $95 billion, with about $35 billion in underwritten offerings and $60 billion through an at-the-market program starting in early 2027. NVIDIA, AMD, and Broadcom were reported to have interest in buying up to $5 billion of Meta stock combined [URL not captured].
- **8 Nov:** NVIDIA, Rebellions, and SK Telecom announced an NVLink Fusion sovereign AI collaboration, listed in the newsroom's related items. Deal terms were not captured [1].
- **Pending acquisition (date unconfirmed):** A third-party analysis reports a pending $11.9 billion Hugging Face acquisition, with closing expected in the first half of 2027. The announcement date was not confirmed within the window [URL not captured].

## Source Gaps

Most facts link to the NVIDIA Newsroom or SEC EDGAR root pages rather than specific releases or filings. Deep links should be confirmed before the meeting. Items marked "URL not captured" were found in the research without a verifiable link and should be checked before they are cited externally.

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. With Kress serving as both Interim CEO and CFO, what governance arrangements are in place for the CEO search, and how will the Board manage the transition alongside the Q3 FY2027 results on 17 November?
2. What is the scope and expected timeline of the independent investigation, and does the Board expect any effect on the Meta investment, the NVLink Fusion collaboration, or the pending Hugging Face acquisition?
3. Given that the Meta investment is subject to closing conditions, what are the expected closing dates, and has the leadership change altered NVIDIA's commitments under the expanded Muse partnership?

## Sources

[1] NVIDIA Newsroom (press releases dated 8 Nov, 10 Nov, 12 Nov, and 26 Oct 2026; deep links not captured): https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/
[2] SEC EDGAR, NVIDIA Form 8-K dated 12 Nov 2026 (Item 5.02; event dated 11 Nov 2026; deep link not captured): https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/
[3] CNBC Africa, report on Meta investment (27 Oct 2026): URL not captured
[4] Techzine, report on Meta Vera Rubin and Muse partnership (late Oct 2026): URL not captured
[5] Yahoo Finance (republishing a Realtor.com article on the Huang resignation, 8–12 Nov 2026): URL not captured

runs.query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Stripe on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
runs.briefing:
# Stripe Briefing: 16 October to 15 November 2026

**Meeting:** Stripe, 17 November 2026
**Research window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026

## Summary

Stripe's activity in the window centred on agentic commerce and embedded financial products. The company made five newsroom product or partnership announcements, signed a Formula 1 team sponsorship, and expanded bank and wallet work in the UK and US. No acquisitions, funding rounds, tender offers, or valuation changes were found in the window. Regulatory coverage was limited to terms and policy updates. No in-window fines, investigations, outages, or security incidents were identified.

## News

- **Terms and policy updates.** Stripe's Services Agreement was last modified on 28 September 2026 and was first observed on 18 October. The General Terms add an AI Agent section stating that the user is solely responsible for every action initiated through an AI agent and that those actions are legally binding on the user [1]. A third-party monitor recorded a privacy policy change first seen on 23 October, with an update effective 20 November 2026 and a changed US privacy contact address [2][3]. Both are monitoring-based records and should be checked against Stripe's own pages before the meeting.
- **Blog thought leadership.** Stripe published several product and industry posts in the window, including a 16 October post on fintech payouts and stablecoin cards [4], a 30 October account of moving $1B in vendor payments to Global Payouts [5], and a 5 November post on analysing Stripe data through an agent [6].

## Product Launches

- **Stripe Treasury for agents (21 October).** Startups can let AI agents check balances, settle invoices, move funds, and convert currencies through Stripe's MCP server. Money movement requires human approval by default [7][8][9]. Stripe states that checking accounts are provided by Fifth Third Bank, not Stripe [8].
- **Claude Duet integration (21 October).** Anthropic's Claude Duet, in US research preview, can buy goods for a business through Stripe's Link agent wallet. Each purchase needs owner approval and is paid with a virtual card. Claude can also use Stripe MCP for invoicing, refunds, and revenue analysis [10][11][12]. No general-availability date was given.
- **Global Payouts (16 October and 30 October).** Stripe reported that new-market setup for vendor payouts fell from six weeks to one, with a 99.9% payout success rate [5]. Stripe also announced fintech-focused payout and stablecoin card updates in more countries [4].

## Hires and Leadership

- **John Collison nominated to Microsoft's board.** Microsoft's 2026 proxy statement, with letters dated 21 October, nominates the Stripe co-founder and president. The annual meeting is on 8 December. Flag: a primary source URL was not captured in the research, so this item is unverified until confirmed.
- **Isabella Liu, Head of Communications, Asia.** Reports dated 20 October say she now oversees Stripe's communications across APAC, Southeast Asia, Greater China, and India from Singapore. Flag: a verifiable URL was not captured, so this item is unverified.
- No other in-window executive appointments or departures were found.

## Deals and Partnerships

- **HSBC UK Tap to Pay (10 November).** Stripe powers a tap-to-pay offering that lets eligible HSBC UK small businesses accept contactless payments on a compatible phone without a card reader [13][14]. Commercial terms were not disclosed.
- **Samsung Wallet stablecoin purchases (5 November).** Stripe's Crypto Onramp powers USDC purchases in Samsung's Stablecoin Account for eligible US Galaxy users. Stripe also handles identity, compliance, and fraud checks. Samsung Pay is now available to businesses using Crypto Onramp [15]. Flag: a third-party source dates Samsung's US launch to 7 October, so the sequence of announcements should be confirmed [16].
- **Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team (20 October).** Stripe is the team's Official Global Payments Partner and Official Team Partner, with car branding from the first race of the 2027 season [17][18]. The value and length were not disclosed.
- **Stratechery presented by Stripe (21 October).** Stripe is the presenting sponsor of Ben Thompson's Stratechery, with ads in placements and a Stripe segment on Sharp Tech. Thompson states that his contract with Stripe includes editorial independence [19][20].
- **Rocker seed round (28 October).** A valuation aggregator lists Stripe as an investor in a $13M seed round. Flag: unverified. No Stripe or Rocker announcement was found, so this item should not be presented as confirmed [21].

**Context outside the window:** Stripe's acquisitions of Parafin and OpenRouter, and Stripe and Advent's pursuit of PayPal, were earlier events. They are not in the window but may be relevant to the discussion [22][23][24].

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. What are the timelines for general availability of Claude Duet and the Treasury for agents features, including agent spending limits? How does Stripe plan to allocate liability for agent-initiated payments, given the new AI Agent terms?
2. How is Stripe reviewing account eligibility and termination policies in light of the FTC's debanking scrutiny, and what changes, if any, does the 20 November privacy policy update introduce for US customers?
3. Can Stripe confirm the status of its reported Rocker investment, and how does it approach disclosing strategic investments and sponsorships like the Stratechery and Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS deals?

runs.briefing:
# Shopify Briefing: 16 October to 15 November 2026

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026. Attendees, purpose, your role, and business-unit or regional interests were not specified, so none are assumed.

## Coverage Summary

Two of the four categories have sourced activity in the window: news and product launches. Hires and leadership has one unverified lead, and no source URL was captured for it. Deals returned no qualifying activity.

## 1. News

- **Q3 2026 results (3 November 2026):** Revenue rose 32% (32% in constant currency), free cash flow margin was 22%, and GMV was $119 billion. [Shopify Investor Relations](https://shopifyinvestors.gcs-web.com)
- **Q4 2026 outlook:** Revenue growth is expected in the low-thirties percent range year over year. Gross profit dollars are expected to grow in the high-twenties. Operating expenses are guided to 29–30% of revenue, and stock-based compensation to $155 million. Free cash flow margin is expected to be consistent with Q4 2025. [Shopify Investor Relations](https://shopifyinvestors.gcs-web.com)
- **Filings (3 November 2026):** An 8-K, a 10-Q, and an S-3ASR are listed as dated 3 November. The 8-K's contents were not retrieved, so it is unknown whether it reports an officer or director change. [Shopify Investor Relations](https://shopifyinvestors.gcs-web.com)

## 2. Product Launches and Feature Releases

- **Fall '26 Edition:** Shopify's merchant announcement and the Editions page describe the release. [Shopify Editions Fall '26](https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026)
- **Agentic commerce:** A Shop skill lets ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents discover products and check out with Shop Pay. Shop Pay is also listed in Muse, Claude Duet, Instinct, and Grok Bot. Merchants can sell through Google Search AI Mode and the Gemini app. [Shopify Editions Fall '26](https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026)
- **Sidekick:** Shopify reports daily Sidekick sessions grew 4.2x year over year. Sidekick stages multi-step changes and applies them only after merchant approval. [Shopify Editions Fall '26](https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026)
- **Payments and international:** Shopify reports +50% higher international conversion for brands using Managed Markets, and lists Shopify Protect fraud and dispute tools. These are company-reported figures. [Shopify Editions Fall '26](https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026)
- **Developer deadlines:** Per a partner agency's review dated 11 November 2026, expiring offline access tokens become required for public apps on 1 January 2027. Shopify stops loading script tags on storefronts on 1 March 2027. Apps have been unable to create or update script tags since 1 October 2026. [Domaine review of Fall '26](https://domaineworldwide.com/de/einblicke/technologie/shopify-editions-fall-26-our-team-picks)
- **POS and retail:** Native stock counts in POS replace Quick Count, and HSA/FSA payments are accepted with Shop Pay. [Domaine review of Fall '26](https://domaineworldwide.com/de/einblicke/technologie/shopify-editions-fall-26-our-team-picks)

## 3. Hires and Leadership

No in-window appointment or departure was confirmed with a direct source URL.

One unverified lead needs checking before the meeting: a BetaKit report dated 19 October 2026 says CTO Mikhail Parakhin is moving to an advisory role, and Shopify has not named a successor. The source URL was not captured, so this is not stated as a fact.

## 4. Deals

No partnership, acquisition, investment, or major customer or vendor agreement dated within the window was found with a direct source URL.

## Three Open Questions

1. Q4 guidance calls for low-thirties revenue growth after 32% in Q3. What drives the expected slowdown, and which parts of the business does that outlook assume?
2. Offline access tokens become mandatory on 1 January 2027, and script tags stop loading on 1 March 2027. What support is Shopify providing to developers and merchants with older custom apps to complete these changes?
3. Shop skill and Shop Pay now let external agents such as ChatGPT and Claude complete checkout. How does Shopify think about brand ownership of the customer relationship and checkout data when a purchase happens inside an agent?

## Sources

[1] Shopify Investor Relations, Financials: https://shopifyinvestors.gcs-web.com
[2] Shopify Editions, Fall '26: https://www.shopify.com/editions/fall2026
[3] Domaine, "Shopify Editions Fall '26: The Features Our Experts Rate": https://domaineworldwide.com/de/einblicke/technologie/shopify-editions-fall-26-our-team-picks

runs.query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Databricks on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
runs.briefing:
# Databricks Briefing: 16 October to 15 November 2026

*Prepared for the meeting on 17 November 2026. Items are ordered by materiality within each category.*

## 1. News

- **Second-generation Genie launched on 11 November 2026.** Databricks describes Genie as an always-on, autonomous enterprise agent that takes goals, delegates to sub-agents, and contacts users only when a decision is needed. It is governed by Unity Catalog permissions and Unity Gateway budgets and approval rules. Pricing is usage-based rather than per seat, and Databricks says more than 20,000 organizations use the platform, including 70% of the Fortune 500. [Source URL not captured in research; confirm on the Databricks newsroom before the meeting.]
- **Europe and Middle East investment of about $3 billion, announced 11 November 2026.** Databricks says this is its largest regional investment outside North America, over three years. It will fund Lakebase, Genie and Unity Gateway work, expand the EMEA team by about 50% (from more than 2,000 employees), open four offices (Amsterdam, Milan, Zurich, Frankfurt), and train about 500,000 people in data and AI skills by 2030 [1]. **Date discrepancy:** HPCwire dates the announcement 12 November [8]. Superpower Daily corroborates the investment without a day [9].

## 2. Product Launches

- **Genie expansion (11 November).** Genie Ontology is generally available. Genie Search, Ontology Manager and the always-on Genie are described as "coming soon" to preview and beta [1][2]. The November release notes, however, list Genie Search and Genie Ontology as GA [2]. **This conflict is unresolved** and should be clarified with Databricks.
- **Apache Spark 4.3.0 (30 October 2026)** is the open-source release that introduces stateful real-time streaming. Databricks made it available in Databricks Runtime 19 [6][7]. Databricks says Spark moves to a quarterly feature-release cadence [7].
- **October generally available releases:**
  - Transactions for managed Delta and Iceberg tables (14 October) [3].
  - Real-time mode in Lakeflow pipelines on classic and serverless compute (29 October) [5].
  - Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs (21 October) [3].
  - Agentic code converter for SQL targets (15 October) [3].
  - Feature Views for batch, streaming and request-time data (12 October) [3].
- **October previews and betas:** a Jailbreak guardrail for MCP tool calls in Unity Gateway (21 October, Beta) and DataFrame caching on serverless compute (23 October, Public Preview) [3].
- **November items:**
  - Genie ZeroOps in Beta, which monitors jobs and pipelines and proposes fixes (12 November) [2].
  - OAuth on-behalf-of for service principals generally available (12 November) [2].
  - Managed warehouse for MLflow in Beta (2 November) [4].
  - Gemini 3.6 Flash retires on 19 November, with calls redirected to Gemini 3.8 Flash [2].

## 3. Executive and Notable Hires

- No executive hire, departure or appointment dated within the window was found in the research.
- Samuel Bonamigo is quoted as SVP and General Manager, EMEA, in the 11 November release. The release does not describe his appointment, so no hire can be confirmed [1].

## 4. Deals

- **Investment and partnerships:** The $3 billion EMEA plan [1] is the main deal item. The same release references startup investments made in the past six months: Tsuga, Advancing Analytics (through Databricks Ventures) and Applied Computing (through the AI Accelerator Program). It also names customers ABN Amro, adidas, Danone, Heineken, HelloFresh, Mercedes-Benz and Nationwide [1]. None of these is dated within the window, and the release gives no allocation of the $3 billion.
- **Flagged, not verified (no verifiable URL captured, so excluded from the main findings):**
  - Reuters joining the Databricks marketplace (about 6 November). Only an X post was seen.
  - Databricks Ventures' Reflex Series A ($15M, 29 October). The only source is an aggregator profile.
  - More than $500M Netherlands investment (10 November). It is referenced but was not opened.
  - Fox Corporation selecting Databricks as strategic partner (13 October).

## Three Open Questions for the Meeting

1. Which Genie components are generally available today: Genie Search and Genie Ontology, which the release notes list as GA, or the "coming soon" status in the launch announcement? What is the timeline for the always-on Genie?
2. How will the $3 billion EMEA investment be allocated across Lakebase, Genie, Unity Gateway, engineering hubs and customer teams, and does the Netherlands investment form part of that envelope?
3. Genie is now priced by usage rather than per seat, with spend limits set in Unity Gateway. How do customers forecast costs for always-on agents, and how is pricing expected to change as Genie Search and the always-on Genie move from preview to general availability?

---

runs.query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Canva on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
runs.briefing:
# Canva Briefing: Changes from 16 October to 15 November 2026

Prepared for the meeting on 17 November 2026. Items are limited to the window and include only facts with a source URL. Unverified items are flagged.

## Headline Change: Restructuring and Job Cuts

Canva announced its first-ever round of job cuts on 3 November 2026. CEO Melanie Perkins said 1,271 people, or 22% of staff, will lose their jobs, change roles or relocate [2]. Canva has not said how many will lose jobs [3]. Press coverage dates the announcement to 4 November [3][4]. Perkins said growth "has slowed for the first time in a decade" [4]. Canva cut its 2026 revenue growth forecast from 30% to 20% and earlier investors cut its valuation to about US$35 billion [4]. BBC reports a different figure, a drop from A$60bn to about A$49bn [5]. These valuation figures conflict across sources and should be confirmed before the meeting.

Changes:
- Product, Growth and Platform merge into one Product Org [2].
- Subspecialisation is reduced and layers are collapsed [2].
- Sydney becomes the primary home for more product teams. Hybrid staff are expected in the office 2 to 3 days a week from January [2][3].

Support for leavers: at least six months' salary regardless of location, removal of the one-year vesting cliff for recent joiners, twelve months of healthcare where provided, and a US$10,000 Canva Collective Fund grant (registration closes 14 December) [2][3]. Perkins said the company is "refounding" around small, empowered teams [2][6].

## News

- **3 Nov 2026:** Perkins's team update was published on the newsroom [2][1].
- **Mid-Oct to early Nov:** Canva's Ad Council and Common Sense Media partnerships, and the "What Will You Canva Today?" campaign, are listed in the newsroom index [1]. The campaign replaces the homepage question used for about 13 years and is Canva's first North American brand campaign [11].

## Product Launches

- **15 Oct 2026:** Digital literacy lessons for Canva Education, and the Mattel template collection [1].
- **21 Oct 2026:** Canva Research introduced [1].
- **22 Oct 2026:** Canva Craft, Canva's first image-generation model, was launched. Canva says it ranks as the world's second most advanced image-generation lab on DesignArena [1].
- **29 Oct 2026:** Canva Brush, a vision-language model for design, is powering supported edits for Pro subscribers. Canva says it is up to 69% faster and 46% lower cost per edit than its previous design agent. These figures are Canva's own claims [7][8]. Wider availability is "coming soon" [7].
- **3 Nov 2026:** Affinity for iPad launched in the App Store. Core tools are free for individuals. Canva AI Studio features require a Canva premium account [9]. The Affinity product page states that content is not used to train AI features [10].

## Hires and Departures

No executive appointments or departures were verified within the window. The only leadership-related item is the restructuring memo, which names no executives [2]. Dana Marineau, Canva's North American CMO, joined in April, which is outside the window [11].

## Deals, Partnerships and Investments

No new deals, acquisitions or funding rounds were verified within the window. The Klaviyo expanded integration (16 April 2026) and the Nitro bundle (May 2025) fall outside the window. A PayPal Payment Links deal with Canva was found, but its date could not be confirmed, so it is omitted.

## Open Questions for Canva

1. With the Product Org merged and layers reduced, who will own Brush, Craft and Affinity roadmaps, and when will Brush reach wider availability beyond Canva Pro?
2. The growth forecast was cut to 20% due to AI costs [4]. Brush reports 46% lower cost per edit [7]. How will these cost gains affect pricing and the Canva AI tiers?
3. Which partnerships and channel deals remain priorities after the restructuring, given that no new in-window deals have been announced?

### Sources

[1] Canva Newsroom: https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news
[2] An important update on our team (Canva Newsroom): https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-team-update
[3] Canva CEO memo, Business Insider: https://www.businessinsider.com/canva-reorganization-layoffs-ceo-memo-2026-11
[4] Canva lays off over 1,200 people amid slowing growth, TechCrunch: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/04/canva-lays-off-over-1200-people-amid-slowing-growth
[5] BBC News, Canva restructuring coverage: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cw77pg7neydmo

[7] Introducing Canva Brush (Canva Newsroom): https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-brush

runs.query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Razorpay on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
runs.briefing:
# Razorpay Briefing: Meeting on 17 November 2026

*Research window: 16 October to 15 November 2026. Prepared 15 November 2026.*

Only one item in the window could be dated and tied to a linkable source. Items just outside the window are labelled as background. Items without a usable date or URL are listed under "Excluded" so they can be verified before the meeting.

## 1. News

- **Final IFSCA Payment Service Provider licence for GIFT City (3 Nov 2026).** Razorpay received its final PSP licence from the International Financial Services Centres Authority, following in-principle approval in April 2026. The licence lets Razorpay move money in and out of India under one framework for global investing, international collections, settlements and multi-currency flows. Razorpay says platform integration time falls from months to 2–3 weeks. Source: [Razorpay Newsroom](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)

## 2. Product and Service Launches

- **In window:** No launch with a dated, linkable source was confirmed. The GIFT City release says key investment platforms are expected to go live soon.
- **Background (just before window):** ChatGPT Ads through Razorpay Engage (5 Oct 2026). Engage prepares catalogues and runs campaigns with an AI agent and human oversight. Early brands include Tanishq, Titan, Traya, Tata Neu and Axis Max Life. The product is marked "Early access," with no pricing disclosed. Sources: [Razorpay Newsroom](https://razorpay.com/newsroom); [Engage ChatGPT Ads page](https://razorpay.com/engage/chatgpt-ads)
- **Background (just before window):** Apple Pay live online and in-store with no card entry or OTP, used by Zepto, Ixigo, IndiGo, Tata 1mg and JioMart (30 Sep 2026). Source: [Razorpay Newsroom](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)

## 3. Executive and Team Hires or Departures

- **In window:** No hire or departure with a dated, linkable source was found.
- **Leadership note:** Khilan Haria was announced as Chief Product Officer, with a remit covering global product strategy, UPI, POS and Southeast Asia expansion. The Instagram post is undated in the captured text. The newsroom places the elevation on 11 Feb 2025, which conflicts with the LinkedIn profile showing the CPO role from Oct 2024. Source: [Razorpay Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DF7UyTsSvU2?hl=en)

## 4. Deals, Partnerships and Funding

- **Banking integrations:** RBL Bank and ICICI Bank integrations are live for the GIFT City infrastructure, with further banks to follow (3 Nov 2026). Source: [Razorpay Newsroom](https://razorpay.com/newsroom)
- **Funding, tender offers, acquisitions and new bank agreements:** None with a dated, linkable source was found in the window.

## Excluded (Unverified or Outside Window)

- **Reported SEBI approval for an IPO**, with a listing targeted as early as Q1 2027 and a valuation near USD 5 billion (The Paypers, 5 Nov 2026). No URL was captured. **Verify before the meeting.**
- **Replit partnership** (UPI and card payments for Replit subscriptions, live in beta). No publication date was confirmed.
- **AI and engineering hires** (Sudhir Reddy, Abhishek Agarwal, Bhavya Shivaprakash, Anuj Mathur), reported in August 2026. No linkable source was captured, and Mathur's LinkedIn shows his role from July 2026.
- **Mrityunjoy Das** (Director, Domestic Payments, since July 2025) and **Praveen Parihar** (CISO, September 2025). Both are outside the window.

## Three Open Questions for Razorpay

1. The GIFT City release says platforms can go live in 2–3 weeks, with RBL and ICICI already live. Which investment platforms go live first, which banks join next, and on what timeline?
2. ChatGPT Ads through Engage entered early access in October. What adoption or performance results has Razorpay seen so far, and when will Engage move beyond early access?
3. The CPO's remit includes Southeast Asia expansion. What is the timeline for that expansion, and which products are planned for launch there first?

# Infosys Briefing for 17 November 2026 (Window: 16 October to 15 November 2026)

## Summary

Research found one linkable development in the window: an expanded Truist collaboration to build a Hyderabad Global Capability Center (GCC). Research found no qualifying product launch and no qualifying executive or key hire in the window. Several other in-window items, including the Q2 FY27 results and the guidance change, appeared in research notes without retained source URLs, so they are excluded from this briefing (see Source Gaps).

## News

No news item in the window could be linked to a verified source URL. Check the Infosys newsroom (infosys.com) and investor relations pages (investors.infosys.com) directly before the meeting for Q2 FY27 results, guidance, and dividend announcements dated 16 October to 15 November 2026.

## Product and Service Launches

No qualifying launch was identified in the window. Finacle and other suite references in the research were existing offerings, not new launches.

## Executive and Key Hires

No qualifying executive appointment, departure, board change, or key senior hire was identified in the window. The research did not search business press for senior hires from rival companies, so a poaching-style move could have been missed.

## Deals

**Truist expands its AI-first Global Capability Center in Hyderabad (19 October 2026).** Infosys expanded its collaboration with Truist, a large US financial services company, to build out Truist's AI-first GCC in Hyderabad [1]. Key points from the release:

- Truist is consolidating work previously delivered through multiple India supplier relationships into one integrated operating model. The stated aims are to reduce third-party dependency and manage global delivery complexity [1].
- Infosys and Truist planned to celebrate the onboarding of more than 1,000 colleagues later that month [1].
- Infosys will apply Infosys Topaz and its Build, Operate and Transfer (BOT) enablement model to help Truist build and then transition the center to a self-sustaining model [1].
- Truist's India contract workforce already spans engineering, data, and operations [1].

No contract value was disclosed in the release. Unverified third-party figures were excluded.

## Source Gaps

- Research notes reference Q2 FY27 results (23 October 2026), a lowered FY27 revenue growth outlook, a large-deal total contract value of $5.2 billion including an unnamed mega deal, the Infosys Prize 2026 (12 November), and a US Department of Labor action affecting PERM applications (10 October). These items lacked retained URLs and are not stated as facts here. Verify each on infosys.com or investors.infosys.com before citing it.
- Coverage for 1 to 15 November 2026 is thin. No Infosys-issued launch, hire, or deal dated in that period was confirmed.

## Open Questions to Ask

1. Under the BOT model for the Truist GCC, how many of the 1,000+ onboarded roles and which multi-supplier scopes transfer to Truist-led operation, and what is the transition timeline?
2. How will the Truist consolidation affect revenue visibility and margin, given the current pressure on pricing and client technology budgets?
3. Across large deals like Truist, what share of AI-led scope is priced on outcomes versus effort, and how is Infosys protecting pricing as competitive intensity rises?

### Sources

# Zepto: Briefing for 17 November 2026 Meeting

## Scope and Headline

Between 16 October and 15 November 2026, the research confirmed one regulatory matter, one operational update, and reports that Zepto has paused its IPO and is raising a smaller pre-IPO round. No in-window executive hires, product launches, or verified partnerships were found. Most in-window items rest on secondary sources, and some dates could not be confirmed.

## In-Window Developments (16 Oct to 15 Nov 2026)

### Regulatory and Consumer Matters

- **FSSAI notice over expired besan (dated 19 October 2026, per Business Standard/PTI).** The food regulator issued a notice to Zepto Marketplace Pvt Ltd after a customer alleged that two packs of gram flour arrived with a "use by" date of 12 September 2026. FSSAI asked Zepto to verify the complaint, explain the root cause, confirm withdrawal of affected stock, notify customers, process refunds, set out preventive measures, and submit a written response [4]. The source URL was not captured in the research record, so the link should be checked before the meeting.

### Operations and Partner Network

- **Delivery partner app listing updated (last updated 24 October 2026, per Google Play).** The listing advertises referral bonuses of up to ₹7,000 and medical insurance for riders in "10+ cities across India." Recent reviews complain that per-order earnings were cut by ₹2 to ₹6 [3]. This is a company-published operational update, not a deal.

### Funding and Valuation (reported mid-November, date unconfirmed)

- **IPO on hold and a ₹1,000 Cr pre-IPO placement in progress.** An Inc42 social post, which appears to be from around 14–15 November 2026, reports that Zepto has put its IPO on hold, is raising about ₹1,000 Cr from mainly domestic investors, and is being valued at $2.5–3 billion, against a last private valuation of $7 billion [1]. Zepto had not commented in the sources reviewed. This is a secondary report and needs confirmation.
- **Conflicting commentary.** A separate Inc42 post describes the "₹8,010 Cr IPO" as "finally here" [2]. This conflicts with the reports above and with the pause reported in July, so it should be treated as commentary, not a confirmed event.

### Not Found in Window

- Executive or senior hires, product or service launches, acquisitions, distribution or vendor agreements, and debt facilities. The searches returned no verified items for these categories.

## Context Before the Window (for background only)

- **Pre-IPO placement and IPO delay.** Reports from July 2026 said Zepto planned to raise about ₹1,000 Cr at roughly $4.5 billion, pushing back its IPO, which had been targeted for July [5][6]. Bloomberg reported that foreign investors indicated a pre-money valuation near $4.5 billion, while some domestic institutions valued the company at $3–3.5 billion [7]. Zepto's press release says it agreed with major shareholders to close a pre-IPO private placement, and that the company will focus on execution rather than listing immediately. The release states cash of ₹5,681 Cr and no debt as of 31 March 2026. Its publication date was reported as 1 August 2026, though the release itself is undated and its URL was not captured.
- **Listing timeline.** Reports suggest a February to May 2027 listing target. Zepto's CEO reportedly said the company has until November 2027 to list without refiling its draft papers [Forbes India, 3 August 2026; URL not captured].

## Gaps and Conflicts

- **FY26 net loss:** one Inc42 post cites ₹5,095 Cr, while restated figures reported elsewhere show ₹5,905.19 Cr. The second figure is more consistent with the restated numbers.
- **Unverified dates:** the Inc42 IPO-on-hold post and the "finally here" post lack confirmed publication dates.
- **Primary-source gap:** no in-window statement from Zepto's own newsroom or blog was located.

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. Can you confirm the status, size, valuation, and closing date of the pre-IPO placement, and whether the listing timeline has changed from the reported February to May 2027 target?
2. What is the current quarterly cash burn and runway, and what milestones will the company use to show a path to profitability, given the reported FY26 loss figures?
3. What were the root cause and corrective actions for the FSSAI besan notice, and what changes are planned for rider earnings and quality of service?

- **Public previews (28 October 2026).** Wero bank redirect for the EU, multi-currency settlement for connected accounts, and the Queries and Reports API, which lets users query Stripe data with SQL [2].

## Executive and Team Hires

- No in-window executive appointment, departure or promotion was found with a linkable source. The Stripe newsroom listing contains no personnel announcements in the window.
- A Microsoft proxy filing dated 21 October 2026 nominates Stripe co-founder and President John Collison to Microsoft's board. This is an outside board role, and no linkable primary source was captured, so it is excluded.

## Deals and Partnerships

- **HSBC UK Tap to Pay (10 November 2026).** Stripe and HSBC announced Tap to Pay for UK small businesses [1].
- **Samsung Wallet stablecoin purchases (5 November 2026).** Stripe announced stablecoin purchases in Samsung Wallet [1].
- **Anthropic (21 October 2026).** Stripe and Anthropic announced a partnership to help entrepreneurs run their business inside Claude [1].
- **Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team (20 October 2026).** Stripe announced a partnership with the team [1].

## Open Questions for the Meeting

1. Outbound Payments limits for ACH and wires were raised to $100 million. What risk controls and monitoring apply to these flows, and do they change for new markets? [2][3]
2. OUSD is now a supported token, and stablecoin purchases are live in Samsung Wallet. How does Stripe balance stablecoin growth with compliance and consumer protection requirements? [1][2]
3. Treasury for agents and agent-driven purchases are now live. How does Stripe govern agent-initiated payments, including spending limits, approvals and dispute handling? [1]
